Arakhin 23a:11-23b:7: Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer vechulei. moshe bar atzri arva dechalleteh hava, verav huna bereh tzureba merabbanan hava, udechika leh milleta. amar abbaye: lekka denasseveh etza lerav huna, deligaresh lidvethu vetitba ketubbeta meavu, velahdera mihadaroy.
Amar leh rava: vehaanan "yiddor hanaa" tenan! veabbaye — attu kol dimgaresh beve dina megaresh? lesof iggallay milleta dechohen hava. amar abbaye: batar anya azla anyuta.
Umi amar abbaye hachi? vehaamar abbaye: ezehu rasha arum? ze hammassi etza limkor binchasim, kerabban gamliel.
Vetippok leh dearev dichtubba la mishtabad!
Kabbelan hava. hanicha leman deamar: kabbelan, af al gav delet leh nechasim lelove — mishtabad, ella leman deamar: it leh — mishtabad, let leh — la mishtabad, may ikka lememar?
Ibbaet ema: rav huna hava leh veishteduf, veibbaet ema: abba legabbeh bereh shabode meshabed nafsheh.

Deittemar: arev dichtubba — divre hakkol la mishtabad, kabbelan devaal chov — divre hakkol mishtabad, arev devaal chov vekabbelan dichtubba — peligi. ikka leman deamar: it leh nichse lelove — mishtabad, let leh — la mishtabad, veikka leman deamar: af al gav delet leh — mishtabad.
Vehilcheta bechullehu, af al gav delet leh name mishtabad, levar mearev dichtubba, deaf al gav deit leh la mishtabad. may tama? mitzva kaaved, vela midde chassereh.

Hahu gavra dezabbeninhu lenichseh, veka (gershah) [megarsha] lidvethu. shalcha rav yosef bereh derava lekammeh derav pappa: arev tenan, hekdesh tenan, lokeach mahu? amar leh: tanna ki rochla nichashshev venezil?
Nehardae amri: ditnan tenan, dela tenan la tenan. amar rav mesharsheya: may tama dinhardae? bishlama hekdesh — mishshum revach dehekdesh, arev name — mitzva hu daavad, velav midde chassereh.
Ella lokeach, mikkede midda yada dechol chad vechad ikka aleh ketubba, ammay nezil venizbon? ihu hu deafsed annafsheh!
Avodah Zarah 75b:7-76a:2: Gemara tana: vechullan tzerichin tevila bearbaim sea. menahane mille? amar rava, deamar kera: "kol davar asher yavo vaesh taaviru vaesh vetaher", hosif lecha hakkatuv tohora acheret.
Tane bar kappara: mittoch shenneemar "beme nidda", shomea ani shetztzarich hazzaa shelishi ushevii, talmud lomar "ach" — chalak.
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "beme nidda"? mayim shennidda tovelet bahen, heve omer: arbaim sea.
Itzterich lemichtav "vetaher", veitzterich lemichtav "beme nidda". i ketav "vetaher", hava amena "vetaher" kol dehu, ketav rachamana "beme nidda".
Vei ketav rachamana beme nidda, hava amena heerev shemesh kenidda, ketav rachamana "vetaher" lealtar.

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: afillu kelim chadashim bammashma, deha yeshanim velibbenan kachadashim damu, vaafillu hachi bae tevila. matkef la rav sheshet: i hachi, afillu zuza desarbala name! amar leh: kele seuda amurin bapparasha.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella bilkuchin, uchemaase shehaya, aval sheulin — la.
Rav yitzchak bar yosef zevan mana demarda miggoy, sevar lehatebilah, amar leh hahu merabbanan verabbi yaakov shemeh: ledidi mipparsha leh minneh derabbi yochanan: kele mattachot amurin bapparasha.

Amar rav ashe: hane kele zechuchit, hoil vechi nishtabberu yesh lahen takkana, kichle mattachot damu. kuneya, peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad amar: kitchillato, vechad amar: kesofo, vehilcheta kesofo.

Ibbaya lehu: mashkanta may? amar mar bar rav ashe: abba mashken leh goy kasa dechaspa, veatbeleh veishti beh, vela yadana i mishshum dekasavar mashkanta kizvine damya, i mishshum dechaze legoy dedateh leshakkoeh.

Tanu rabbanan: hallokeach kele tashmish min haggoyim, devarim shello nishtammesh bahen — matbilan vehen tehorin. devarim shennishtammesh bahen al yede tzonen, kegon kosot vekittoniyyot utzelochiyyot — maddichan umatbilan vehem tehorin. devarim shennishtammesh bahen al yede chammin, kegon hayyorot hakkumekmosin umechamme chammin — magilan umatbilan vehen tehorin. devarim shennishtammesh bahen al yede haur, kegon hashshappudin vehaaskelaot — melabbenan umatbilan vehen tehorin.
Vechullan shennishtammesh bahen ad shello yatbil veshello yagil veshello yelabben, tane chada: asur, vetanya iddach: muttar.
La kashya, ha keman deamar: noten taam lifgam — asur, ha keman deamar: noten taam lifgam — muttar.
Uleman deamar: noten taam lifgam — muttar, giule goyim deasar rachamana hechi mashkachat la?
Amar rav chiyyay bereh derav huna: lo asra tora ella kedera
Bat yoma, delav noten taam lifgam hu.
Mikkan veelach lishtere! gezera kedera sheenah bat yoma mishshum kedera bat yoma.
Berakhot 63b:21-64a:14: Patach rabbi nechemya bichvod achsanya vedarash: may dichtiv "vayyomer shaul el hakkeni lechu suru redu mittoch amaleki pen osifcha immo veatta asita chesed im kol bene yisrael"? vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma yitro shello kerav et moshe ella lichvod atzmo — kach, hameareach talmid chacham betoch beto, umaachilo umashkehu umehannehu minnechasav — al achat kamma vechamma.

Patach rabbi yose bichvod achsanya vedarash: "lo tetaev adomi ki achicha hu lo tetaev mitzri ki ger hayita veartzo", vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma mitzriyyim shello kervu et yisrael ella letzorech atzman, shenneemar: "veim yadata veyesh bam anshe chayil vesamtam sare mikne al asher li" — kach, hameareach talmid chacham betoch beto umaachilo umashkehu umehannehu minnechasav — al achat kamma vechamma.

Patach rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili bichvod achsanya vedarash: "vayvarech Adonai et oved edom haggitti baavur aron haelohim", vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma aron shello achal veshata, ella kibbed veribbetz lefanav — kach, hameareach talmid chacham betoch beto, umaachilo umashkehu umehannehu minnechasav — al achat kamma vechamma.
May hi beracha shebbercho? amar rav yehuda bar zevida: zo chamot ushemone kalloteha sheyyaldu shishsha shishsha bechares echad.
Shenneemar: "peulletay hashshemini", uchetiv "ki vercho elohim". "kol elle mibbene oved edom hemma uvenehem vaachehem ish chayil bakkoach laavoda shishshim ushenayim leoved edom".
Amar rabbi avin hallevi: kol haddochek et hashshaa — shaa dochakto. vechol hannidche mippene hashshaa — shaa nidchet mippanav.

Midderabba verav yosef. derav yosef sinay verabba oker harim, itztericha lehu shata. shelachu lehatam: sinay veoker harim, eze mehem kodem? shelachu lehu: sinay kodem, shehakkol tzerichin lemare chittayya. af al pi chen lo kibbel alav rav yosef, deamri leh kaldae: malchat tarten shenin.
Melach rabba esrin vetarten shenin, melach rav yosef tarten shenin ufalga.
Kol hanach shene dimlach rabba, afillu ummana leveteh la kera.
Veamar rabbi avin hallevi: may dichtiv "yaancha Adonai beyom tzara yesaggevcha shem elohe yaakov", elohe yaakov velo elohe avraham veyitzchak? mikkan levaal hakkora sheyyikkanes beovyah shel kora.

Veamar rabbi avin hallevi: kol hannehene misseuda shettalmid chacham sharuy betochah, keillu nehene mizziv shechina, shenneemar: "vayyavo aharon vechol zikne yisrael leechol lechem im choten moshe lifne haelohim", vechi lifne elohim achlu? vahalo lifne moshe achlu!
Ella lomar lach kol hannehene misseuda shettalmid chacham sharuy betochah — keillu nehene mizziv shechina.

Veamar rabbi avin hallevi: hanniftar mechavero al yomar lo "lech beshalom", ella "lech leshalom", shehare yitro sheamar lo lemoshe "lech leshalom", ala vehitzliach. david sheamar lo leavshalom "lech beshalom", halach venitla.
Veamar rabbi avin hallevi: hanniftar min hammet al yomar lo "lech leshalom", ella "lech beshalom", shenneemar: "veatta tavo el avotecha beshalom".
Amar rabbi levi bar chiyyay: hayyotze mibbet hakkeneset venichnas levet hammidrash veosek battora — zoche umekabbel pene shechina, shenneemar "yelchu mechayil el chayil yerae el elohim betziyyon".
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: talmide chachamim en lahem menucha lo baolam hazze velo baolam habba, shenneemar: "yelchu mechayil el chayil yerae el elohim betziyyon".
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam, shenneemar: "vechol banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich".

Al tikre "banayich" ella "bonayich". "shalom rav leohave toratecha veen lamo michshol". "yehi shalom bechelech shalva bearmenotayich". "lemaan achay vereay adabbera na shalom bach. lemaan bet Adonai elohenu avaksha tov lach". "Adonai oz leammo yitten Adonai yevarech et ammo vashshalom".
I Kings 8:54-59: Vayhi ׀ kechallot shelomo lehitpallel el-Adonai et kol-hattefilla vehattechinna hazzot kam millifne mizbach Adonai mikkeroa al-birkav vechappav perusot hashshamayim
Vayyaamod vayvarech et kol-kehal yisrael kol gadol lemor

Lehattot levavenu elav lalechet bechol-derachav velishmor mitzvotav vechukkav umishpatav asher tzivva et-avotenu
Veyihyu devaray elle asher hitchannanti lifne Adonai kerovim el-Adonai elohenu yomam valayla laasot ׀ mishpat avdo umishpat ammo yisrael devar-yom beyomo

Vayyizbach shelomo et zevach hashshelamim asher zavach laAdonai bakar esrim ushenayim elef vetzon mea veesrim alef vayyachnechu et-bet Adonai hammelech vechol-bene yisrael
I Kings 8:64-9:2: Bayyom hahu kiddash hammelech et-toch hechatzer asher lifne vet-Adonai ki-asa sham et-haola veet-hammincha veet chelve hashshelamim ki-mizbach hannechoshet asher lifne Adonai katon mehachil et-haola veet-hammincha veet chelve hashshelamim
Vayyaas shelomo vaet-hahi ׀ et-hechag vechol-yisrael immo kahal gadol millevo chamat ׀ ad-nachal mitzrayim lifne Adonai elohenu shivat yamim veshivat yamim arbaa asar yom
Bayyom hashshemini shillach et-haam vayvarchu et-hammelech vayyelchu leoholehem semechim vetove lev al kol-hattova asher asa Adonai ledavid avdo uleyisrael ammo
Vayhi kechallot shelomo livnot et-bet-Adonai veet-bet hammelech veet kol-cheshek shelomo asher chafetz laasot {p}
Vayyera Adonai el-shelomo shenit kaasher nira elav begivon
Joshua 1:1-6: Vayhi achare mot moshe eved Adonai vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua bin-nun mesharet moshe lemor
Moshe avdi met veatta kum avor et-hayyarden hazze atta vechol-haam hazze el-haaretz asher anochi noten lahem livne yisrael
Kol-makom asher tidroch kaf-raglechem bo lachem netattiv kaasher dibbarti el-moshe
Mehammidbar vehallevanon hazze vead-hannahar haggadol nehar-perat kol eretz hachittim vead-hayyam haggadol mevo hashshamesh yihye gevulechem
Lo-yityatztzev ish lefanecha kol yeme chayyecha kaasher hayiti im-moshe ehye immach lo arpecha velo eezvekka
Chazak veematz ki atta tanchil et-haam hazze et-haaretz asher-nishbati laavotam latet lahem
Joshua 1:7-11: Rak chazak veematz meod lishmor laasot kechol-hattora asher tzivvecha moshe avdi al-tasur mimmennu yamin usemovl lemaan taskil bechol asher telech
Lo-yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha vehagita bo yomam valayla lemaan tishmor laasot kechol-hakkatuv bo ki-az tatzliach et-derachecha veaz taskil
Halo tzivviticha chazak veematz al-taarotz veal-techat ki immecha Adonai elohecha bechol asher telech {p}

Ivru ׀ bekerev hammachane vetzauu et-haam lemor hachinu lachem tzeda ki beod ׀ sheloshet yamim attem ovrim et-hayyarden hazze lavo lareshet et-haaretz asher Adonai elohechem noten lachem lerishtah {p}
Mishnah Chullin 1:1: Hakkol shochatin ushechitatan keshera, chutz mecheresh, shote, vekatan, shemma yekalkelu vishchitatan. vechullan sheshshachatu vaacherim roin otan, shechitatan keshera. shechitat nachri, nevela, umetammea vemassa. hashshochet ballayla, vechen hassuma sheshshachat, shechitato cheshera. hashshochet beshabbat, uveyom hakkippurim, af al pi shemmitchayyev benafsho, shechitato cheshera:
Mishnah Menachot 11:1-5:
Shete hallechem nilloshot achat achat, veneefot achat achat. lechem happanim nillosh echad echad, veneefe shenayim shenayim. uvitfus haya ose otan. ucheshehu radan, notnan bitfus, kede shello yitkalkelu: 
Echad shete hallechem veechad lechem happanim, lishatan vaarichatan bachutz, vaafiyyatan bifnim, veenan dochot et hashshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer, kol maasehem bifnim. rabbi shimon omer, leolam heve ragil lomar, shete hallechem velechem happanim kesherot baazara, uchesherot bevet pagi: 
Chavitte chohen gadol, lishatan vaarichatan vaafiyyatan bifnim, vedochot et hashshabbat. tichunan veherkedan enan dochot et hashshabbat. kelal amar rabbi akiva, kol melacha sheefshar lah leasot meerev shabbat, ena docha et hashshabbat. veshei efshar lah leasot meerev shabbat, docha et hashshabbat: 
Kol hammenachot yesh bahen maase cheli bifnim, veen bahen maase cheli vachutz. ketzad. shete hallechem arkan shiva verachban arbaa, vekarnotehen arba etzbaot. lechem happanim, arkan asara verachban chamishsha, vekarnotav sheva etzbaot. rabbi yehuda omer, shello tite, 15 22. ben zoma omer, venatatta al hashshulchan lechem panim lefanay tamid, sheyyehe lo fanim: 
Hashshulchan, arko asara, verachbo chamishsha. lechem happanim, arkan asara verachban chamishsha. noten arko keneged rachbo shel shulchan, vechofel tefachayim umechetza mikkan utefachayim umechetza mikkan, nimtza arko memalle kol rachbo shel shulchan, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, hashshulchan arko shenem asar verachbo shishsha. lechem happanim arko asara verachbo chamishsha. noten arko keneged rachbo shel shulchan, vechofel tefachayim mikkan utefachayim mikkan utefachayim revach baemtza, kede shettehe haruach menashshevet benehen. abba shaul omer, sham hayu notnin shene veziche levona shel lechem happanim. amru lo, vahalo chevar neemar (Vayikra kad), venatatta al hammaarechet levona zakka. amar lahen, vahalo chevar neemar (Bamidbar b), vealav matte menashshe:
Mishnah Menachot 11:6-9:
Arbaa senifin shel zahav hayu sham, muftzalin merashehen, shehayu somchim bahen, shenayim leseder ze ushenayim leseder ze. veesrim ushemona kanim, kachatzi kane chalul, arbaa asar leseder ze vearbaa asar leseder ze. lo siddur kanim velo netilatan doche et hashshabbat, ella nichnas meerev shabbat veshomtan venotnan learko shel shulchan. kol hakkelim shehayu vammikdash, arkan learko shel bayit: 
Shene shulchanot hayu vaulam mibbifnim al petach habbayit, echad shel shayish veechad shel zahav. al shel shayish notnim lechem happanim bichnisato, veal shel zahav bitziato, shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. veechad shel zahav mibbifnim, shealav lechem happanim tamid. arbaa chohanim nichnasin, shenayim beyadam shene sedarim, ushenayim beyadam shene vezichim. vearbaa makdimin lifnehem, shenayim littol shene sedarim, ushenayim littol shene vezichim. hammachnisim omdim batztzafon, ufenehem laddarom. hammotziin omdim baddarom, ufenehem latztzafon. ellu moshchin veellu mannichin, vetifcho shel ze cheneged tifcho shel ze, shenneemar (Shemot 25), lefanay tamid. rabbi yose omer, afillu ellu notlin veellu mannichin, af zo hayta tamid. yatzu venatnu al hashshulchan shel zahav shehaya vaulam. hiktiru habbezichin, vehachallot mitchallekot lakkohanim. chal yom hakkippurim lihyot beshabbat, hachallot mitchallekot laarev. chal lihyot erev shabbat, sair shel yom hakkippurim neechol laarev, habbavliyyim ochlin oto keshehu chay, mippene sheddatan yafa: 
Sidder et hallechem beshabbat veet habbezichim leachar shabbat vehiktir et habbezichim beshabbat, pesula, veen chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame. sidder et hallechem veet habbezichin beshabbat vehiktir et habbezichin leachar shabbat, pasul, veen chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul venotar vetame. sidder et hallechem veet habbezichin leachar shabbat vehiktir et habbezichin beshabbat, pasul. ketzad yaase. yannichenna lashshabbat habbaa, sheafillu hi al hashshulchan yamim rabbim, en bechach kelum: 
Shete hallechem neechalot en pachot mishshenayim, velo yater al shelosha. ketzad. neefot meerev yom tov veneechalot beyom tov, lishnayim. chal yom tov lihyot achar hashshabbat, neechalot lishlosha. lechem happanim neechol en pachot mittisha, velo yater al achad asar. ketzad. neefe veerev shabbat veneechol beshabbat, letisha. chal yom tov lihyot erev shabbat, neechol laasara. shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana, neechol leachad asar. veeno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon ben hassegan, doche et yom tov veeno doche et yom tzom:
Mishnah Menachot 12:1-4:
Hammenachot vehannesachim shennitmeu ad shello kiddeshan bakkeli, yesh lahen pidyon. mishshekkadshu vakkeli, en lahem pidyon. haofot vehaetzim vehallevona uchele sharet, en lahem pidyon, shello neemar ella behema: 
Haomer, hare alay bemachavat, vehevi vemarcheshet, bemarcheshet vehevi vemachavat, ma shehevi hevi, vide chovato lo yatza. zo lehavi vemachavat, vehevi vemarcheshet, bemarcheshet, vehevi vemachavat, hare zo fesula. hare alay shene esronim lehavi vichli echad, vehevi vishne chelim, bishne chelim, vehevi vichli echad, ma shehevi hevi, vide chovato lo yatza. ellu lehavi vichli echad, vehevi vishne chelim, bishne chelim vehevi vichli echad, hare ellu fesulin. hare alay shene esronim lehavi vichli echad vehevi vishne chelim, amru lo bichli echad nadarta, hikrivan bichli echad, kesherim, uvishne chelim, pesulin. hare alay shene esronim lehavi vishne chelim, vehevi vichli echad, amru lo, bishne chelim nadarta, hikrivan bishne chelim, kesherim. netano vichli echad, kishte menachot shennitaravu: 
Hare alay mincha min hasseorin, yavi min hachittim. kemach, yavi solet. belo shemen ulevona, yavi immah shemen ulevona. chatzi issaron, yavi issaron shalem. issaron umechetza, yavi shenayim. rabbi shimon poter, shello hitnaddev kederech hammitnaddevim: 
Mitnaddev adam mincha shel shishshim issaron, umevi vichli echad. im amar hare alay shishshim veechad, mevi shishshim bichli echad veechad bichli echad, shekken tzibbur mevi veyom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat shishshim veechad. dayyo layyachid sheyyehe fachot min hatztzibbur echad. amar rabbi shimon, vahalo ellu lapparim, veellu lakkevasim, veenam nivlalim ze im ze. ella, ad shishshim yecholim lehibbalel. amru lo, shishshim nivlalim, shishshim veechad en nivlalim. amar lahen, kol middot chachamim ken. bearbaim sea hu tovel, bearbaim sea chaser kurtov eno yachol litbol bahen. en mitnaddevim log, shenayim, vachamishsha, aval mitnaddevim shelosha vearbaa veshishsha, umishshishsha ulemala:
Mishnah Menachot 12:5-13:4:
Mitnaddevim yayin, veen mitnaddevim shemen, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi tarfon omer, mitnaddevim shamen. amar rabbi tarfon, ma matzinu vayyayin shebba chova uva nedava, af hashshemen ba chova uva nedava. amar lo rabbi akiva, lo, im amarta vayyayin shekken hu karev chovato vifne atzmo, tomar bashshemen sheeno karev chovato vifne atzmo. en shenayim mitnaddevim issaron echad, aval mitnaddevim ola ushelamim. uvaof, afillu ferida echat: 
Hare alay issaron, yavi echad. esronim, yavi shenayim. perashti veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi shishshim issaron. hare alay mincha, yavi ezo sheyyirtze. rabbi yehuda omer, yavi minchat hassolet, shehi meyuchedet shebbammenachot: 
Mincha, min hammincha, yavi echat. menachot, min hammenachot, yavi shetayim. perashti veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi chamishtan. perashti mincha shel esronim veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi mincha shel shishshim issaron. rabbi omer, yavi menachot shel esronim meechad vead shishshim: 
Hare alay etzim, lo yifchot mishshene gezirin. levona, lo yifchot mikkometz. chamishsha komatzim hen, haomer hare alay levona, lo yifchot mikkometz. hammitnaddev mincha, yavi immah kometz levona. hammaale et hakkometz bachutz, chayyav. ushene vezichin teunin shene komatzim: 
Hare alay zahav, lo yifchot middinar zahav. kesef, lo yifchot middinar kasef. nechoshet, lo yifchot mimmaa chasef. perashti veeni yodea ma perashti, hu mevi ad sheyyomar lo lechach nitkavvanti:
Mishnah Menachot 13:5-8:
Hare alay yayin, lo yifchot mishshelosha luggin. shemen, lo yifchot millog. rabbi omer, shelosha luggin. perashti veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi chayyom hammerubbe: 
Hare alay ola, yavi cheves. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, o tor o ven yona. perashti min habbakar veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi far vaegel. min habbehema veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi far vaegel ayil gedi vetale. perashti veeni yodea ma perashti, mosif alehem tor uven yona: 
Hare alay toda, ushelamim, yavi cheves. perashti min habbakar veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi far ufara egel veegla. min habbehema veeni yodea ma perashti, yavi far ufara, egel veegla, ayil verachel, gedi ugediyya, sair useira, tale vetalya: 
Hare alay shor, yavi hu unesachav bemane. egel, yavi hu unesachav bechamesh. ayil, yavi hu unesachav bishtayim. keves, yavi hu unesachav besala. shor bemane, yavi vemane chutz minnesachav. egel bechamesh, yavi vechamesh chutz minnesachav. ayil bishtayim, yavi vishtayim chutz minnesachav. keves besela, yavi vesela chutz minnesachav. shor bemane vehevi shenayim bemane, lo yatza, afillu ze vemane chaser dinar veze vemane chaser dinar. shachor vehevi lavan, lavan vehevi shachor, gadol vehevi katan, lo yatza. katan vehevi gadol, yatza. rabbi omer, lo yatza:
Mishnah Menachot 13:9-11:
Shor ze ola, venistaev, im ratza, yavi vedamav shenayim. shene shevarim ellu ola, venistaavu, im ratza, yavi vidmehem echad. rabbi oser. ayil ze ola, venistaev, im ratza, yavi vedamav keves. keves ze ola venistaev, im ratza, yavi vedamav ayil. rabbi oser. haomer achad mikkevasay hekdesh, veachad mishshevaray hekdesh, hayu lo shenayim, haggadol shebbahen hekdesh. shelosha, habbenoni shebbahen hekdesh. perashti veeni yodea ma perashti, o sheamar, amar li abba veeni yodea ma, haggadol shebbahen hekdesh: 
Hare alay ola, yakrivenna vammikdash. veim hikrivah bevet chonyo, lo yatza. sheakrivenna bevet chonyo, yakrivenna bammikdash. veim hikrivah bevet chonyo, yatza. rabbi shimon omer, en zo ola. hareni nazir, yegallach bammikdash. veim gillach bevet chonyo, lo yatza. sheagallach bevet chonyo, yegallach bammikdash. veim gillach bevet chonyo, yatza. rabbi shimon omer, en ze nazir. hakkohanim sheshshimmeshu bevet chonyo, lo yeshammeshu vammikdash birushalayim, veen tzarich lomar ledavar acher, shenneemar (Melachim b 23), ach lo yaalu kohane habbamot el mizbach Adonai birushalayim chi im achlu matztzot betoch achehem, hare hem kevaale mumin, cholkin veochlin, aval lo makrivin: 
Neemar beolat habbehema ishshe reach nichoach (Vayikra 1), uveolat haof ishshe reach nichoach (sham), uvammincha ishshe reach nichoach (sham b), lelammed, sheechad hammarbe veechad hammamit, uvilvad sheyyechavven adam et dato lashshamayim:
Mishnah Oktzin 1:3-6:
Ellu mittammein umetammein velo mitztarfin. sharshe hashshum vehabbetzalim vehakkaflotot bizman shehem yeveshim, vehaammud sheeno mechuvvan keneged haochel, veyad happarkil tefach mikkan vetefach mikkan, yad haeshkol kol shehu, vezanav shel eshkol sherikkeno, veyad hammachbed shel temara arbaa tefachim, vekane shel shibbolet shelosha tefachim, veyad kol hanniktzarim shelosha, vesheen darkan likkatzer yedehem vesharshehem kol shehen, umalin shel shibbolin, hare ellu mittammeim umetammein velo mitztarfin: 
Ellu lo mittammein velo metammein velo mitztarfin. sharshe kolse hakkeruv, vechulfot teradim, vehallefet, et sheddarkam liggazez veneekru. rabbi yose metamme vechullan umetaher besharshe kolse hakkeruv vehallafet: 
Kol yedot hoochalin shebbesasan baggoren, tehorim. rabbi yose metamme. pesiga shel eshkol sherikkenah, tehora. shiyyer bah gargir echad, temea. sharvit shel temara sherikkeno, tahor. shiyyer bo temara achat, tame. vechen bakkitniyyot, sharvit sherikkeno, tahor. shiyyer bo gargir echad, tame. rabbi elazar ben azarya metaher beshel pol umetamme beshel kitniyyot, mippene shehu rotze bemishmushan: 
Okatze teenim ugerogarot vehakkelusim vehecharuvim, hare ellu mittammein umetammein umitztarfin. rabbi yose omer, af oketz delaat. okatze haaggasin vehakkerustemelin vehapperishin vehauzradin, oketz delaat tefach, oketz kuneras tefach, rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer, tefachayim, hare ellu mittammein umetammein velo mitztarfim. ushear kol hookatzim, lo mittammein velo metammein:
Mishnah Oktzin 2:1-4:
Zetim shekkevashan betarfehen, tehorim, lefi shello chevashan ella lemare. keshut shel kishshut vehannetz shellah, tehora. rabbi yehuda omer, kol zeman shehi lifne hattaggar, temea: 
Kol haggalinin mittammeot umetammeot velo mitztarfot. galina shel rotev, af al pi yotza, mitztarefet. shel yevesha, enah mitztarefet. lefichach, chotal shel yevesha, mitztaref. veshel rotev, eno mitztaref. galina shemmiktzatah yotza, shekkeneged haochel, mitztaref. etzem sheyyesh alav basar, shekkeneged haochel, mitztaref. haya alav mitztzad echad, rabbi yishmael omer, roin oto keillu hu makkifo vetabbaat. vachachamim omrim, shekkeneged haochel, mitztaref, kegon hassia vehaezov vehakkoranit: 
Harimmon vehaavattiach shennimmok miktzato, eno mitztaref. shalem mikkan umikkan venimmok min haemtza, eno mitztaref. happitma shel rimmon, mitztarefet. vehannetz shello eno mitztaref. rabbi eliezer omer, af hammasrek tahor: 
Kol hakkelippin mittammeot umetammeot umitztarfot. rabbi yehuda omer, shelosha kelippin babbatzal. happenimit, ben shelema ben kedura, mitztarefet. haemtzait, shelema mitztarefet, ukedura enah mitztarefet. vehachitzona, ben kach uven kach, tehora:
Mishnah Oktzin 2:10-3:3:
Kele gelalim uchele adama, shehashsharashim yecholin latzet bahen, enam machshirim et hazzeraim. atzitz nakuv eno machshir et hazzeraim. vesheeno nakuv, machshir et hazzeraim. kamma hu shiuro shel nekev, kede sheyyetze vo shoresh katan. milahu afar ad sefato, hare hu chetavla sheen lah lizbez: 
Yesh tzerichin hechsher veenan tzerichim machashava, machashava vehechsher, machashava velo hechsher, lo hechsher velo machashava. kol hoochalim hameyuchadim laadam tzerichin hechsher veenan tzerichim machashava: 
Hachotech min haadam, umin habbehema, umin hachayya, umin haofot, minnivlat haof hattame, vehachelev bakkefarim, ushear kol yarkot sade chutz mishshemarkaim ufitriyyot. rabbi yehuda omer, chutz mikkereshe sade vehargila venetz hechalav. rabbi shimon omer, chutz min haakkaviyyot. rabbi yose omer, chutz min hakkelusin, hare ellu tzerichin machashava vehechsher: 
Nivlat behema temea bechol makom venivlat haof hattahor bakkefarim, tzerichin machashava veenan tzerichin hechsher. nivlat behema tehora bechol makom, venivlat haof hattahor vehachelev bashshevakim, enan tzerichin machashava velo hechsher. rabbi shimon omer, af haggamal vehaarnevet vehashshafan vehachazir:
Mishnah Oktzin 2:5-9:
Hamechattech levashshel, af al pi shello merak, eno chibbur. lichbosh velishlok ulehanniach al hashshulchan, chibbur. hitchil lefarek, ochel shehitchil bo, eno chibbur. haegozim sheamanan, vehabbetzalim shechamaran, hare ellu chibbur. hitchil lefarek baegozim ulefakkel babbetzalim, eno chibbur. haegozim vehashshekedim, chibbur, ad sheyyerasses: 
Betza megulgelet, ad sheyyagos. usheluka, ad sheyyerasses. etzem sheyyesh bo moach, chibbur, ad sheyyerasses. harimmon shepperado, chibbur ad sheyyakkish alav bekane. kayyotze vo, shelal hakkovsin vehabbeged shehu tafur bechilayim, chibbur, ad sheyyatchil lehattir: 
Ale yerakot yerukkim, mitztarfin. ulevanim, enan mitztarfin. rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer, hallevanim mitztarfim bakkeruv, mippene shehen ochel. uvachazarim, mippene shehen meshammerin et haochel: 
Ale vetzalim uvene vetzalim, im yesh bahen rir, mishtaarin bichmot shehen. im yesh bahen chalal, memaech et chalalan. pat sefoganit, mishtaeret bichmot shehi. im yesh bah chalal, memaech et chalalah. besar haegel shennitpach uvesar zekena shennitmaet, mishtaarin bichmot shehen: 
Kishshut shennetaah beatzitz vehigdila veyatza chutz leatzitz, tehora. amar rabbi shimon, ma tivah littaher. ella hattame betumato, vehattahor yeachel:
Mishnah Oktzin 3:4-7:
Hashshevet, mishshennatan tamo bakkedera, en bo mishshum teruma, veeno mittamme tumat ochalim. luleve zeradim veshel adal vaale halluf hashshote, enan mittammein tumat ochalim ad sheyyimtoku. rabbi shimon omer, af shel pakkuot kayyotze vahem: 
Hakkosht, vehachemes, verashe vesamim, hattia, vehachiltit, vehappilpelin, vechallot charia, nilkachim bechesef maaser veenan mittammein tumat ochalin, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri, im nilkachim bechesef maaser, mippene ma enan mittammein tumat ochalin. veim enan mittammein tumat ochalim, af hem lo yillakchu vechesef maaser: 
Happaggin vehabboser, rabbi akiva metamme tumat ochalin. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, mishsheyyavou leonat hammaasrot. peritze zetim vaanavim, bet shammay metammein uvet hillel metaharin. hakketzach, bet shammay metaharin, uvet hillel metammein. vechen lammaasrot: 
Hakkor, hare hu cheetz lechol davar, ella shehu nilkach bechesef maaser. kafniyyot, ochalin, ufeturot min hammaasrot:
Mishnah Oktzin 3:8-12:
Dagim meematay mekabbelin tuma, bet shammay omrim, mishsheyyitztzodu. uvet hillel omrim, mishsheyyamutu. rabbi akiva omer, im yecholin lichyot. yichur shel teena shennifshach umeore vakkelippa, rabbi yehuda metaher. vachachamim omrim, im yachol lichyot. tevua shenneekra umeora afillu veshoresh katan, tehora: 
Chelev behema tehora, eno mittamme tumat nevelot, lefichach hu tzarich hechsher. chelev behema temea, mittamme tumat nevelot, lefichach eno tzarich hechsher. dagim temeim vachagavim temeim, tzerichin machashava bakkefarim: 
Kavveret devorim, rabbi eliezer omer, hare hi chekarka, vechotvin aleha perozbul, veenah mekabbelet tuma vimkomah, veharode mimmenna beshabbat chayyav chattat. vachachamim omrim, enah kekarka, veen kotvim aleha perozbul, umekabbelet tuma vimkomah, veharode mimmenna beshabbat patur: 
Challot devash, meematay mittammeot mishshum mashke. bet shammay omrim, mishsheyyecharcher. bet hillel omrim, mishsheyyerassek: 
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehanechil lechol tzaddik vetzaddik shelosh meot vaasara olamot, shenneemar (Mishlei 8), lehanechil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle. amar rabbi shimon ben chalafta, lo matza hakkadosh baruch hu keli machazik beracha leyisrael ella hashshalom, shenneemar (tehillim 29), Adonai oz leammo yitten Adonai yevarech et ammo vashshalom:
Mishnah Yevamot 4:12-5:2:
Hammachazir gerushato, vehannose chalutzato, vehannose kerovat chalutzato, yotzi, vehavvalad mamzer, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, en havvalad mamzer. umodim benose kerovat gerushato, shehavvalad mamzer: 
Ezehu mamzer, kol sheer basar shehu velo yavo divre rabbi akiva. shimon hattimni omer, kol shechayyavin alav karet bide shamayim. vahalacha chidvarav. rabbi yehoshua omer, kol shechayyavim alav mitat bet din. amar rabbi shimon ben azzay, matzati megillat yuchasin birushalayim vechatuv bah, ish peloni mamzer meeshet ish, lekayyem divre rabbi yehoshua. ishto shemmeta, muttar baachotah. gershah vameta, muttar baachotah. nisset leacher vameta, muttar baachotah. yevimto shemmeta, muttar baachotah. chalatz lah vameta, muttar baachotah: 
Rabban gamliel omer, en get achar get, velo maamar achar maamar, velo veila achar beila, velo chalitza achar chalitza. vachachamim omrim, yesh get achar get, veyesh maamar achar maamar, aval lo achar beila velo achar chalitza kelum: 
Ketzad. asa maamar bivimto, venatan lah get, tzericha hemennu chalitza. asa maamar vachalitza, tzericha hemennu get. asa maamar uvaal, hare zo chemitzvatah:
Mishnah Yevamot 5:3-6:1:
Natan get veasa maamar, tzericha get vachalitza. natan get uvaal, tzericha get vachalitza. natan get vechalatz, en achar chalitza chelum. chalatz veasa maamar, natan get, uvaal, o vaal veasa maamar, natan get vechalatz, en achar chalitza chelum. achat yevama achat leyavam echad, veachat shete yevamot leyavam echad: 
Ketzad. asa maamar bazo umaamar bazo, tzerichot shene gittin vachalitza. maamar bazo veget bazo, tzericha get vachalitza. maamar bazo uvaal et zo, tzerichot shene gittin vachalitza. maamar bazo vechalatz lazo, harishona tzericha get. get lazo veget lazo, tzerichot hemennu chalitza. get lazo uvaal et zo, tzericha get vachalitza. get lazo umaamar bazo, tzericha get vachalitza. get lazo vechalatz lazo, en achar chalitza kelum: 
Chalatz vechalatz, o chalatz veasa maamar, natan get uvaal, o vaal uvaal, o vaal veasa maamar, natan get vechalatz, en achar chalitza chelum, ben yavam echad lishte yevamot, ben shene yevamin livama echat: 
Chalatz veasa maamar, natan get uvaal, o vaal veasa maamar, venatan get vechalatz, en achar chalitza chelum, ben battechilla, ben baemtza, ben bassof. vehabbeila, bizman shehi vattechilla, en achareha chelum. baemtza uvassof, yesh achareha chelum. rabbi nechemya omer, achat beila veachat chalitza, ben battechilla, ben baemtza, ben bassof, en achareha chelum: 
Habba al yevimto, ben beshogeg, ben bemezid, ben beones, ben beratzon, afillu hu shogeg vehi mezida, hu mezid vehi shogeget, hu anus vehi lo anusa, hi anusa vehu lo anus, echad hameare veechad haggomer, kana, velo chalak ben bia levia:
Mishnah Yevamot 6:2-5:
Vechen habba al achat mikkol haarayot shebbattora, o fesulot, kegon almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin, pasal. velo chalak ben bia levia: 
Almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, min haerusin lo yochlu vatteruma. rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon machshirin. nitarmelu o nitgarshu, min hannissuin pesulot, min haerusin kesherot: 
Kohen gadol lo yissa almana, ben almana min haerusin, ben almana min hannissuin, velo yissa et habbogeret. rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon machshirin bevogeret. lo yissa et mukkat etz. eres et haalmana, venitmanna lihyot kohen gadol, yichnos. umaase vihoshua ben gamla shekkiddesh et marta vat baytos, uminnahu hammelech lihyot kohen gadol, uchenasah. shomeret yavam shennafla lifne chohen hedyot, venitmanna lihyot kohen gadol, af al pi sheasa vah maamar, hare ze lo yichnos. kohen gadol shemmet achiv, choletz velo meyabbem: 
Kohen hedyot lo yissa aylonit, ella im ken yesh lo ishsha uvanim. rabbi yehuda omer, af al pi sheyyesh lo ishsha uvanim, lo yissa aylonit, shehi zona haamura vattora. vachachamim omrim, en zona ella giyyoret umeshuchreret veshennivala veilat zenut:
Mishnah Yevamot 6:6-7:3:
Lo yibbatel adam mipperiyya ureviyya, ella im ken yesh lo vanim. bet shammay omrim, shene zecharim. uvet hillel omrim, zachar unekeva, shenneemar, (Bereshit 5) zachar unekeva beraam. nasa ishsha, veshaha immah eser shanim, velo yalda, eno rashshay libbatel. gershah, mutteret linnase leacher. verashshay hashsheni lishhot immah eser shanim. veim hippila, mone mishshaa shehippila. haish metzuvve al periyya ureviyya, aval lo haishsha. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, al shenehem hu omer (Bereshit 1), vayvarech otam elohim vayyomer lahem elohim peru urevu: 
Almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, hichnisa lo avde melog veavde tzon barzel, avde melog lo yochlu vatteruma, avde tzon barzel yochelu. veellu hen avde melog, im metu, metu lah, veim hotiru, hotiru lah. af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotan, hare ellu lo yochlu vatteruma. veellu hen avde tzon barzel, im metu, metu lo, veim hotiru, hotiru lo. hoil vehu chayyav beacharayutan, hare ellu yochlu vatteruma: 
Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen vehichnisa lo avadim, ben avde melog, ben avde tzon barzel, hare ellu yochlu vatteruma. uvat kohen shennisset leyisrael, vehichnisa lo, ben avde melog, ben avde tzon barzel, hare ellu lo yochlu vatteruma: 
Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen, umet, vehinnichah meubberet, lo yochlu avadeha batteruma, mippene chelko shel ubbar, shehaubbar posel veeno maachil, divre rabbi yose. amru lo, meachar sheheadta lanu al bat yisrael lechohen, af bat kohen lechohen, umet, vehinnichah meubberet, lo yochlu avadeha vatteruma, mippene chelko shel ubbar:
Mishnah Yevamot 7:4-8:2:
Haubbar, vehayyavam, vehaerusin, vehacheresh, uven tesha shanim veyom echad, poslin velo maachilin. safek shehu ven tesha shanim veyom echad safek sheeno, safek hevi shete searot safek shello hevi, nafal habbayit alav veal bat achiv veen yadua e ze met rishon, tzaratah choletzet velo mityabbemet: 
Haones, vehamefatte, vehashshote, lo foslim velo maachilim. veim enam reuyin lavo veyisrael, hare ellu foslin. ketzad, yisrael shebba al bat kohen, tochal batteruma. ibbera, lo tochal batteruma. nechtach haubbar bemeeha, tochal. kohen shebba al bat yisrael, lo tochal batteruma. ibbera, lo tochal. yalda, tochal. nimtza kocho shel ben gadol mishshel av. haeved posel mishshum bia, veeno fosel mishshum zara. ketzad, bat yisrael lechohen, bat kohen leyisrael, veyalda hemennu ven, vehalach habben venichbash al hashshifcha, veyalda hemennu ven, hare ze eved. hayta em aviv bat yisrael lechohen lo tochal batteruma. bat kohen leyisrael, tochal batteruma. mamzer posel umaachil. ketzad, bat yisrael lechohen, uvat kohen leyisrael, veyalda hemennu vat, vehalcha habbat venisset leeved, o legoy, veyalda hemennu ven, hare ze mamzer. hayta em immo vat yisrael lechohen, tochal batteruma. bat kohen leyisrael, lo tochal batteruma: 
Kohen gadol peamim shehu fosel. ketzad, bat kohen leyisrael, veyalda hemennu vat, vehalcha habbat venisset lechohen, veyalda hemennu ven, hare ze rauy lihyot kohen gadol omed umeshammesh al gabbe hammizbeach, maachil et immo ufosel et em immo, vezot omeret, lo chivni kohen gadol, shehu posleni min hatteruma: 
Hearel vechol hattemeim, lo yochlu vatteruma. neshehen veavdehen, yochlu vatteruma. petzua dakka ucherut shafcha, hen veavdehen yochlu, uneshehen lo yochelu. veim lo yedaah mishshennaasa fetzua dakka ucherut shafcha, hare ellu yochelu: 
Ezehu fetzua dakka, kol shenniftzeu habbetzim shello, vaafillu achat mehen. ucherut shafcha, kol shennichrat haggid. veim nishtayyer mehaatara afillu kechut hassaara, kasher. petzua dakka ucherut shafcha, muttarin begiyyoret umeshuchreret, veenan asurin ella millavo vakkahal, shenneemar (Devarim 23), lo yavo fetzua dakka ucherut shafcha bikhal Adonai:
Mishnah Yevamot 8:3-6:
Ammoni umoavi, asurim, veissuran issur olam, aval nekevotehem muttarot miyyad. mitzri vaadomi enam asurim ella ad shelosha dorot, echad zecharim veechad nekevot. rabbi shimon mattir et hannekevot miyyad. amar rabbi shimon, kal vachomer haddevarim, uma im bimkom sheasar et hazzecharim issur olam, hittir et hannekevot miyyad, mekom shello asar et hazzecharim ella ad shelosha dorot, eno din shennattir et hannekevot miyyad. amru lo, im halacha nekabbel, veim laddin, yesh teshuva. amar lahem, lo chi, halacha ani omer. mamzerin unetinin, asurin, veissuran issur olam, echad zecharim, veechad nekevot: 
Amar rabbi yehoshua, shamati shehassaris choletz, vecholtzin leishto, vehassaris lo choletz velo choltzin leishto, veen li lefaresh. amar rabbi akiva, ani afaresh. seris adam choletz vecholtzin leishto, mippene shehayta lo sheat hakkosher. seris chamma lo choletz velo choltzin leishto, mippene shello hayta lo sheat hakkosher. rabbi elazar omer, lo chi, ella seris chamma choletz, vecholtzin leishto, mippene sheyyesh lo refua. seris adam lo choletz velo choltzin leishto, mippene sheen lo refua. heid rabbi yehoshua ben betera al ben megusat shehaya virushalayim seris adam, veyibbemu et ishto, lekayyem divre rabbi akiva: 
Hassaris lo choletz velo meyabbem. vechen aylonit lo choletzet velo mityabbemet. hassaris shechalatz livimto, lo fesalah. bealah, pesalah, mippene shehi veilat zenut. vechen aylonit shechaltzu lah achin, lo fesaluha. bealuha, pesaluha, mippene shebbeilatah beilat zenut: 
Seris chamma kohen shennasa vat yisrael, maachilah batteruma. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim, anderoginos kohen shennasa vat yisrael, maachilah batteruma. rabbi yehuda omer, tumtum shennikra venimtza zachar, lo yachalotz, mippene shehu chesaris. anderoginos nose, aval lo nissa. rabbi eliezer omer, anderoginos chayyavim alav sekila, kezachar:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 7:11-13: Gamru milleechol mesallekin et hashshulchan umechabbedin et hammakom sheachlu bo veachar kach notlin et yedehem. shemma yeshayyeru sham perurin sheyyesh bahen kezayit sheasur lehallech bahen velirchotz alehen. aval perurin sheen bahen kezayit muttar leabbedan bayyad:

Heviu lahem mayim lintila kol shemmevarech birkat hammazon hu notel yadav techilla. kede shello yeshev haggadol veyadav mezohamot ad sheyyittol acher. ushear hassoadin notlin yadan bassof ze achar ze. veen mechabbedin bedavar ze sheen mechabbedin beyadayim mezohamot velo bigsharim velo bidrachim ella befetach harauy limzuza uvishat kenisa:
Gamru littol yedehen veniggevu yedehen uverchu birkat hammazon veheviu et hammugmar. mi shebberech birkat hammazon hu mevarech al hammugmar vechullan onin amen:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 7:14-15: Im haya sham yayin meviin kos machazik reviit o yater al reviit. umeviin besamim veochez et hayyayin bimino veet habbesamim bismolo umevarech birkat hammazon. veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin. veachar kach mevarech al habbesamim. im hayu habbesamim shemen arev vechayyotze bo tacho berosh hashshammash. veim haya hashshammash talmid chacham tacho bakkotel kede shello yetze mevussam lashshuk:

Af al pi sheen birkat hammazon tzericha yayin. im berech al hayyayin kamminhag sheamarnu tzarich sheyyadiach kos shel beracha mibbifnim velishtof oto mibbachutz. vimalleennu yayin chay. vechevan shehiggia levirkat haaretz noten letocho meat mayim kede sheyyehe arev lishtiyya. veen mesichin al kos shel birkat hammazon ella hakkol shotkim ad shettichle birkat hammazon uvirkat hayyayin veyishtu:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 7:5-6: Habbotzea noten perusa lifne kol echad veechad. vehaacher notel beyado. veen habbotzea noten beyad haochel ella im ken haya avel. vehabbotzea hu poshet yadav techilla veochel. veen hammesubbin rashshain litom ad sheyyitom hamevarech. veen habbotzea rashshay litom ad sheyyichle amen mippi rov hammesubbin. veim ratza habbotzea lachalok kavod lerabbo o lemi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma veyannichennu lifshot yado kodem lo harshut beyado:

Shenayim mamtinin ze laze bikara. shelosha en mamtinin. gamru mehen shenayim hashshelishi mafsik immahen. gamar echad mehen hashshenayim en mafsikin lo ella ochlin veholchin ad sheggomrin. en mesichin bisudda kede shello yavo lide sakkana. umippene ze im ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. sheim berech echad veone haone amen bishat habbelia yavo lide sakkana. veen mistakkelin bifne haochel velo limnato shello levayyesho:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 7:7-8: Hashshammash sheomed lifne hammesubbin eno ochel immahen. vederech rachamanut hu litten letoch piv mikkol tavshil vetavshil kede leyashshev dato. veim natnu lo yayin mevarech al kol kos vechos shennotnin lo. mippene sheen shetiyyato teluya birtzono ella birtzonam:

Yatza echad min hammesubbin lehashetin mayim notel yado achat venichnas. dibber im chavero vehiflig notel shete yadav venichnas. im hayu mesubbin lishtiyya nichnas veyoshev bimkomo venotel yadav veachar kach machazir panav laorchin. velamma notel bimkomo shemma yomru lo natal yadav mippene sheen sham achila:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 7:9-10: En mannichin basar chay al happat. veen maavirin kos male al happat. veen somchin et hakkeara befat. veen zorkin et happat. velo et hachatichot velo et hoochalin sheen lahen kelippin kegon tutim vaanavim uteenim mippene shehen nimasin. umuttar limshoch et hayyayin betzinnorot bevatte chatanim vezorkin lifnehem kelayot veegozim bimot hachamma aval lo bimot haggeshamim mippene shennimasin. veen notlin yedehen beyayin ben chay ben mazug. vechen en mafsidin shear ochalin umashkin derech bizzuy uveita:

Asur leorchim littol kelum mimma shellifnehem velitten beyad beno o bitto shel baal habbayit shemma yitbayyesh baal hasseudda shehare en lo ella ma shehevi lifnehem venimtzeu hakketannim notlim otam veholchim. lo yishlach adam lachavero chavit yayin veshemen tzaf al piha shemma yishlach lo adam chavit shekkullah yayin vidamme shehu shemen veshemen hu sheal paneha bilvad vizammen orchim veyitbayyesh. vechen kol kayyotze bidvarim ellu hammeviim lide busha levaal hasseudda asurin:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10:22-25:
Hameshalleach kelavim kede sheyyatzudu tzevaim vearnavim vechayyotze bahen uvarach hatztzevi mippene hakkelev vehaya hu rodef achar hatztzevi o sheamad befanav vehivhilo ad shehiggia hakkelev utefaso hare ze toledet hatztzad vechayyav. vechen haose kadderech hazzo beofot: 
Tzevi shennichnas levayit venaal echad befanav chayyav. nealuhu shenayim peturin. im en echad yachol linol unealuhu shenayim chayyavin. yashav echad al happetach velo milleahu veyashav hashsheni umilleahu hashsheni chayyav. yashav harishon umilleahu uva hashsheni veyashav betziddo af al pi sheamad harishon vehalach lo harishon chayyav vehashsheni lo asa kelum umuttar lo leshev bimkomo ad haerev velokeach hatztzevi. lema ze dome lenoel beto leshamro venimtza tzevi shamur betocho shello asa kelum. nichnesa lo tzippor tachat kenafav yoshev umeshammerah ad shettechshach umuttar: 
Hatztzad tzevi zaken o chigger o chole o katan patur. hamefarek behema chayya vaof min hammetzuda patur. hatztzad chayya vaof shebbirshuto kegon avazin vetarnegolin veyone (aliyya) patur. hatztzad davar sheen bemino tzida kegon chagavim haggazin tzerain veyattushin ufaroshin vechayyotze baellu hare ze patur: 
Remasim hammazzikin kegon nechashim veakrabbim vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheenan memitin hoil venoshchin muttar latzud otam beshabbat. vehu sheyyitkavven lehinnatzel minneshichatan. ketzad hu ose. kofe keli alehen o makkif alehen o koshran kede shello yazziku:
Moed Katan 12b:12-17: Rabbi yehuda nesia nefak bechumarta dimdusha, veishti mayya deachem kappila arammaa. shema rabbi amme, ikkefad. amar rav yosef: may tama ikkefad? i mishshum chumarta dimdusha, ha tanya: hashshirin, hannezamim vehattabbaot — hare hen kechol hakkelim hannittalin bechatzer.
I mishshum deishti mayya deachem kappila arammaa, ha amar shemuel bar yitzchak amar rav: kol shenneechol kemot shehu chay, en bo mishshum bishshule goyim! adam chashuv shane.
Amar rav chananel amar rav: kotzetz adam dekel bammoed, af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lannesoret shello. layet ala abbaye.

Rav ashe hava leh ibba bishlanyay. azal lemiktzeyeh bechulla demoada, amar leh rav shela mishshelanyay lerav ashe: may dataych, dekaamar rav chananel amar rav: kotzetz adam dekel bammoed af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lannesoret shello — ha layet ala abbaye! amar leh: la shemia li, kelomar, la sevira li. ishtemit narga, bae lemifsekeh leshakeh. shavkeh vahadar ata.

Rav yehuda shera lemikar kittana ulemiktal keshuta, ulemikar shumeshme. amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: bishlama kittana — chaze lachafifa, keshuta — chaze leshichra, ella shumeshme lemay chaze? chaze lenazye deit behu.
Rabbi yannay hava leh hahu pardesa dimta zimneh bechulla demoada, katfeh. leshana shahiyyu kulle alma lefardesayyhu lechulla demoada. afkereh rabbi yannay lefardeseh hahiv shatta.
Nedarim 32a:7-32b:8: Ufeliga derabbi eliezer, deamar rabbi eliezer: gedola tora, sheilmale tora lo nitkayyeymu shamayim vaaretz, shenneemar: "im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti vegomer".

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: beshaa sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu leavraham avinu "hithallech lefanay vehye tamim" achazattu reada. amar: shemma yesh bi davar megunne. kevan sheamar lo: "veettena veriti beni uvenecha", nitkarra dato.
"Vayyotze oto hachutza", amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, histakkalti bammazzal shelli veen li ella ben echad. amar lo: tze meitztagninut shellecha, en mazzal leyisrael.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: kol hametammem atzmo — hakkadosh baruch hu mittammem immo, shenneemar: "im chasid titchassad im gibbor tamim tittammam".
Amar rabbi hoshaya: kol hametammem atzmo — shaa omedet lo, shenneemar: "hithallech lefanay vehye tamim", uchetiv: "vehayita leav hamon goyim".
Amar rabbi: kol hamenachesh — lo nachash, shenneemar: "ki lo nachash beyaakov". veha belamed alef ketiv! ella mishshum midda keneged midda.

Tane ahava bereh derabbi zera: kol adam sheeno menachesh, machnisin oto bimchitza sheafillu malache hashsharet en yecholin likkanes betochah, shenneemar: "ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael vegomer".

Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: mippene ma neenash avraham avinu venishtabedu banav lemitzrayim matayim veeser shanim — mippene sheasa angaryay betalmide chachamim, shenneemar: "vayyarek et chanichav yelide veto".

Ushemuel amar: mippene shehifriz al middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "bamma eda ki irashenna". verabbi yochanan amar: shehifrish bene adam millehikkanes tachat kanfe hashshechina, shenneemar: "ten li hannefesh veharchush kach lach".
"Vayyarek et chanichav yelide veto", rav amar: shehorikan battora. ushemuel amar: shehorikan bezahav.
"Shemona asar ushelosh meot", amar rabbi amme bar abba: eliezer keneged kullam. ikka deamri: eliezer hu, dechushebaneh hachi have.
Veamar rabbi amme bar abba: ben shalosh shanim hikkir avraham et boro, shenneemar: "ekev asher shama avraham bekoli" — chushebaneh mea veshivin uteren.
Veamar rame bar abba:

"Hassatan" bechushebaneh telat mea veshittin vearbea. veamar rame bar abba: ketiv "avram", uchetiv "avraham". battechilla himlicho hakkadosh baruch hu al matayim vearbaim ushelosha evarim, ulevassof himlicho al matayim vearbaim ushemone evarim,
Ellu hen: shete enayim, ushete oznayim, verosh haggeviyyay.

Veamar rame bar abba, may dichtiv: "ir ketanna vaanashim vegomer". "ir ketanna" — ze hagguf, "vaanashim bah meat" — ellu evarim, "uva eleha melech gadol vesavav otah" — ze yetzer hara, "uvana aleha metzodim vacharamim" — ellu avonot,

"Umatza vah ish misken vechacham" — ze yetzer tov, "umillat hu et hair bechochmato" — zo teshuva umaasim tovim. "veadam lo zachar et haish hammisken hahu" — devishat yetzer hara let demiddechar leh leyetzer tov.

"Hachochma taoz lechacham measara shallitim". "hachochma taoz lechacham" — zo teshuva umaasim tovim, "measara shallitim" — shete enayim, ushete oznayim, ushete yadayim, ushete raglayim, verosh haggeviyyay, ufe.

Amar rabbi zecharya mishshum rabbi yishmael: bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu lehotzi kehunna mishshem, shenneemar: "vehu chohen leel elyon". kevan shehikdim birkat avraham levirkat hammakom — hotziah meavraham.

Shenneemar: "vayvarchehu vayyomar baruch avram leel elyon kone shamayim vaaretz uvaruch el elyon". amar lo avraham: vechi makdimin birkat eved levirkat kono? miyyad netanah leavraham, shenneemar: "neum Adonai ladoni shev limini ad ashit oyvecha hadom leraglecha", uvatreh ketiv: "nishba Adonai velo yinnachem atta chohen leolam al divrati malki tzedek". al dibburo shel malki tzedek.
Vehayeynu dichtiv "vehu chohen leel elyon": hu kohen, veen zaro kohen.
Niddah 44b:15-45a:2: Metivi: bat shalosh shanim, vaafillu bat shete shanim veyom echad — mitkaddeshet bevia, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: bat shalosh shanim veyom echad.
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, ki hechi deikka tanna dekaamar yom echad bashshana chashuv shana, hachi name ikka tanna deamar sheloshim yom bashshana chashuvin shana.

Zohar, Emor 25: Amar ribbi elazar, seudata telitaa deshabbat, kad ira beh oshpiza, shavkin leh o la shavkin leh, i la shavkin leh, ishtechach ushepiza dechayyay mippatora demalka, i shavkin leh, ishtechach pegimu bisudata demalka.

Amar leh ribbi shimon avoy, lemalka deira beh ushepiza, venatil mechla mikkammeh, vesalleka leushepizeh, ishtechach af al gav demalka la achal immeh, mimmechla demalka ka achil, umalka yahiv leh lemechal. vechol da, begin dehu ushepize demalka. uveve rav hamenuna sava, la chayyshe leushepiza beshaata da, ulevatar mesaddere patora leoshpiza.
Behay yoma millula asir, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar, utenan cheftzecha ketiv, begin dehay yoma kol mehemnuta itkeshar beh.

Amar leh ribbi elazar, vehech avidna dela lesaddera (sefer acher lesalleka) seudata demalka leushepiza, deha arbesar dechal lihyot beshabbat, salleka seudata demalka lefischa, af al gav delav ihu ushepizeh.

Amar leh hachi amena dei hu ushepizeh, (kol hahu yoma) yachla lesalleka leh, vei lav la salleka leh. vei nema 18 dechal lihyot beshabbat, itdachyay seudata demalka mikkamme seudata defischa. shane pesach, disudata deshabbat itdachyay bechamma gavvnin. chad, begin matzot umerorim, devae bar nash deyishtechach taiva. vechad, begin pesach veha nahama la ishtechach 46 shaot ulemala, desiddura defatora bela nahama, lav hu siddura.

Vei tema bechamra, chamra share, begin detaiv (sefer acher degarer sefer acher dagebayr) libba. aval miomay ishtaddallena dela batilna seudata deshabbat, afillu innun yome, deishtechach beh. behay yoma chakal detappuchin kaddishin itberach, umitbarchan illain vetattain, vehay yoma kishura hu deorayyta.

Amar ribbi abba, hachi hava avid ribbi shimon, bezimna deistellak seudata deshabbata, mesadder patoreh veishtedal bemaase merkava, vahava amar ha seudata demalka deyete lemechal gabbay. begine kach, shabbat, ishtechach becholla adif mikkol zimnin vechaggin, veikre kodesh vela mikra kodesh.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kullehu moadim mikrae kodesh karenan behu. aval nafke rosh hashshana veyoma dechippura dela ishtechach behu chedvavta, deha innun dina havo, aval illen telata, zeminin mikkodesh, lechedvavta lecholla, leishtashea behu bekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 12:12) usemachtem lifne Adonai elohechem, uchetiv (Devarim 27:7) vesamachta lifne Adonai elohecha. behay yoma deshabbeta, itneshe kol tzaara vechol rugeza vechol dochaka mikkol alma, begin deihu yoma dehilula demalka, denishmatin ittosfan, kegavvna dealma deate.

Amar ribbi yitzchak leribbi yehuda, ketiv (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho, vetanenan zachrehu al hayyayin, amay al hayyayin. amar leh, begin deyayin chedvavta deorayyta, veyena deorayyta, chedvavta hu decholla. vehay yayin chadde lemalka, vehay yayin meattera lemalka beitroy, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo baatara sheittera lo immo. vetanenan becholla bayay leachazaa bar nash ovada. dela ishtechach kedushsha ella beyayin, kema deat amer (Shir hashshirim 1:4) ki tovim dodecha miyyayin, miyyayin innun tavaan, nazkira dodecha miyyayin. veal da kidusha deshabbat beyayin, veha ukemuha, veha ittemar.
Zohar, Emor 42: (Vayikra 23:6) uvachamishsha asar yom, ribbi yehuda patach, (Bamidbar 21:1) vayyishma hakkenaani melech arad. tanenan, 3 mattenan illain, izdemanu lehu leyisrael, al yede telata achin: moshe, aharon, umiryam. man, bizchut moshe. anane kavod, bizchut aharon. beer, bizchut miryam. vechullehu achidan leella. man bizchut moshe, dichtiv, (Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim min hashshamayim (dayyka), da moshe. anane kavod bizchut aharon, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 14:14) asher ayin beayin (aharon) nira atta Adonai vegomer, uchetiv (Vayikra 16:13) vechissa anan hakketoret. ma lehallan, shiva. af kan name shiva. deha bakketoret shiva ananin mitkashsheran kachada (veod). veaharon resha lechol shiva ananin hu vehu kashir leshit ochoranin beh bechol yoma.

Beer bizchut miryam, deha hi vadday beer itkere. uvesifra deaggadta, (Shemot 2:4) vattetatztzav achoto merachok ledea vegomer. da hu beer mayim chayyim, vecholla kishshura chad. meta miryam, istallak beer. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 20:2) velo haya mayim laeda. uvehahi shaata baat beer ochora leistalleka, dehava shechiach immehon deyisrael. kad chamat shitta ananin dahavo keshirin alah, itkashsherat hi behu.

Mit aharon, istelaku innun ananin, veistallak anana devera immehon. ata moshe, ahdar lehu. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 68:19) alita lammarom shavita shevi lakachta mattanot baadam. lakachta mattanot vadday, innun mattanot dahavo bekadmita beer vaananin.

Beer, da beer deyitzchak. ananim, illen ananim deaharon. amar ribbi yitzchak, mippene ma zacha aharon leda, begin deihu kashir baananim (nusach acher resha laananeym). vehu akshir kol yoma veyoma lechullehu kachada, demitbarchan kullehu al yedoy.

Ta chaze, al kol chesed deavad kudesha berich hu beyisrael. kashir immehon 7 anane yakiran, vekashir lehu bichneset yisrael, deha anana dilah itkeshar beshita ochoranin. uvechullehu shiva, azlu yisrael bemadbera. may taama, begin dechullehu kishra dimhemnuta ninhu veal da bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim. may ka mayyre. begin dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 2:3) betzillo chimmadti veyashavti ufiryo matok lechikki. uvae bar nash leachazaa garmeh, deyativ techot tzilla dimhemnuta.

Ta chaze, kol innun shenin dekaim aharon, havo yisrael betzilla dimhemnuta, techot illen ananin. batar demit aharon, istallak anana chad, dehu yemina decholla. vechad hay istallak, istelaku kol shear immeh (nusach acher ananin) veitchaziu kullehu bigriuta. veha ukemuha, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 20:29) vayyiru kol haeda ki gava aharon. al tikre vayyiru, ella vayyiru. miyyad vayyishma hakkenaani melech arad yoshev hannegev ki va yisrael derech haatarim. shema deistalaku innun ananim, umit tayayra ravreva dechol innun ananim itkeshsharu beh.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, hakkenaani melech arad yoshev hannegev vadday. vechad atu innun meallelin deshadar moshe, amru (Bamidbar 13:29) amalek yoshev beeretz hannegev, begin letavra libbayyhu. deha baamalek attebar chelehon bekadmita.

Amar ribbi abba, vayyishma hakkenaani, may ka mayyre hacha. batar deistelaku innun ananim. ella kenaan ketiv beh, (Bereshit 9:25) vayyomer arur kenaan eved avadim yihye leechav. hacha olifna, man deappik garmeh mitztzila dimhemnuta, itchaze lemehevi eved leavadde avaddin, hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 21:1) vayyillachem beyisrael vayishb mimmennu shevi. hu natal avaddin miyisrael legarmeh.

Veal da ketiv, kol haezrach beyisrael yeshvu basukkot. kol man deihu misharsha vegiza kaddisha deyisrael, yeshvu bassukkot, techot tzilla dimhemnuta. uman deleteh miggiza veshorsha kaddisha deyisrael, la yetiv behu, veyippuk garmeh mittechot tzilla dimhemnuta.

Ketiv (Hoshea 12:8) kenaan beyado mozne mirma, da eliezer eved avraham. veta chaze, ketiv arur kenaan uvegin dezacha kenaan da, leshammesha leavraham, kevan deshimmesh leavraham, yetiv techot tzilla dimhemnuta, zacha lemeppak mehahu latyay deitlatteyay, velo od ella dichtiv beh beracha. dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:31) vayomer bo beruch Adonai. may ka mayyre. dechol man deyetiv techot tzilla dimhemnuta, achasin cheru leh velivnoy lealmin, veitberach birchata illaa, uman deappik garmeh metzilla dimhemnuta, achasin galuta leh velivnoy, dichtiv vayyillachem beyisrael vayyishb mimmennu shevi.
Zohar, Emor 43: (Vayikra 23:42) bassukkot teshvu chaser, veda anana chad, dechullehu keshirin beh. dichtiv, ki anan Adonai alehem yomam. uchetiv, (Bamidbar 14:14) uveammud anan atta holech lifnehem yomam. da hu anana deaharon, deikre yomam, dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo. anana chad, natil immeh chamesh ochoranin, veinnun shit. vaanana ochora, dichtiv uveammud esh layla, da nahara lehu leyisrael, minhiru deinnun shit.

Raya mehemna (Vayikra 23:42) bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim vegomer, pikkuda (45) da, leshev bassukka. veha okimna, begin leitchazaa deyisrael yatve beraza dimhemnuta, bela dechilu kelal, deha mekatrega itperash minnayyhu. vechol man deihu beraza dimhemnuta, yativ bassukka. kema deokimna, dichtiv, kol haezrach beyisrael yishvu bassukkot. man deihu beraza dimhemnuta, umizzara vesharsha deyisrael, yishvu bassukkot. veraza da ittemar bechamma duchete.

Pikkuda (46) batar da, lekarva karbena bechol yoma, vekarbena da, lemehevi chulaka becholla, bechedvavta divnoy. begin dechullehu achidan beilana. anfin diltatta dilgabbe sharsha deilana, kolla itbarchan begin ilana. af al gav delet behu toalta, kolla itbarchan. vechedvavta deyisrael baavuhon dilella, yahave chulaka devirkan, lechol innun shear ammin, deit lon achidu, veitachadu behu beyisrael.

Vechol illen karbenin, lemehav mezona, leinnun memanan dishar ammin, deha miggo rechimu deka rachim kudesha berich hu livnoy, bae decholla yehon rechimin dilhon. veraza da, (Mishlei 16:7) birtztzot Adonai darche ish gam oyvav yashlim itto. afillu kol innun mekatrege illae kullehu ahadderan rechimin leyisrael vechad chayyaylin dilella ahadru rechimin leyisrael, kol innun diltatta, al achat kama vechamma.

Vei tema lehon havo mekarve karbena, lav hachi, ella kolla lekudesha berich hu salik umitkarev. veihu parish mezona lechullehu uchelusin desitrin ochoranin, deyithanun behahu dorona divnoy, veyithadrun rechimin dilhon, deyindeun ella vetatta, deha let amma keamma deyisrael, deinnun chulakeh veadveh dekudesha berich hu, veistallak yekara dekudesha berich hu ella vetatta kedka yaut. vechol uchelusin illain patche veamre, (Shmuel b 7:23) umi cheammecha keyisrael goy echad baaretz. (tikkunin daf 152) (ad kan raya mehemana)

Ribbi elazar patach (veamar), (Yirmeyahu 2:2) ko amar Adonai zacharti lach chesed neurayich vegomer. hay kera al keneset yisrael ittemar, beshaata dahavat azla bemadbera immehon deyisrael. zacharti lach chesed: da anana deaharon, denatla bechamesh ochoranin, deitkesharu alach, unehiru alach. ahavat kelulotayich, deishtachlalu lach, (sefer acher vechullehu ishtachlelu bach) veattaru lach, veatkinu lach kechalla detade tachshitaha. vechol kach lamma. begin lechtech acharay bammidbar beeretz lo zerua.

Ta chaze, beshaata devar nash yativ bemadora da, tzilla dimhemnuta, shechinta parsa gadfaha aleh milleella, veavraham vachamishsha tzaddikayyay ochoranin shavyayn madorehon immeh. amar ribbi abba, avraham vachamishsha tzaddikayyay, vedavid malka, shavyayn madorehon immeh. hada hu dichtiv, bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim. shivat yamim ketiv, vela beshivat yamim. kegavvna da ketiv, (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim vegomer. uvae bar nash lemechde bechol yoma veyoma, beanpin nehirin, beushepizin illen desharyayn immeh.

Veamar ribbi abba, ketiv bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim, ulevatar yeshvu bassukkot. bekadmita teshvu, ulevatar yeshvu. ella, kadmaa leushepize. tinyayna, livne alma. kadmaa leushepize, ki ha derav hamenuna sava, kad hava ayel lassukka hava chadde, vekaim al pitcha lassukka millegav, veamar nezammen leushepizin. mesadder (nusach acher nisdar) patora, vekaim al raglohi, umevarech, veomer bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim. tivu ushepizin illain, tivu. tivu ushepize mehemnuta, tivu. arim (sefer acher asche) yedoy, vechadde, veamar zakkaa chullakana, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dichtiv, (Devarim 32) ki chelek Adonai ammo vegomer, vahava yativ.

Tinyayna, livne alma, deman deit leh chulaka beamma uveara kaddisha, yativ betzilla dimhemnuta, lekabbela ushepizin, lemechde behay alma uvealma deate uvae lemechde lemiskene. may taama. begin dechulaka deinnun ushepizin dezammin demiskene hu. vehahu deyativ betzilla da dimhemnuta, vezammin ushepizin illen illain, ushepize mehemnuta, vela yahiv lon chulakehon, kullehu kayyme minneh, veamre (Mishlei 23:6) al tilcham et lechem ra ayin vegomer, ishtechach dehahu patora detakkin, dileh hu, velav dekudesha berich hu, aleh ketiv (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem vegomer, peresh chaggechem, vela chaggay. vavy leh lehahu bar nash, beshaata deillen ushepize mehemnuta kayyme mippatoreh.

Veamar ribbi abba, avraham, kol yomoy hava kaim befarashat orchin, lezammena ushepizin, uletakkena lon patore, hasheta, dimzammenin leh, ulechullehu tzaddikayyay, uledavid malka, vela yahavin lon chulakehon, avraham kaim mippatora, vekare, (Bamidbar 16:26) suru na meal ohole haanashim harshaim haelle. vechullehu sallekin avatreh. yitzchak amar, (Mishlei 13:25) uveten reshaim techsar. yaakov amar, (Mishlei 23:8) pittecha achalta tekienna. ushear kol tzaddikayyay amre, (Yeshayahu 28:8) ki kol shulchanot malu ki tzoa beli makom.

David malka amar, (chaser kan) veashlim dinoy, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 25:38) vayhi kaaseret hayyamim vayyiggof Adonai et naval vayyamot. may ka mayyre. begin dedavid shaal lenaval, veitavid leh oshpiza, vela baa. veda zammin leh, vela yahav leh chulaka, uveinnun asara yomin dedavid malka dain alma, attedan aleh hahu bar nash deashlim leh bish yattir minaval.

Amar ribbi elazar (begin kach) orayyta la atrach aleh devar nash yattir, ella kema deyachil, dichtiv, (Devarim 16:17) ish kemattenat yado vegomer. vela lema inish echul veesba vearvivy bekadmita, uma deyishtear etten lemiskene, ella resha decholla deushepizin hu, vei chadde leushepizin veravvi lon, kudesha berich hu chadde immeh, veavraham kare aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai vegomer. veyitzchak kare aleh, (Yeshayahu 54:17) kol keli yutzar alayich lo yitzlach. amar ribbi shimon, hay, david malka amar leh, begin dechol zayynin demalka, ukeravin demalka, bidoy dedavid itpekadu, aval yitzchak kaamar, (Tehillim 112:2) gibbor baaretz yihye zaro vegomer, hon vaosher vegomer.

Yaakov amar, (Yeshayahu 58:8) az yibbaka kashshachar orecha vegomer, shear tzaddikayyay amre, (Yeshayahu 58:8) venachacha Adonai tamid vehisbia vegomer, david malka amar, (Yeshayahu 54:17) kol keli yutzar alayich lo yitzlach, deha hu al kol zeyne alma itpekad. zakkaa chulakeh devar nash, dezache lechol hay. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, bealma den, uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim vegomer. raya mehemna pikkuda (47) da litol lulav behahu yoma beinnun zinin dileh vehay raza okimna veokmuha chavrayyay kema dekudesha berich hu natil lon leyisrael behane yomin vechadde behon. uf hachi yisrael natle leh lekudesha berich hu lechulakehon vechaddan beh. veda hu raza delulav. uminin deveh deihu raza diyyukena deadam veha ittemar. (ad kan raya mehemana)

Zohar, Tetzaveh 17: Ketiv (iyyov 1) yehi shem Adonai mevorach. may mevorach. (ella kolla yade), aval raza chada yada chad mechavrana, bemadbera achziu leh bechelma, veribbi yitzchak kaftora shemeh. may mevorach. sheruta kashe, vesofeh rach. 42 kashe, vedina ihu vadday. (ulevatar kach) kegavvna da, yoma derosh hashshana 42, deha bemv (uveraza 46) atvavn itbere alma, veal da itbere bedina. levatar rach, veal da tanenan, kol sherutin kashin, vesofa dilhon rachin. (sefer acher da 44 uveraza 46 atvavn itbere alma veal da itbere bedina levatar kach kegavvna da) beyoma derosh hashshana 42 kashe bedina. beyoma daatzeret rach bechedva.

Ta chaze, ma ben dina illaa, lehay dina. dina illaa sheruta vesofa kashe, velet man deyekum beh, vechol ma deazil ittakkaf, uvatar deshaari, la salik minneh, ad deachil veshetze kolla, dela ishtear kelum. aval dina achara detatta, sheruta kashe, vechol ma deazil itchalash, ad denahir anpin, kegavvna (sefer acher da dina denukeba) denukeba dechalash chelaha.

Ematay ittear dina dilella lemishre al alma. beyoma detofana. veal da la ishtear kelum bealma, bar hahu tevuta denoach, deihi kegavvna illaa, desavil lehahu tukepa. vei lav dezammin kudesha berich hu, veishtechach berachame al alma, kol alma itavid, dichtiv, (Tehillim 29:10) Adonai lammabbul yashav, veal da la sharya dina dilella al alma, dela yachil alma lemisbal leh, afillu riga chada.

rashi: Ulechol hayyad hachazaka. shekkibbel et hattora balluchot beyadav:
Ulechol hammora haggadol. nissim ugevurot shebbammidbar haggadol vehannora (80 sifre):

Leene kol yisrael. shennesao libbo lishbor halluchot leenehem shenneemar "vaashabberem leenechem" (Devarim 9) vehiskima daat hakkadosh baruch hu ledato, shenneemar "asher shibbarta" (Shemot 34) — yishar kochacha sheshshibbarta:
Veikkevotecha lo nodau. en happesiot nikkarot al hammayim. veikkevotecha teratzsh belaaz:
targum: Beyama desuf orchach vechivshach bemayin sagiin verushemat pesiatach la ityedau:

rashi: Vezot lihuda. samach yehuda liruven mippene sheshshenehem hodu al kilkul shebbeyadam, shenneemar "asher chachamim yaggidu vegomer lahem levaddam vegomer velo avar zar betocham" (Iyov 15); veod pershu rabbotenu shekkol arbaim shana shehayu yisrael bammidbar hayu atzmot yehuda mitgalgelin baaron mippene nidduy shekkibbel alav, shenneemar "vechatati leavi kol hayyamim" (Bereshit 44), amar moshe mi garam liruven sheyyode? yehuda vechulei (sota 7):
Shema Adonai kol yehuda. tefillat david ushelomo veasa mippene hakkushim, vihoshafat mippene haammonim, vechizkiyya mippene sancheriv:
Veel ammo teviennu. leshalom mippene hammilchama:
Yadav rav lo. yarivu rivo veyinkemu nikmato:

Veezer mitztzarav tihye. al yehoshafat hitpallel al milchemet ramot gilad, "vayyizak yehoshafat vaAdonai azaro" (divrei hayamim 2 18); davar acher — shema Adonai kol yehuda, kan ramaz leshimon mittoch birchotav shel yehuda, veaf keshechalku eretz yisrael natal shimon mittoch goralo shel yehuda, shenneemar (Yehoshua 19) "mechevel bene yehuda nachalat bene shimon" (umippene ma lo yiched lo veracha bifne atzmo? shehaya belibbo alav al ma sheasa bashshittim, ken katuv beaggadat tehillim:)
ohc: Shema Adonai kol yehuda. perush, lefi sheyyehuda chata bemaase tamar vehitvadda al cheto beamro (Bereshit 38:26) "tzadka mimmenni", bikkesh moshe sheyyekabbel Adonai kolo behodaato. veamar inyan ze lomar acharav "veel ammo teviennu", perush lefi ma shekkatavnu befasuk "mitteref beni alita" (Bereshit 49:9), ki beemtzaut maase tamar hotzi teref adam sheachal habbeliyyaal, vehu ma sheramaz beamro "yadav", perush koach maasav rav lo, higdil vekana rabbanut betosefet gader elyon kemo sheheerachnu sham:

Veamro veezer mitztzarav tihye. perush, shehagam shehirviach peretz vezerach bechoach maase tamar, af al pi chen adayin lo heira malchut bet david, ki tzericha lenitzotz hakkedushsha sheadayin ben haummot vehi rut hammoaviyya. laze amar "veezer mitztzarav tihye" leshon nekeva, gam "ezer" yore el hannekeva, keamro (Bereshit 2:18) "eese lo ezer" vegomer. veayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk "vechatati leavi" vegomer (Bereshit 43:9).

rashi: Baruch marchiv gad. melammed shehaya techumo shel gad marchiv veholech kelappe mizrach (sham):
Kelavi shachen. lefi shehaya samuch lassefar, lefichach nimshal baarayot, shekkol hassemuchim lassefar tzerichim lihyot gibborim (sham):
Vetaraf zeroa af kodkod. harugehen hayu nikkarin, chotchim harosh im hazzeroa bemakka achat:
ohc: Marchiv gad. perush, hirchiv Adonai lo binchasim rabbim, dichtiv (Bamidbar 32:1) "umikne rav haya [livne reuven] velivne gad" vegomer, vehattaam kemo sheamar sham hakkatuv (Bamidbar 31:53) "anshe hatztzava bazzu ish lo", veleheyot bene gad gibbore choach bazzu yoter mikkullam, vehu ma shessamach lemaamar "marchiv vegomer kelavi shachen vetaraf" vegomer:

rashi: Lemor lezaracha ettenenna heriticha. kede shettelech vetomar leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov, shevua shennishba lachem hakkabba kiyyemah. vezehu lemor, lechach heritiha lecha, aval gezera hi millefanay sheshshamma lo taavor, sheillule chach hayiti mekayyemcha ad shettire otam netuim ukevuim vah vetelech vetaggid lahem:
ohc: Lemor lezaracha ettenenna. amro "lemor", lefi shello amar nosach ze shel "lezaracha ettenenna" lishlashtam, laze amar "lemor", perush shemmechuvvan hammaamar hu ze "lezaracha ettenenna". verabbotenu zichronam livracha (berachot 18:) darshu shetztzivvahu sheyyelech veyomar lahem laavot vechulei, ad kan. veulay ki ratza Adonai sheyyomar lahem moshe haddevarim lehachezik lo haavot tovat chen vachesed al asher tarach veyaga hu baadam ad haviam el hammakom.

Veshamma lo taavor. ulay shennitkavven lomar lo shello yitztarech laavor shamma laalot derech sham mishshaar hashshamayim shehu shamma, veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Zohar 9 81.) sheen hannefashot olot ella derech sham. umoshe lefi shenneesaf el hashshechina hinne mekomo bakkodesh bemakom shehu sham. veze hu shiur hakkatuv: veshamma lo titztarech laavor el mekomcha, vesamach omer "vayyamat sham vegomer al pi Adonai", vehaven:

rashi: Af chovev ammim. gam chibba yetera chavav et hashshevatim; kol echad veechad karuy am, shehare vinyamin levaddo haya atid lehivvaled kesheamar hakkadosh baruch hu leyaakov (Bereshit 35), "goy ukehal goyim yihye mimmekka":
Kol kedoshav beyadecha. nafshot hatztzaddikim genuzot itto, kainyan shenneemar (Shmuel 1 25) "vehayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim et Adonai elohecha" (sifre):
Vehem tukku leraglecha. vehem reuyim lechach, shehare tivvechu atzman letoch tachtit hahar leraglecha besinay:
Tukku. leshon pualu, huttavvechu letoch margelotecha:
Yissa middabberotecha. nasu alehem ol toratcha (sifre):

Middabberotecha. hammem bo karov lisod, kemo (Bamidbar 7), "vayyishma el hakkol middabber elav", "vaeshma et middabber elay" (Yechezkel 2) kemo mitdabber elay, af ze middabberotecha — ma shehayita medabber lehashemieni lemor lahem, 319 paveraperaleyresh belaaz. veunkelos tirgem shehayu nosim al pi devarecha, vehammem bo shimmush, meshammeshet leshon min. davar acher — af chovev ammim, af bishat chibbatan shel ummot haolam shehereta laummot panim sochakot umasarta et yisrael beyadam, kol kiddushav beyadecha, kol tzaddikehem vetovehem davku becha velo mashu meacharecha veatta shomram:
Vehem tukku leraglecha. vehem mitmatztzeim umitkannesim letachat tzillecha.
Yissa middabberotecha. mekabbelim gezerotecha vedatotecha besimcha, veelle divrehem:
ohc: Af chovev ammim vegomer razal amru (bava batra 8.) af shechibbev Adonai haammim vehigla yisrael benehem, af al pi chen "kol kedoshav beyadecha vehem" vegomer sheen al lomde tora minda velo vahalach. venire sheyyechavven hakkatuv latet taam lahalichato leseir ulefaran, shehu lacharot bahem af Adonai beyom haddin kesheyyomru "lo hodatanu otah", laze kadam lahem hassibba veamar lahem "attem rotzim lekabbel hattora?". veshiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: af hu ma shechovev ammim shehalach lehazeminam lattora.

Veamro "kol kedoshav" vegomer, perush al derech amram zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni sof parashat kedoshim) befasuk "vaavdil etchem min haammim" (Vayikra 20:26), illu amar "vaavdil et haammim mikkem" lo hayta tekuma laummot, umeamro "vaavdil etchem" vegomer, mikkan sheim yavou mehaammim lehitgayyer hinne hem mekubbalim keechad yisreeli, vehu amro "kol kedoshav" perush maala zo odenna lahem, perush, lehitgayyer, shehabba lehitkaddesh mehem "beyadecha", perush, hu nichnas umekubbal tachat kenafecha (yevamot 47.).

O tihye kavvanat hakkatuv al ze hadderech: "af chovev" – perush chibba achat nishara laammim, vehu shekkol kedoshav beyadecha kemo shepperashti. veamro "vehem" – perush am yisrael shebbahem hu kol ikkar hammaamar, yesh lahem hefresh lehitgadder al kedoshav shel habbaim min shear haggoyim, sheyyisrael "tukku leraglecha", perush, keamram zichronam livracha (yevamot 103:) yisrael sheamdu al har sinay paska zohamatam, veze haya mitztzad ma shettukku – perush nitmarku al yede koach haddibbur hammufla sheshshamu divre haelohim, veamru zichronam livracha (shabbat pach:) sheyyatza nishmatam karamuz bappasuk (Shir HaShirim 5:6) "nafshi yatza vedabbero", uvaze paska zohamatam, ma sheen ken haggerim shehagam sheyyitkabbelu keechad shivte yisrael lo paska zohama mehem kayyadua middivrehem (Zohar 11 14:).

Vegamar omer "yissa middabberotecha", perush leshon memshala, al derech amro (tehillim 47:4) "yadber ammim tachtenu", hakkavvana baze sheen notnim shum memshala al yisrael ella lemi shehu mizzera yisrael velo mimmishpachat haggerim, uchemo sheddarshu zichronam livracha (yevamot ma:) mippasuk (Devarim 17:15) "som tasim alecha melech" – kol mesimot shettasim alecha lo yihyu ella mikkerev achecha, vetze ulemad mibbarayta (sota ma.) shel agrippas hammelech keshekkara bevet hammikdash zalgu enav demaot vechol hainyan, vehu amro "yissa middabberotecha" perush kol shehu mizzera am bene yisrael hu yachol lehitromem bigdullot sheyyeshnam al yisrael ammecha, veamro "yissa" leshon yachid keamram (sanhedrin 8.) dabbar echad laddor velo shene dabbarim.

Od yirtze beamro "yissa middabberotecha" shehu taam "tukku", al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat pach.) shekkafa hashshem alehem hahar kegigit lekabbel hattora, uvime haman bittelu taanat modaa rabba vekiyyemu mertzonam ma shekkibbelu beones, uferashti haddavar bimkomo (Shemot 19:5), ki ma shemmeanu lekabbel hattora ad shehutzrach lahafoch alehem hahar haya al gezerat chachamim vedivrehem vetakkanotehem asher ravu sheasu lehazehir yisrael ulehaamidam bemakom hammishtammer millaavor al divre hashshem, vehu amro "tukku leraglecha" kede sheyyissa middabberotecha chelek mehaddibberot shello ratzu lekabbel, ki al kelalut hattora katuv yosher (Shemot 24:7) "kol asher dibber hashshem naase venishma", ella al chelek mehaddibberot shetztzivva alehem lekabbel torat chacham al ze "tukku leraglecha" shehu har sinay sheamad hashshem alav veoto kafa hashshem alehem kegigit.

O titparesh "middabberotecha" leshon hanehaga, perush torot hammanhigim et yisrael shehem hem hammechaddeshim takkanot ugezerot ugedarim useyagim, uvime mardechay kesherau asher yafli tzaddik asot kibbelu torat chacham mekor chayyim.

Od yirtze amro "yissa middabberotecha" al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shir HaShirim Rabba 1:2) shekkol dibbur vedibbur shehaya yotze mippi hakkadosh baruch hu haya medabber im kol ish vaish miyyisrael veamar lo: "atta mekabbeleni alecha?" vehu amar lo: "hen". haya noshko vechulei veole umitatter lerosho, vehu amro "vehem tukku vegomer yissa" – kol echad veechad mehem middabberotecha al rosho. vedikdek lomar "middabberotecha" velo amar "dibberotecha", lefi shehaddevarim atzmam hayu medabberim lahem veomer lechol echad: atta mekabbeleni vechulei kaamur.

Veamro yissa – leatid, lefi sheachar maase haegel niklefu mehem haatarot hahem shennasu al rosham, shehem hamedabberim otam, vehoridu edyam behar chorev (Shemot 33:5), vezacha bahem moshe (shabbat pach.), keamram (chagiga 15.) zacha notel chelko vechelek chavero began eden, vehu sod amro (Shemot 33:8) "vehibbitu achare moshe" sheamru zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 110.) shechashaduhu beeshet ish, perush – hi hattora hameorasa leyisrael shennatal moshe kol chelkam. laze amar "yissa" sheatidim lachzor lahem leatid lavo, veamru od rabbotenu zichronam livracha (saydaver Rabbi asher beshem 216 zichrono livracha) shebbeyom shabbat chozrim haatarot lerosh yisrael velo nishar lemoshe ella chelko hammaggia lo, velaze hu sheanu omrim beyom shabbat "yismach moshe bemattenat chelko", perush – yismach hagam sheen lo ella mattenat chelko shekkevar hechzir leyisrael chelkam bachayyim.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (horayot 8:) "anochi" velo yihye lecha" mippi haggevura shemanum, veyishshavnu maamar ze im maamar (mechilta yitro) shekkol aseret haddibberot neemru bedibbur echad, ki Adonai amar kullam bedibbur echad, aval beerech hashshomim lo yachlu lekabbel mehem ella "anochi" velo yihye lecha" shamu otam bigvurot bedibbur echad veyatzta nishmatam beemtzautam, vehu amro "tukku leraglecha" veafas koach ad sheyyatzta nishmatam, hattaam "lissa middabberotecha" perush chelek mehaddibberot hammuflaim shehem "anochi" velo yihye lecha", aval hashshear moshe tzivva otam keamram zichronam livracha (sham), vehu ma sheggamar omer "tora tzivva lanu moshe" vegomer, vetimtza shekkol hammitzvot shetztzivva Adonai ben mitzvot ase ben mitzvot lo taase hem bifratut taryag mitzvot, vehammaskil letevat "tora" yimtza bah minyan tarya (makkot 23:) im shenayim harmuzim bammaamar hassamuch "yissa middabberotecha" hare hem taryag venachon.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha bemassechet megilla (Megila 29.) beoto maase sheratzu hammalachim lidchoto lerav sheshet mikkenishta mippene hashshechina, ad shettaan veamar: ribbono shel olam, aluv vesheeno aluv mi nidche mippene mi? veamar lahem hashshem shivkuhu. vehu amro "vehem tukku", perush ucheshehem birida aluvim umeunnim uvaim betaana zo, yissa mealav middabberotecha shehem malachim haomdim lesharet et pene hashshem, shehem hammemunnim al devar kevod shemo, velo yiddachu mippenehem:

Od yirmoz al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (berachot 5.) shalosh mattanot tovot natan hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael, vechullam lo netanam ella al yede yissurin, shehem tora vechulei, veamru od (berachot 63.) befasuk (Mishlei 30:32) "im navalta vehitnasse" shekkol hammenabbel atzmo al divre tora sofo lihyot mitalle, vehu amro "tukku leraglecha" vetziaru atzmam baze, "yissa" – perush yitalle mitztzad dibberotecha, shehattora hi hammeromemet umenasset, keamro (Mishlei 8:15) "bi melachim yimlochu" vegomer:

Od yirtze beamro "tukku vegomer yissa" vegomer, al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (nedarim lach.) sheamru befasuk "vattechasserehu meat meelohim" (tehillim 8:6), shemt shaare bina nimseru lemoshe besinay, veshaar hachamishshim halo hu kamus et Adonai. vehu ma shepperashti befasuk "ki mala haaretz dea et Adonai" (yeshaya 11:9), perush haddea sheadayin hi et Adonai, velo mesarah lemoshe, uvehiggalot meshichenu yitten Adonai hattov hahu. vehu amro "tukku leraglecha", bachelek shekkevar kibbelu, veod leatid "yissa middabberotecha", veyiches elav leshon nesiut umaala shechelek hahu elyon meod, uchevar katavnu mizze beorech bimkomot acherim:
