rashi: Male geviyyot. asifat pegarim, male leshon asifa kemo "karu acharecha male" (Yirmeyahu 12:6), "asher yikkare alav melo roim" (Yeshayahu 31:4). vehechan dan male geviyyot? "et mitzrayim met al sefat hayyam" (Shemot 14:30):

Machatz rosh al eretz rabba. zo hi dugmat nevuat "machatzta rosh mibbet rasha" (Chavakuk 3:13) – rosh paro, shehaya rosh vesar al eretz gedola vachashuva al kol haaratzot, kemo shenneemar "moshel ammim vayfattechehu" (tehillim 105:20) – shehayu kol haummot tachat memshelet mitzrayim:
targum: Itmana ledayan al ammaya mele ara gusheme rashiin ketilin mecha resha al ara sagia lachada:

rashi: Mechatz motnayim kamav. mechatz kamav makkat matnayim, kainyan shenneemar (Tehillim 69) "umatnehem tamid hamead", veal hammeorrin al hakkehunna amar ken. davar acher — raa sheatidin chashmonay uvanav lehillachem im hayyevanim vehitpallel alehem, lefi shehayu muatim — 12 bene chashmonay veelazar — keneged kamma revavot, lechach neemar barech Adonai chelo ufoal yadav tirtze (Bereshit Rabba 99):
Umesanav min yekumun. mechatz kamav umesanav mihyot lahem tekuma:
ohc: Umesanav min yekumun. amro "min yekumun", ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 99:2) shennitnabbe al malchut yavan sheatida lippol beyad bene chashmonay. laze amar "umesanav min yekumun", perush afillu min hazzeman atzmo shettihye lahem lassonim kima, veyisrael shefalim, bazzeman atzmo "mechatz matnayim kamav" vegomer, vechen haya, vedavar ze hi hatzelacha benes vafele.

rashi: Betach badad. kol yachid veyachid ish tachat gafno vetachat teenato mefuzzarin veen tzerichin lehitassef veleshev yachad mippene haoyev:

En yaakov. kemo "veeno keen habbedolach" (Bamidbar 11) keen habberacha shebbercham yaakov, lo chevadad sheamar yirmeya "badad yashavti" (Yirmeyahu 15), ella keen havetacha shehivticham yaakov (Bereshit 48) "vehaya elohim immachem veheshiv etchem el eretz avotechem" (80 sifre):
Yaarfu. yittefu:
Af shamav yaarfu tal. af birchato shel yitzchak nosefet al birchato shel yaakov "veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim vegomer":
ohc: Vayyishkon yisrael betach. ematay? kesheyyihye badad, umaamar "vayyishkon" nimshach im maamar shellemala mimmennu shehu "vayyomer hashemed", shetztzivva Adonai leyisrael lehashemid kol neshama miyyoshve haaretz, uvaze "vayyishkon yisrael betach badad".
Veamro en yaakov, lomar shehagam shettihye enam el eretz dagan vetirosh, perush leechol mippiryah velisboa mittuvah, af al pi chen lo yivatu keshello yihyu yoshvim mehaammim immahem baaretz.

rashi: Ledor vador asher lo vera. lo tavo alay raa ledorotay:
targum: Yemar bilvaveh la azua midar ledar milmeevad bish:

rashi: En kael yeshurun. da lecha yeshurun sheen kael bechol elohe haammim velo chetzurecha tzuram:
Rochev shamayim. hu oto eloah shebbeezrecha, uvegaavato hu rochev shechakim:
ohc: En kael yeshurun. perush, en kael shel yeshurun sheose davar ze lahem, vehu sherochev shamayim, perush rochev al hashshamayim bishvil ezrat yisrael, vehu amro "beezrecha", lehillachem bishvilcha, keamro (Shemot 14:14) "Adonai yillachem lachem", ucheshehu ba venilcham lahem kol hashshamayim hem merkavto, umeatta kol kochot hashshamayim umaarachtam baim leezrat yisrael, shehassus tafel larochev.

rashi: Meona elohe kedem. lemaon hem hashshechakim lelohe kedem, shekkadam lechol elohim uvarar lo shechakim leshivto umeonato, umittachat meonato kol baale zeroa shochnim:

Zeroot olam. sichon veog umalche chenaan shehayu takpo ugevurato shel olam, lefichach al karcham yecherdu veyazuu vechocham chalesh mippanav, leolam emat haggavoah al hannamuch, vehu shehakkoach vehaggevura shello beezrecha:
Vaygaresh mippanecha oyev, vayyomer. lecha hashemed otam:
Meona. kol teva shetztzericha lamed bitchillatah hetil lah hei besofah (yevamot 13):
Yachilu. yatzlichu, vedome lo (Iyov 20:21) "al ken lo yachil tuvo". veyesh mefarshim yachilu kemo (Shmuel 2 3:29) "yachulu al rosh yoav":
Marom mishpatecha minnegdo. mesullakim umeruchakim mishpete yissurin ufureaniyyot shellecha minnegdo, sheenam baim alav:
Kol tzorrav yafiach bahem. behappachat ruach hu mefiach bahem, vehem noflim lefanav:
targum: Matzlechin orchateh bechol idan rechikin dinach min kibbeleh bechol meikoy yizof behon:

rashi: Velizvulun amar. ellu chamishsha shevatim shebberech baacharona — zevulun gad dan venaftali veasher — kafal shemotehem lechazzekam ulehagbiram, lefi shehayu challashim shebbechol hashshevatim, hem hem sheholich yosef lifne faro shenneemar (Bereshit 47) "umiktze echav lakach chamishsha anashim", lefi shennirim challashim velo yasim otam lo sare milchamto:

Semach zevulun betzetecha veyissashchar beohalecha. zevulun veyissashochar asu shuttafut, zevulun lechof yammim yishkon veyotze lifrakmatya bisfinot umistakker venoten letoch piv shel yissashchar, vehem yoshvim veoskim battora, lefichach hikdim zevulun leyissashochar shettorato shel yissashchar al yede zevulun hayta (Bereshit Rabba 99):
Semach zevulun betzetecha. hatzelach betzetcha lischora:

Veyissashchar. hatzelach bishivat ohalecha lattora, leshev uleabber shanim velikboa chodashim, kemo shenneemar (20 12) "umibbene yissashchar yode vina laittim.. rashehem matayim", rashe sanhedrin hayu oskim bechach, veal pi keviot ittehem veibburehem —
ohc: Semach zevulun vegomer. hagam shebbeinyene olam hazze bichlalut en lismoach bahem, dichtiv (Kohelet 2:2) "ulesimcha ma zo osa", amar hannavi shezzevulun yeshno besimcha, hagam bitziato mibbet hammidrash lischora, vehattaam kede sheyyitkayyem yissashchar beoholo keamro "veyissashchar beohalecha".

Od yirtze, lefi sheen adam yodea bitziato lischora im yatzliach im lo ad sheyyachzor mutzlach, laze amar lizvulun "semach" meet yetziatcha, ki bevadday shettatzliach, vehattaam kevan sheyyissashochar beohalecha sheliach mitzva atta lazun lomde tora, vechinna ohel yissashchar lizvulun, ki hu habbone oholo.

O yirtze "beohalecha", kinnuy leyissashochar, veamar leshon ohel lishte sibbot: echad, sheen osin ikkar baolam ella yeshivat aray, veikkar diratam hu bet olamim. 2, kinnuy lammaahil alehem, shehi hashshechina shennikret ohel, hagam sheoskim bischora, alehem neemar (tehillim 85:14) "tzedek lefanav yehallech" vegomer:

rashi: Vayyar reshit lo. raa littol lo chelek beeretz sichon veog, shehi reshit kibbush haaretz:
Ki sham chelkat. ki yada asher sham benachalato chelkat sede kevurat mechokek, vehu moshe (80 sifre; sota 13):
Safun. otah chelka sefuna utemuna mikkol beriyya, shenneemar (Devarim 34) "velo yada ish et kevurato":
Vayyete. gad:
Rashe am. hem hayu holchin lifne hechalutz bechibbush haaretz, lefi shehayu gibborim, vechen hu omer "veattem taavru chamushim lifne achechem vegomer" (Yehoshua 1):
Tzidkat Adonai asa. sheheeminu divrehem veshamru havetachatam laavor et hayyarden ad shekkavshu vechalku; davar acher — vayyete moshe rashe am, tzidkat Adonai asa al moshe amur (80 sifre):
ohc: Vayyar reshit lo. perush, haya rauy reshit shehi hattora lo, vetaam laddavar – "ki sham chelkat", perush chelko shel mechokek shehu moshe "safun", o chelek mimmechokek, ki chelek haggadol ala lemala, velo nishar sham ella gufo hakkadosh hachay safun. vetaam haddavar lehavi rashe am, keamram zichronam livracha (sifre kan) lehavi dor hammidbar laolam habba. vehu amro "vayyete" vegomer, ukeraam rashe am lefi shehem techillat keniyyat yisrael laAdonai leam segulla.

Od yirtze, "vayyar reshit" – hannachala shennachalu yisrael, shehi eretz sichon veog "lo", perush littelah lechelko. velachashash segullat haaretz shekkol haddar bah o kol hakkavur bah yesh lo chelek laolam habba (ketuvot 110:), amar taam shello chash ledavar ze "ki sham", perush bammakom hahu shellakach lenachalato, sham "chelkat mechokek", shehu moshe, "safun", "vayyete rashe am", umeatta gam hu yavo im rashe am laolam habba.

Tzidkat Adonai asa. perush chozer el moshe, shennoten taam lamma zacha lechol hammaala sheyyavi acherim immo laolam habba, veamar "tzidkat Adonai" vegomer, perush sheasa hatztzedek bedavar hannogea laAdonai.

O efshar sheyyechavven lomar sheasa yoter mechiyyuvo im Adonai, uchemo sheramaznu bappasuk "utzedaka tihye lanu" vegomer (Devarim 6:25), gam mishpatav im yisrael asa, perush shehaya mitdayyen tamid im Adonai al yisrael vehaya machria haddin lechaf zechut, kaamur beinyan haegel umeraggelim vaadat korach, veayyen ma shepperashnu bahem. uchefi ze shiur amro "umishpatav", perush mishpatim shel Adonai im yisrael, asa otam, perush asa tikken.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech, "tzidkat Adonai asa" bema shennogea leatzmo, uma shennishpat hu bemishpatim ellu lamut beever hayyarden vesatam tefillato hu "im yisrael", perush hu baddevarim shehem im yisrael, kegon me meriva, ushear hassibbot shemmehem.

O yitparesh amro "tzidkat Adonai" vegomer, al gad sheasa im Adonai davar sheyyechashev lo litzdaka, vehu sheavar hayyarden lehillachem milchemet mitzva im yisrael. vedavar ze kefi haddin beno leven Adonai eno chayyav bo, ki vaa nachalatam bammakom shebbacharu, veen lahem chiyyuv laavor lehillachem im yoshve haaretz, uchemo shettaanu betaanotehem befarashat mattot (Bamidbar 32:5), uchemo shepperashnum sham, uchemo shehochiach hammaase shehiskim Adonai al nachalatam ki vaa shamma. uma sheavru hayyarden lahem techashev litzdaka, veze lema shennogea lema shebbenam leven Adonai, aval lema shennogea levenam uven yisrael kach shurat haddin notenet.

Vehu amro "umishpatav im yisrael", uchemo shepperashti sham bitshuvat moshe al taanotehem, shekkullam hem kede sheyyihyu nekiyyim meAdonai umiyyisrael, ki en tzorech laAdonai leezrat gevuratam, veyodea haya Adonai shello hayta kavvanatam bishelat haaretz leshum mechush ra, vechol hatteanot shettaan lahem moshe lo hayu ella beerech yisrael achehem.

rashi: Ammim. shel shivte yisrael:
Har yikrau. lehar hammoriyya yeasfu, kol asifa al yede keria hi, vesham yizbechu bargalim zivche tzedek:
Ki shefa yammim yinaku. yissashchar uzevulun, vihe lahem penay laasok battora:

Usefune temune chol. kissuye temune chol, tarit vechillazon uzechuchit levana hayyotzim min hayyam umin hachol, uvechelko shel yissashchar uzevulun haya kemo sheamur bemassechet megilla (daf 6) "zevulun am cheref nafsho lamut" (Shoftim Adonai) mishshum denaftali al merome sade" (sham), haya mitraem zevulun al chelko — leachi natatta sadot ucheramim vechulei (sifre):

Usefune. leshon kissuy, kemo shenneemar (Melachim 1 6) "vayyispon et habbayit", "vesafun baerez" (Yirmeyahu 22, 14) vetargumo "umetolal bechiyyore arza". davar acher — ammim har yikrau al yede perakmatya shel zevulun taggare ummot holam baim el artzo, vehu omed al hassefar vehem omrim hoil venitztaarnu ad kan nelech ad yerushalayim venire ma yiratah shel umma zo uma maaseha, vehem roim kol yisrael ovdim leeloah echad veochlim maachol echad — lefi shehaggoyim eloho shel ze lo cheloho shel ze umaachalo shel ze lo chemaachalo shel ze — vehem omrim en umma keshera kezo umitgayyerin sham, shenneemar sham yizbechu zivche tzedek (sifre):
Ki shefa yammim yinaku. zevulun veyissashochar hayyam noten lahem mamon beshefa:

Vayyomar Adonai missinay ba. patach techilla beshivcho shel makom veachakka patach betzarchehem shel yisrael, uvashshevach sheppatach bo yesh bo hazekarat zechut leyisrael, vechol ze derech ritztzuy hu, kelomar keday hem ellu shettachul alehem beracha (sifre):
Missinay ba. yatza likratam keshebbau lehityatztzev betachtit hahar kechatan hayyotze lehakebil pene challa, shenneemar "likrat haelohim" (Shemot 19), limmedanu sheyyatza chenegdam:
Vezarach misseir lamo. sheppatach livne esav sheyyekabbelu et hattora velo ratzu:
Hofia mehar paran. shehalach sham ufatach livne yishmael sheyyekabbeluha velo ratzu (sifre):
Veata. leyisrael:
Merivvot kodesh — veimmo miktzat rivvot malache kodesh velo chullam velo rubbam, velo chederech basar vadam shemmare kol kevod ashro vetifarto beyom chuppato (sham):

Esh dat. shehayta chetuva meaz lefanav beesh shechora al gav esh levana, natan lahem balluchot ketav yad yemino (80 tanchuma Bereshit 1); davar acher — esh dat ketargumo, shennittena lahem mittoch haesh:
ohc: Vayyomar Adonai missinay ba vegomer. razal amru (sifre): yatza likrat yisrael missinay, vezarach misseir – sheppatach livne esav litten lahem hattora, hofia mehar paran – shehalach gam ken leyishmael. vekashe lamma hitchil bammeuchar shehu "missinay ba" shezze haya achar sheppatach leseir ulefaran velo kibbelu, veyatza likrat yisrael kesheratza littenah lahem. od tzarich ladaat lamma shinna ledabber bishlosha leshonot: "ba", "zarach", "hofia", vehaya lo lechallam yachad al ze hadderech: "missinay ba umisseir umipparan". od lamma besinay hikdim zichron hammakom veachar kach ma shehaya mimmennu, uvefaran veseir hikdim habba veachar kach hammakom?

Achen yitbaer hainyan behair amram zichronam livracha lamma lo zachu haavot, uvifrat yaakov shehayta mittato shelema, latet lahem Adonai torato, veamru (Bereshit Rabba 70,9-14) shehattaam hu lefi sheen shechina shora al pachot mishshishshim ribbo, unetinat hattora tzericha hayta hasheraat shechina, kemo shekken matzinu (Shemot 19:20) "vayyered Adonai al har sinay".

Vehinne yomar haomer: halo matzinu sheafillu shenayim sheyyoshvim veoskim battora, amru bammishna (avot 3:2) shechina sheruya benehem. laze amru kadmonenu yode daat ki ma sheanu omrim shetztzarich shishshim ribbo hu al hasheraat kelalut hashshechina, uma shezzochim asara sheyyoshvim veoskim battora o shenayim hu al ot achat shemmeir mimmenna hammofia bemi sheyyitorer lehiddavek bakkedushsha, kol echad kefi kocho, veen dome hearat shenayim lishlosha ushelosha learbaa, aval kelalut hashshechina enah shora ella al shishshim ribbo miyyisrael.

Vehu maamar hakkatuv "Adonai" – perush, kelalut hashshechina, "missinay ba" lehakebil yisrael, uvetzet hashshechina lehakebil am nivchar, im yetziatah yatzu shene orot uvau, echad derech har seir veechad derech har paran leyisrael sheavru derech sham lesibba yedua. velaze hikdim "missinay ba" shehi biat kelalut hashshechina, veachar kach hodia chelke orah shebbau derech mekomot hallaz. vedikdek lomar "zarach" vehofia" lehair shello halach derech sham ella zericha achat vehofaa achat mimmennu. uleshon hofaa yeamer al chelek muat mehakkedushsha, kederech amram zichronam livracha (makkot 23:) "hofia ruach hakkodesh bemidrashenu", shehu geder katan shebbivchinat hasheraat or hashshechina. veyiches livne seir geder gadol miggeder shel yishmael kefi madregato, ki hu lemala miyyishmael.

Uvaze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim. gam ma shehikdim zichron sinay labbia uveseir uvefaran hikdim lizricha vehofaa, ki bimkom zichron Adonai hu maamar hofia vezarach, vehaven. vehakkavvana bechol hammaamar lehair maalatam leharebot bevirchatam ki reuyim hem livracha, veze midderech harotze levarech bechol libbo leorer haddevarim lehalehiv hallev levarech bechol libbo. vechen timtza sheasa yitzchak kesheratza levarech yaakov, haya mekarvo elav veamar lo (Bereshit 27:26) "gesha na usheka li beni", veze middevarim hammeorrim.

Veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat vaychi befasuk (Bereshit 48:8) "mi elle" beechad min hadderachim, uchemo chen haadon moshe bachar lo leorer ahavat libbo alehem mimma she ahavam veheela otam, venafsho hakkedosha titlahev leehov ahuve elyon, veze echad mishshelemut ahavato behakkadosh baruch hu.

Veata merivvot kodesh. harishonim (Rashi beshem sifre) amru shennitkavven lomar shehevi immo chelek merivvot velo kol velo rov, lehodia anvato yitbarach. uledivrehem yefarshu tevat "veata" bimkom "vehevi", veen ze peshat hatteva. veim yefarshu "veata" hu uva, en meforash im hevi afillu ketzatam. veulay shessovrim shehavaat hammiktzat en hakkatuv tzarich leamro, uma shellamadnu min hakkatuv hu shello hevi immo harivvot kodesh vehinnicham sham.

Vechutz middarkam nire shehakkavvana hu lehair maalatam shel yisrael, ki hinniach Adonai tzeva mala rivvot kodesh uva etzel yisrael, uferush "veata" ba behechlet mehem veasa bimkomam ammo venachalato, vechen haya sheshsham besinay tzivva leyisrael (Shemot 25:8) "veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham" veazav elyonim, vetimtza besefer hazzohar (teruma 140:) kamma nitztaaru tzeva hashshamayim keshekkava Adonai dirat shechinato battachtonim asher bachar lo:

Mimino esh dat lamo. perush, taam shebbachar Adonai lishkon shamma battachtonim "veata merivvot kodesh", lefi shemimino esh dat lamo", vehu al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 33.) befasuk "veyikchu li teruma" mashal lemelech shehissi bitto vechulei, amar hammelech kechi gam oti immah, vehu hattaam shennatan kan livata merivvot" mittaam "mimino esh dat lamo", perush leyisrael.

Veamro "esh dat" velo amar "dat esh", lehasemich tevat "esh" letevat "mimino" lehair shennittena hattora miyyamin umissemol (sifre kan), vehu amro "mimino" – ze yamin, "esh" – ze semol shehu gevura harmuza bivchinat haesh, mishshenehem "dat lamo". vehu sod (Devarim Rabba 3,12, tanchuma yitro 16) esh levana al gabbe shechora, vehu sod keriat hattora tushiyya (yevamot sav., yalkut shemauni ramaz 23) mitztzad haggevura venotenet oz umemshala mitztzad hachesed.

rashi: Veet kol naftali. herahu artzo beshalvatah vechurbanah, veherahu devora uvarak mikkedesh naftali nilchamim im sisra vachayalotav:
Veet eretz efrayim umenashshe. herahu artzam beshalvatah uvechurbanah, veherahu yehoshua nilcham im malche chenaan shebba meefrayim, vegidon shebba mimmenashshe nilcham im midyan vaamalek:
Veet kol eretz yehuda. beshalvatah uvechurbanah, veherahu malchut bet david venitzchonam:

Ad hayyam haacharon. eretz hammaarav beshalvatah uvechurbanah; davar acher — al tikre hayyam haacharon ella hayyom haacharon, herahu hakkabba kol hammeoraot sheatidin leara leyisrael ad sheyyichyu hammetim (sifre):
Umerosh harere kedem. umevorechet mereshit bishshul happerot, sheharareha makdimin levakker bishshul perotehem. davar acher — maggid shekkadma beriatan lishar harim (sham):
Givot olam. gevaot haosot perot leolam veenan poskot meotzer haggeshamim:
Zormu mayim avot. shechakim natfu zerem mayim avim:
Chatzatzecha. kemo chitztzecha:
targum: Achitu maya anane shemaya kalin yahavu shechake lechod kippe girrach azlin umishtalhavin:

rashi: Baggalgal. kemo kaggalgal, kol raamcha kaggalgal al hayyam lahum et machane mitzrayim (Shemot 14:24):
targum: Kal achleyutach begalgela ishtema anhiru verakin tevel rigzat veitregifat ara:

rashi: Uretzon shochni sene. kemo shochen sene; utehe artzo mevorechet mertzono venachat rucho shel hakkabba hannigle alay techilla bassene:
Ratzon. nachat ruach ufiyyus, vechen kol ratzon shebbammikra:
Tavota. beracha zo lerosh yosef:
Nezir echav. shehufrash meechav bimchirato (80 sifre):
ohc: Uretzon shochni sene vegomer. perush sheyyitratztze bo Adonai lehetivo gam bizman sheyyisrael betzaar, vehu siman shechinat sene.

Veamro tavota lerosh yosef ulekadkod vegomer. perush, taam haamur hu keneged shene middot tovot shennimtzeu bo: echad, shehagam sheggala veyarad lemitzrayim, vechamma sibbot haresha hikkifuhu, amad betzidkato, keamram zichronam livracha (Rashi al Shemot 1:5) befasuk "veyosef haya vemitzrayim" hu yosef vegomer, vehu ma sheramaz beamro "lerosh yosef". ucheneged ma sheshillem leechav tova tachat raa, amar "nezir echav", shehizziruhu echav min achvatam, kemo sheddarshu zichronam livracha (Rashi al Bereshit 37:17) befasuk "nasu mizze", veaf al pi chen "vaychalkel yosef" vegomer:

rashi: Umimmeged tevuot shamesh. shehayta artzo petucha lachamma umematteket happerot (sifre):
Geresh yerachim. yesh perot shehallevana mevashshaltan veellu hen kishshuin udeluin; davar acher — geresh yerachim. shehaaretz megareshet umotzia mechodesh lechodesh:
Tiku chaf. hitarvu yachad ze im ze leharia lelohim bekol rinna:
targum: Kol amaya tekau yeda vechedva yabbivu kodam Adonai bekal tushebachta:

rashi: Vezot habberacha … lifne moto. samuch lemitato, sheim lo achshav ematay (sham):
ohc: Vezot habberacha. tzarich ladaat amro "vezot" betosefet vav bitchillat inyan. od tzarich ladaat leeze inyan neemar kol hakkatuv, im lehodia hammevarech vehammitbarech halo nikkarim hem haddevarim belo pasuk ze im haya matchil mippasuk "vayyomer" vegomer, veim lehodia ki ze haya lifne moto samuch lemitato, muvanim hem haddevarim mimma shellefanav uleacharav shessamuch lemitato hayu haddevarim. uma gam ki ma tzorech yesh behodaat hazzeman?

Venire shennitkavven hakkatuv leshabbeach ish haelohim ma gadlu maasav. hinne bapparasha hakkodemet laze samuch lemaamar "vezot habberacha" millefaneha, amar hakkatuv hechlet haggezera al moshe lamut beamro (Devarim 32:49) "ale el har haavarim vegomer umut vegomer al asher" vegomer, veim ken yomar haomer ki ze moshe haish tina haya belibbo al mitato asher haya lah sibba im bene yisrael, achar sheratz acharehem kesus (midrash tanchuma) garmu lo mita bechutz laaretz umenauhu meavor laaretz asher nichsefa vegam kalta nafsho lah. veteva enosh yarchik hassovev ra, vahagam sheyyadua hu hatztzaddik lesavlan achar hayyecholet, ze yoil shello lisno otam, aval kurvat hallev hi nimnaat al kol panim. laze ba devar Adonai betorato veheid al hatztzaddik veamar ki millevad shello sane otam velo hirchikam millibbo, od lo "zot habberacha" vegomer. velaze amar "vezot" betosefet vav lehair geder hakkodem sheyyistovev mehammaamar hassamuch, vehaven.

Vegamar omer "lifne moto", perush samuch lemitato, lehaid od al hafelagat tzidkuto, dahagam dizman hahergesh shehu perek hannesia shehaddavar yechayyev lisno, af al pi chen berach otam, veheid hakkatuv al habberacha heyotah meulla ushelema bechol libbo bema shekkatav vav bitchillat teva lehair al ma rav gadlah.

Od yirtze beamro "vezot" vegomer, leheyot shekkadmu berachot acherim – avraham berach et yitzchak, veyitzchak leyaakov, veyaakov levanav, vechullan nitkabbetzu lerosh yisrael. laze keshebba moshe levarech yisrael dikdek bidvarav ki birchato hi tosefet al harishonim, al derech sheppershu zichronam livracha (sifre) befasuk (Devarim 1:11) "Adonai elohe avotechem yosef vegomer vivarech etchem" vegomer, shehakkavvana zo hi mishshelli vivarech etchem vegomer, hare shemmakpid ledakdek asher hu mosif levarech, uchemo chen heid kan ki birchato hi tosefet al birchot harishonim, vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar "vezot".
Veamro "habberacha" beHei, meida hattora shehi hammeulla vehammeshubbachat yoter mikkullan, vegamar hakkatuv lomar haddevarim shebbahem titalle al kol beracha.
Ha) "asher berach moshe", veyadua hu maalato kemo shekkatav elohe olam behochicho aharon umiryam (Bamidbar 12:7), vesham perashti.

2) "Ish haelohim" – tze ulemad me atzmu razal (midrash tanchuma 2) lidrosh beteva zo, ad shehiggiu lomar shehu al derech amro (Rut 1:3) "ish noomi", vehakkavvana shemmoshe haya gozer vaAdonai mekayyem, vehaven. veayyen ma shennefaresh besiyyata dishmayya besamuch:

3) "Et bene yisrael", shehem keli muchan lekabbel habberachot ma shello haya ad atta, vetze ulemad shello sharta shechina bichlalutam ella al bene yisrael ki nitkabbetzu kochot hakkedushsha shehem bemispar shishshim ribbo. veamro "et bene yisrael" velo hispik lomar "bene", ulay shennitkavven letzaref immahem hanneelama meene kol chay shehi hashshechina, shehi im yisrael afillu betzara, dichtiv (tehillim 91:15) "immo anochi vetzara". vidiat hahafachim shava, shennitkavven moshe shehu hashshoshvin levarchah immahem.

4) "Lifne moto", ki hagam sheggadol erech moshe, tosef rucho vechocho beet asher yaggia haet asher yeasef el ammav, uletzad haarbaa teamim higdilah Adonai veyichadah lemala mikkullam beamro "vezot habberacha".

Od yirmoz beamro "vezot" al derech amram zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni, sifre kan) shello zacha moshe sheyyikkare ish haelohim ad shebberach et yisrael, vehu ma sheheir beamro "vezot", perush, millevad kol asher paal veasa mehayyosher, keshehosif zot habberacha asher berach moshe et bene yisrael, baze nikra ish haelohim.

Ish haelohim. yitbaer hakkatuv al derech amram zichronam livracha (arachin 17.) veze leshonam: im yavo hakkadosh baruch hu leshev bedin im avraham yitzchak veyaakov enam yecholim laamod befanav, ad kan. ha lamadta ki ma shemmoilim hatztzaddikim bemaasehem uvehitatztzemutam baolam hazze eno ella lizkot mikkoach harachamim aval bedin lo, uchemaamar david (tehillim 143:2): "veal tavo vemishpat et avdecha ki lo yitzdak lefanecha kol chay", perush kol tzaddik sheyyikkare chay. vechan hodia hakkatuv ki tzaddik ze nitatztzem ufaal hattov afillu beerech bechinat haddin haramuz beelohim", vehu amro "ish haelohim", veim yavo Adonai laamod immo bedin – yuchal, ki hifli laasot hattov vehayyashar.

Od nitkavven bemaamar ze lehaid alav ki kol hitatztzemo bammiddot hattovot hayyeduot lo lo hayu ella letzad yirato meelohav, lo shehaya tivo mesayyeo el haddavar, keamram zichronam livracha (yoma 22:) shaul beachat velo alta lo vedavid vechulei, ki shaul haya mittivo mazug velo haya cham umahir litot, velaze beachat sheshshagag yatzta mimmennu hammelucha lefi tivo. meshaarim bene elyon sheim haya ketivo shel david admoni haya ose kedavid eser yadot. vehen haish moshe yesh makom lachshov shehaya anav mittivo vehaya bechullan [savlan] mittivo, laze heida hattora alav shekkol hitatztzemuto vetigbarto haramuz betevat "ish" haya letzad haelohim haya yare, vehu amro "ish haelohim".

Od yirmoz al ze hadderech "ish haelohim" – shello kam velo yakum kemoto. venitkavven hakkatuv bismichut "et bene yisrael" lemaamar "ish haelohim" lehaggid shemmadrega zo hissigah im bene yisrael, perush, beemtzaut ma shettarach bahem uma shessaval mehem vehammistaef meemtzaut hanehagato hattova immahem hissig madrega zo likkare ish haelohim.

rashi: Minnachal badderech yishte vegomer. minnilus hannahar bederech halichato hayta artzo shota velo hayta tzericha leme geshamim, al ken haya merim rosh umitpaer "li yeori vaani asitini" (Yechezkel 29:3). inyan acher yesh lefaresh hammizmor hazze bedavid:
(1) Neum Adonai ladoni. al iske adoni shaul, keshehayiti nirdaf mippanav:
Ladoni. al adoni, kemo "veamar paro livne yisrael" (Shemot 14:3), "vayyishalu anshe hammakom leishto" (Bereshit 26:7):
Shev limini. hitakkev vehameten lishuati:
(2) Matte uzzecha yishlach Adonai mitztziyyon. maasim tovim hametzuyyanin beyadcha. davar acher: od timloch betziyyon, vesham yeshullach lecha matte oz, veaz tirde bekerev oyvecha:

(3) Ammecha nedavot beyom chelecha. am yisrael yitnaddevu leezratcha beyom shettaase chayil, kemo shemmeforash (divrei hayamim 1 12:21) shehayu nikbatzim alav mikkol shevet vashevet "belechto el tziklag naflu alav mimmenashshe vegomer" "umin haggadi nivdelu el david vegomer" (sham;9):
Behadere kodesh merechem mishchar. bishvil haderat kedushsha shehoyo vecha minneurecha:
Lecha tal yaldutecha. yaldut tova uferek nae shehaya becha, tihye lecha kattal shehu naim vearev, vetaase lecha perot lehatzelichacha:
(4) Nishba Adonai vegomer. shehammalchut tehe shellecha olamit:
Atta chohen leolam. veezo min hakkehunnot? kehunna shehi lemala mikkehunnat malki tzedek, vezehu hammalchut shehi lemala mikkehunna gedola bishloshim maalot (avot 6:5):
Al divrati malki tzedek. lemala mikkehunnat malki tzedek shehaya "kohen leel elyon" (Bereshit 14:18), veim tomar: af hu melech haya, meluchat malki tzedek enah melucha chashuva keneged yisrael:
(5) Adoni. yihye tamid al yemincha lehoshiacha:
Asher machatz beyom appo melachim. shennilchamu im avraham (Bereshit 14:15) veim yehoshua (Yehoshua 10-12) veim barak (Shoftim 4-5):

(6) Yadin baggoyim male geviyyot. veod bime chizkiyyahu bincha yadin beucheluse sancheriv kibbutz pegarim metim, veyimchatz besancheriv shehu roshah shel ninve veashshur shehi eretz rabba, asher minnachal badderech haya shote, shennitpaer sheshshatu uchelusav mime hayyarden, shenneemar (Yeshayahu 37:25) "ani karti veshatiti mayim veachariv vegomer":
(7) Al ken yarim rosh. haya mishtabbeach umitpaer begadlo:
targum: Mippum neviya beorcha ulefan yekabbel metul hechna yizkof resha:

rashi: Haomer leaviv uleimmo lo reitiv. keshechatu vaegel veamarti "mi laAdonai elay" (Shemot 32), neesfu elay kol bene levi vetzivvitim laharog et avi immo vehu miyyisrael o et achiv meimmo o ven bitto, vechen asu. vei efshar lefaresh aviv mammash veachiv meaviv vechen banav mammash, shehare leviyyim hem, umishshevet levi lo chata echad mehem, shenneemar (sham) "kol bene levi":
Ki shamru imratecha. "lo yihye lecha elohim acherim" (Shemot 20, 2):
Uveritcha yintzoru. berit mila, sheotam shennoldu bammidbar shel yisrael lo malu et benehem, vehem hayu mulin umalin et benehem:
ohc: (9~10) Haomer vegomer yoru mishpatecha vegomer. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava batra 60.) bemaase shebbau ladun al ilan shehaya mazzik lederech harabbim vechulei, veamar lahem ad lemachar vechulei, veshalach vekatz vechulei, ad kan. vehu amro "haomer" vegomer, adam kaze rauy lehorot mishpat vechulei, ki en makom lomar lo "tol kora" vechulei (bava batra 15:), veze lecha haot "haomer leaviv uleimmo".

Od yirtze, lefi shetztzivva "shoftim vegomer lishvatecha" (Devarim 16:18), veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sifre) shetztzarich sheyyemanne dayyanim lechol shevet, laze amar ki shevet levi letzad ma shehochachnu shello nasu fanim leav uleach uleven reuyim hem lehitmannot al kol shivte yisrael, vehu amro "yoru mishpatecha leyaakov" bederech kelal, ki en lachush sheyyisu fanim leshivtam yoter mishshevet zulatam.

rashi: Ulelevi amar. veal levi amar:
Tummecha veurecha. kelappe shechina hu medabber:
Asher nissito bemassa. shello nitlonnu im shear hammallinim:
Terivehu vegomer. ketargumo. davar acher — terivehu al me meriva, nistakkafta lo lavo vaalila, im moshe amar shimu na hammorim, aharon umiryam me asu? (sifre):
ohc: Ulelevi amar tummecha vegomer. perush, yitkayyem beyado davar ze ulezaro acharav kehunnat olam.

Asher nissito bemassa. perush, lefi sheyyaakov amar al levi beshittuf im shimon "kele chamas vegomer arur appam ki az" vegomer (Bereshit 49:5,7), laze amar ki levi nitnassa sheeno baal af veevra shennitnassa bemassa, perush lo shennissahu Adonai, ella sheraa bo nissayon, shekkol shivte yisrael nissu Adonai dichtiv (Shemot 17:7) "veal nassotam et Adonai", velo chen levi, ha lamadta sheshshachach rugezam.

rashi: Veet hannegev. eretz haddarom. davar acher — mearat hammachpela shenneemar "vayyaalu vannegev vayyavo ad chevron" (Bamidbar 13):
Veet hakkikkar. herahu shelomo yotzek kele vet hammikdash, shenneemar (Melachim 1 7) "bechikkar hayyarden yetzakam hammelech bemaave haadama" (sifre):
Asher yedao Adonai panim el panim. shehaya libbo gas bo umedabber elav bechol et sherotze, kainyan shenneemar "veatta eele el Adonai" (Shemot 32), "imdu veeshmea ma yetzavve lachem" (Bamidbar 9):
ohc: Velo kam navi od. perush – velo kam ad atta. veamro "od", perush – velo yakum od kamohu.

Veamro beyisrael – ramaz shekkol hassagat nevuato hayta beemtzaut yisrael, vetze ulemad mehashshanim shehayu yisrael nezufim lo nidbar immo Adonai. verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (sifre Devarim 34:10) aval beummot haolam vechulei:

rashi: Vayyikbor oto. hakkabba bichvodo. rabbi yishmael omer hu kavar et atzmo, vezehu echad mishshelosha etin shehaya rabbi yishmael doresh ken. kayyotze vo "beyom melot yeme nizro yavi oto" (Bamidbar 6) — hu mevi et atzmo. kayyotze vo "vehissiu otam avon ashma" (Vayikra 22) vechi acherim massiin otam? ella hem massiim et atzmam:
Mul bet peor. kivro haya muchan sham mishsheshet yeme vereshit lechapper al maase feor, veze echad min haddevarim shennivreu ben hashshemashot beerev shabbat (avot 84; fesachim 54):
ohc: Ad hayyom hazze. hem divre Adonai, shehaya omer umoshe kotev, uchemo chen maamarim hakkodmim laze, "vayyamat sham moshe", "vayyikbor oto".

Veraiti leharav rabbi avraham ben ezra shekkatav sheyyehoshua katav ken. veen rauy lichtov kaddevarim haelle bifshate hakketuvim, shemmoshe lo hishlim hassefer tora shemmasar lalviyyim, shebbeaznay shamati mibbene ammenu mistabbechim bedavar ze umesaafim mizze kefira battora, vezo hi taanat haggoyim, shemmibbene yisrael tikkenu hammichtav venimtza bah ma shello haya velo haya ma shehaya. veyishtakka haddevarim vedomehem, hasebbi enayich minnegdam. vehaikkar shekkol hassefer tora ketavo moshe, ucheamram (bava batra 15.) hishlimo bedema.

rashi: Rasha kegova appo. shehu geva ruach, umagbiah vezokef panav veappo begavhuto:
Bal yidrosh. kol mezimmotav omrot lo: bal yidrosh hakkadosh baruch hu kol ma sheeese, ki en mishpat:
En elohim. let din velet dayyan (shabbat kana.):
targum: Rashia begasut rucheh la yitbar elaha veyemar belibbeh dela galyan kodam Adonai kulehon machshevatoy:

rashi: Shiru laAdonai. kol elle leatid:
targum: Tushebchat nevua shabbachu kodam Adonai shevach chadat arum perishan avad perikat leh yemineh veedra shechinat kudesheh:

rashi: Nishba Adonai velo yinnachem. lefi shehaya mityare shello yeanesh al hauchelosin sheharag, neemar lo (Bereshit 15:1) "al tira avram vegomer". lo yinnachem al hattova asher dibber alecha:
Atta chohen leolam al divrati malki tzedek. mimmecha tetze hakkehunna umalchut, lihyot banecha yorshin et shem avi avicha hakkehunna vehammalchut shennittenu lo:

Divrati malki tzedek. yod yetera, kemo "rabbati am" (Eicha 1:1). al divrat malki tzedek – al pekuddat malki tzedek. atta chohen. yesh bemashma kohen – kehunna userara, kemo "uvene david kohanim hayu" (Shmuel 2 8:18):
targum: Kayam Adonai vela yetuv deant mitmane lerabba lealma deate begin zechuta dahaveta melach zakkay:

rashi: Raucha mayim. rabbim keshennigleta al hayyam (Shemot 14:21):
targum: Chamon shechintach bego yama elaha chamon gevuretach al yama retattun amaya lechod itragzun tehomaya:

rashi: Ki hillel rasha. musav al lamma Adonai taamod berachok, ki atta amalek harasha mithallel shemmassig kol taavat nafsho:
Uvotzea berech nietz Adonai. vehaggazlan shibbach et atzmo lemor: nietz Adonai, veshalom yihye li (Devarim 29:18):

Berech. kemo berach, leshon piel. veteda, sheillu haya shem davar, haya hattaam lemala baot harishona, vehaya nakud pattach, veze nakud kamatz katan vetaamo lematta baresh. veal titma al berech shello amar berach, sheharebe tevot shel resh meshammeshot kach, kegon "oyev cheref Adonai" (tehillim 74:18), velo neemar cheraf:
Nietz. kemo cheref, vechen kol leshon niutz. kach patar menachem:
targum: Metul deishtabbach rashia al rigrug nafsheh dimvarach gavra taloma marchak memra daAdonai:

rashi: Bechor shoro. yesh vechor shehu leshon gedulla umalchut, shenneemar "af ani bechor ettenehu" (Tehillim 89), vechen "beni vechori yisrael" (Shemot 4) — melech hayyotze mimmennu, vehu yehoshua shekkocho kashe keshor lichbosh kamma melachim:
Hadar lo. natun lo, shenneemar "venatatta mehodcha alav" (Bamidbar 27):
Vekarne reem karnav. shor kocho kashe, veen karnav naot, aval reem karnav naot veen kocho kashe, natan lihoshua kocho shel shor veyofi karne reem (sifre):

Afse aretz. sheloshim veechad melachim efshar shekkullam meeretz yisrael hayu? ella en lecha kol melech veshilton shello kana lo falterin vaachuzza beeretz yisrael shechashuva lechullam hi, shenneemar (Yirmeyahu 3) "nachalat tzevi tzivot goyim" (80 sifre):
Vehem rivvot efrayim. otam hamenuggachim hem harvavot sheharag yehoshua shebba meefrayim:
Vehem alfe menashshe. hem haalafim sheharag gidon bemidyan shenneemar (Shoftim 8) "vezevach vetzalmunna bakkarkor vegomer":
ohc: Bechor shoro vegomer. kan berech shene gedolim hayyotzim miyyosef, veamar keneged menashshe habbechor "bechor shoro hadar lo", remez legidon, vechinna lo et hashshor, remez lema sheamar malach Adonai legidon (Shoftim 6:25) "kach et par hashshor asher leavicha vegomer velakachta et happar hashsheni vehaalita ola" vegomer:

Veamro hadar lo, keamro sham (Shoftim 7:2) "vayyomer Adonai el gidon rav haam asher ittach mittitti et midyan beyadam pen yitpaer alay yisrael lemor yadi hoshia li". vehu happeer hu hehadar haamur kan, shello alu miyyisrael ella anashim muatim, uvaze tihye hatteshua hadar lammoshia, vehu amro hadar lo.

Vekarne reem karnav. hu keneged yehoshua habba meefrayim, shehaya shamo bechol haaretz, asher giddelo Adonai veherim maalato kekarne reem, "bahem ammim yenaggach" vegomer, ki chishmoa malche haemori et asher haya Adonai immo lo kama od ruach bahem mippanav.

Vechazar uferash moshe devarav, ki shene habberachot sheamar hem keneged shene hashshevatim, vehu amro "vehem rivvot efrayim vehem alfe menashshe", vahagam shebbabberacha hikdim lomar "bechor shoro" shehu keneged menashshe, lefi shebbirchato ketanna mibbirkat efrayim, hitchil bammuat lehosif velaalot babberacha, ucheshehizkiram hikdim birkat efrayim kefi gedullatan, sheggedullat yehoshua gedola miggedullat gidon:

rashi: Lo chahata eno. af mishshemmet:
Lo nas lecho. lachluchit shebbo, lo shalat bo rikkavon velo nehpach toar panav:
ohc: Ben mea veesrim shana bemoto. perush, im yetziat nafsho nigmeru hammea veesrim shana. od nitkavven lehasemich "bemoto" lemaamar "lo chahata eno", lehair sheachar mita hu omer "lo chahata" vegomer.

rashi: Yechi reuven. baolam hazze:
Veal yamut laolam habba, shello yizzacher lo maase vilha (80 sham):
Vihi metav mispar. nimnin beminyan shear echav, dugma hi zo, kainyan shenneemar (Bereshit 35) "vayyishkav et bilha, vayyihyu vene yaakov shenem asar", shello yatza min hamminyan:
ohc: Yechi reuven vegomer vihi metav vegomer. amro "yechi reuven", rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sifre Devarim 347) shehitpallel al reuven sheyyihye lo chelek laolam habba. veulay efshar lomar shennitkavven al gedole hashshevet shemmetu baadat korach, keamram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 18:3) ki matayim vachamishshim ish kullan hayu rashe sanhedraot verubban mishshevet reuven keamram zichronam livracha (Rashi Bamidbar 16:1). ulefi sheyyesh makom lomar sheadat korach en lahem chelek laolam habba (sanhedrin kat:), laze hitpallel "yechi reuven" perush shivto, vahagam shello hayu ella matayim vachamishshim ish, leheyotam gedolehem yitkanne hashshevet kullo alehem.

O efshar sheal reuven atzmo hu omer, ella shehu mehattaam atzmo, ki kesheyyitkatztzetzu anafim shel gedol hashshevet yiggara mitztzaddik shehu reuven eno, laze hitpallel sheyyichye laolam habba, veze maskim kisvarat haomer (sanhedrin kach.) adat korach yesh lahem chelek laolam habba.

Vihi metav mispar. hitpallel alehem sheyyihyu tzaddikim, lefi shennamakku hashsharashim bimora gedolehem bemaase korach kaamur besamuch, laze hitpallel "vihi metav mispar", perush al derech amram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 26.) sheamar chizkiyya lifne hakkadosh baruch hu "rabbim asher et shevna" vegomer, veheshiv hakkadosh baruch hu en minyan larshaim, laze amar moshe bemetek leshono "metav mispar", perush shello yihyu reshaim, sheaz en minyan lahem, vetoil tefillat tzaddik al haddavar besod "tzaddik moshel beyirat elohim" (Shmuel 2 23:3, ayyen shabbat 63.):

rashi: Levinyamin amar. lefi shebbirkat levi baavodat hakkarbanot veshel binyamin bevinyan bet hammikdash, bechelko, semachan ze laze, vesamach yosef acharav, sheaf hu mishkan shilo haya vanuy vechelko, shenneemar (tehillim 78) "vayyimas beohel yosef vegomer", ulefi shebbet olamim chaviv mishshilo lechach hikdim binyamin leyosef:
Chofef alav. mechasse oto umegen alav:
Kol hayyom. leolam, mishshennivchara yerushalayim lo sharta shechina bemakom acher:

Uven ketefav shachen. begova artzo haya vet hammikdash banuy, ella shennamuch esrim veshalosh amma meen etam, vesham haya dato shel david livnoto, kidita vishchitat kadashim (zevachim 54) amre nitte veh pureta, mishshum dichtiv "uven ketefav shachen" — en lecha nae bashshor yoter mikketefav:
ohc: Levinyamin amar. perush tevat "levinyamin" hu divre moshe, vetevat "amar" hu divre hakkatuv, sheim lo chen bamme yuvan haddavar sheal binyamin hu omer, vechen "leyosef" velizvulun" vegomer.
Veamro "yishkon lavetach alav". perush, ma taam yishkon lavetach? "alav", perush al heyoto shecheno shel shochen habbira, ki mi yavo achar hammelech:

rashi: Vayyamot sham moshe. efshar moshe met vechatav vayyamot sham moshe? ella ad kan katav moshe, mikkan vaelach katav yehoshua. rabbi meir omer efshar sefer hattora chaser kelum vehu omer (lo, 26) "lakoach et sefer hattora hazze"? ella hakkabba omer umoshe chotev bedema (sifre; 4 15, menachot 30):
Al pi Adonai. binshika:
ohc: Vayyamat sham. perush, sham levad hu shemmet, aval hu chay bemakom acher kadosh veelyon al pi Adonai.

Veamro lechol haotot vegomer – nimshach im ma shellemala "yedao Adonai panim el panim" lechol haotot, perush letzorech haotot vegomer, vehakkavvana sheal kol ot umofet sheshshelacho Adonai laasot, haya yodo panim befanim.

Od yitbaer al pi ma shekkatav harambam behilchot deot shehannavi sheyyakum beyisrael en tzarich sheyyaase moftim gedolim keotam sheasa moshe, ella kol shehu mehammoftim sheyyaase vechulei. vetimtza shebbishne mekomot amra hattora chozek haemuna bemoshe: 1, al hayyam dichtiv (Shemot 14:31) "vayyaaminu baAdonai uvemoshe avdo". 2, bemattan tora dichtiv (Shemot 19:9) "vegam becha yaaminu leolam".

Veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk "dabber atta immanu venishmaa" (Shemot 20:16), shepperashti unekabbela, shekkevar hitzdiku nevuato behatzedaka muregeshet ugeluya lahem, velaze ba devar Adonai veamar "velo kam navi od beyisrael" vegomer:

Hattaam ki moshe natan kol haotot, ma sheen navi acher ose kaze, veen tzarich lomar kullan. veod "lechol hayyad hachazaka" shehu keriat yam suf shebbo heeminu, "ulechol hammora haggadol" shehu bemaamad har sinay, shebbo gamru lehaamin lo yakum od navi sheyyaase kaze:

Vegamar omer "leene kol yisrael", perush shehem beatzman rau haddevarim, velo letzad haemuna keseder sheosim bishar hanneviim habbaim acharav, ella beenehem rau ki moshe nevi Adonai emet vetorato torat elohim chayyim emet.
Chassalat parashat vezot habberacha

rashi: Dan gur arye. af hu haya samuch lassefar, lefichach moshlo baarayot (sham):

Yezannek min habbashan. ketargumo, shehaya hayyarden yotze mechelko mimmearat pamyas, vehi leshem shehi vechelko shel dan, shenneemar (Yehoshua 19) "vayyikreu leleshem dan", vezinnuko vekillucho min habbashan. davar acher — ma zinnuk ze yotze mimmakom echad venechelak lishne mekomot, kach shivto shel dan natlu chelek bishne mekomot, techilla natlu vitzfonit maaravit — ekron usevivoteha — velo safku lahem, uvau venilchamu im leshem shehi pamyas, vehi bitzfonit mizrachit — shehare hayyarden yotze mimmearat pamyas vehi bemizrachah shel eretz yisrael uva mehatztzafon laddarom, vechale viktze yam hammelach shehu bemizrach yehuda shennatal bidromah shel eretz yisrael — kemo shemmeforash besefer yehoshua, vehu shenneemar (sham) "vayyetze gevul bene dan mehem vayyaalu vene dan vayyillachamu im leshem vegomer" — yatza gevulam mikkol oto haruach shehitchilu linchol bo (sifre):
ohc: Gur arye. ulay shennitkavven el shimshon sheshshissa haarye keshassa haggedi (Shoftim 14,6). veamro "yezannek", remez litzlichat alav ruach Adonai vedilleg leshasseo kimdalleg mehar bashan:

rashi: Seva ratzon. shehayta artzo sevea kol retzon yoshveha:
Yam vedarom yerasha. yam kinneret nafla bechelko, venatal melo chevel cherem bidromah, lifros charamim umichmorot (102 81):

Yerasha. leshon tziuuy, kemo "ale resh" (Devarim 1), vehattaam shellemala baresh mochiach, kemo selach, yeda, lekach, shema, keshemmosif bo hei yihye hattaam lemala selacha, yedaa, lekacha, shemaa, af kan yerasha leshon tziuuy, uvammasoret haggedola matzinu bealfa beta leshon tziuuy detamehon milleel:
Ashrecha yisrael. leachar shepparat lahem habberachot, amar lahem ma li lifrot lachem kol davar? hakkol shellachem:
Ashrecha, mi chamocha. teshuatcha baAdonai, asher hu magen ezrecha vecherev gaavatecha:
Veyikkachashu oyvecha lach. kegon haggivonim sheamru "meeretz rechoka bau avadecha vegomer" (Yehoshua 9):
Veatta al bamotemo tidroch. kainyan shenneemar "simu et raglechem al tzavvere hammelachim haelle" (sham 10):
ohc: Ashrecha vegomer nosha baAdonai. perush, shekkol haummot sarehem nilchamim lahem kayyadua, uvaze yesh lachush sheyyigba alav sar shekkenegdo, o Adonai yiggefennu, keamro (Shemot 14:30) "vayyar yisrael et mitzrayim met" vegomer, veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 21:5) sheheram Adonai saro shel mitzrayim met lifnehem, ma sheen ken yisrael ashrehem shetteshuatam hi baAdonai, shehu bichvodo nilcham lahem, uvaze charbam gevoha veomedet belo mechush.

Od yirtze beamro "nosha baAdonai", perush shehammelech nosha bitshuato, keamro (Devarim 30:3) "veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha", veamru zichronam livracha (Megila 29.) "veheshiv" lo neemar ella "veshav", ashrav vechulei, vehu amro "ashrecha mi chamocha" sheatta am nosha im Adonai shehu magen ezrecha, vaasher hu cherev gavhutecha, sheen cherev gedola kecherev laAdonai beshalfo otah mittarah.

rashi: Barzel unechoshet minalecha. achshav hu medabber keneged kol yisrael, shehayu gibborehem yoshvim beare hassefar venoalim otah shello yuchelu haoyvim likkanes bah, keilu hi segura vemanulim uverichim shel barzel unechoshet. davar acher, barzel unechoshet minalecha — artztzechem neula beharim shechotzvin mehem barzel unechoshet, veartzo shel asher hayta manulah shel eretz yisrael (sifre):

Ucheyamecha dovecha. ucheyamim shehem tovim lecha, shehen yeme techillatcha, yeme neurecha, ken yihyu yeme ziknatcha, shehem doavim zavim umitmottim. davar acher, ucheyamecha dovecha keminyan yamecha — kol hayyamim asher attem osim retzono shel makom — yihye davecha, shekkol haaratzot yihyu dovot kesef vezahav leeretz yisrael, shettehe mevorechet beferot vechol haaratzot mitparnesot hemenna umamshichot lah kaspam uzehavam, ashekaveranet, hakkesef vehazzahav kale mehem shehen mezivot oto leartzechem:
Tora. asher tzivva lanu moshe morasha hi likhillat yaakov, achaznuha velo naazvenna:
ohc: Tora tzivva lanu moshe vegomer. yesh lehair, kevan shehu hamedabber, haya lo lomar "tora tzivviti lachem" vegomer. veulay ki pasuk ze nismach lema shellefanav, al ze hadderech: yissa am yisrael middabberotecha bekol echad kullam "tora tzivva lanu moshe" vegomer, vechen hem haddevarim shekkol yisrael yachdav yisu kolam biftichat hattora.

Veamro "tora tzivva lanu" vegomer, anu mekabbelim otah morasha kehillat vegomer. uferush "tzivva lanu" efshar lefarshah leoz malchut, keamram zichronam livracha en tzav ella malchut, shehimlichah alenu sheal piha yakum davar, vegam hammelech asher yamlichu alehem yihye al pi hattora, veotah yichtov veyasim lefanav keamro (Devarim 17:18) "vechatav lo" vegomer, vehu maamar hakkatuv (Mishlei 8:15) "bi melachim yimlochu". ulemala befasuk "af chovev" perashnu hakkatuv beofen acher al nachon.

rashi: Yoru mishpatecha. reuyin ellu lechach:
Vechalil. ola (yoma 26):
Yidlak. yirdof, kemo "ki dalakta acharay" (Bereshit 31:36):
Yittafsu bimzimmot zu chashavu. nitpasim hem haaniyyim bimzimmot sheharshaim choshvim alehem:
targum: Begasot rashia yidlak anya yitachdun benichluta dena di chashavu lemebad:

rashi: Ammecha nedavot beyom chelecha. keshetteesof chayil lirdof acharehem, yitnaddevu ammecha veohavecha latzet immecha, kemo shemmatzinu (Bereshit 14:14) "vayyarek et chanichav yelide veto" velo yoter, veaner veeshkol umamre hitnaddevu mealehem latzet lalechet acharav beezrato:
Behadere kodesh merechem mishchar. zot tihye lecha bizchut haderat kedushsha shehaya becha mibbeten immecha, shehikkir boro ben shalosh shanim (nedarim lev.):
Merechem mishchar. mishshennafalta min harechem, kemo meshilin perot derech arubba beyom tov (betza la:), veikka detane mashchirin:
Lecha tal yaldutecha. lecha yechashev yaldutecha. darche yosher shehinhagta bahem beyaldutecha yihye lecha lenoam, kattal ze shehu naim venoach:
targum: Amach devet yisrael demitnadvin leorayta beyom agachuta kerava tistaya beshivhore kudesha rachamin deelaha yistarhavun lach hech nachatat tala lerochatzan toldatach:

rashi: Vene yisrael. hazzecharim, aval beaharon mittoch shehaya rodef shalom venoten shalom ben ish lereehu uven ishsha levalah neemar (Bamidbar 20, 29) "kol bet yisrael" — zecharim unekevot (485 97):
ohc: Vayyivku vene yisrael. uveaharon amar (Bamidbar 20:29) "kol bet yisrael", rabbotenu zichronam livracha (avot derabbi natan perek 12) natnu taam lefi shehaya ohev shalom vechulei.

Verabbi avraham ben ezra katav shebbachu kol bet yisrael lichvod moshe shehaya chay, veen lehaamin leferusho, sheen lehattil mum bammaase hattov sheasu yisrael sheasauhu bishvil moshe shehaya chay, ulemoshe atzmo keshemmet heelimu mehachem behespedo.

Veulay yesh latet taam, ki aharon lo yadu bemitato kodem shemmet, verau pitom shemmet, vedavar kaze yeorer kol lev liftoach mekor dimat eno, ma sheen ken moshe shekkevar yadu mitato, uvechol devarav vetochchotav asher asa haya omer lahem (Devarim 4:22) "ki anochi met vegomer enenni over" vegomer, velaze lo hucham hespedo keaharon.

Od efshar ki mitat aharon hirgishatam beyoter, lefi shettechef nistalleku anne chavod vehusar mesukkatam, veze sibbev biat hakkenaani vegomer (Bamidbar 21:1), laze nitorru yachad kol yisrael livkot, ma sheen ken bemitat moshe, hagam shennittelu ananim vechulei, lo heiru al ze, gam nitredu besimchat biat haaretz hattova.

Od efshar, shebbemitat moshe techef rau davar chadash, sheshsharta shechina al yehoshua velakchu nechama. mashal lemi shenneevda lo margalit umatza acheret bimkomah, lu yehi sheenah doma af al pi chen yitnachem bah, velaze lo bachu kullan, vehu ma shessamach lemaamar "vayyivku" "vihoshua bin nun" vegomer. ma sheen ken bemitat aharon ibbedu margalit velo matzu bema yitnachamu, vahagam shennitmanna elazar tachtav lechohen gadol, af al pi chen lo bochim al chesron kehuna gedola, ella al chesron toaliyyot shemmeatzmo, shello haya lahem temurato.

rashi: Baruch mibbanim asher. raiti vesifre — en lecha vechol hashshevatim shennitbarech bevanim keasher, veeni yodea ketzad:

Yehi retzuy echav. shehaya mitratztze leechav beshemen anpikinon uvekappelaot, vehem meratztzin lo bitvua. davar acher — yehi retzuy echav shehayu venotav naot, vehu shenneemar bedivre hayyamim (22 7) "hu avi virzayit", shehayu venotav nesuot lechohanim gedolim umelachim hannimshachim beshemen zayit:
Vetovel bashshemen raglo. shehayta artzo moshechet shemen kemayan, umaase shennitztarchu anshe ludekiyya leshemen, minnu lahem pulemusetus echad, vechulei chidita vimnachot (daf 85):
ohc: Baruch mibbanim asher vegomer. perashti befarashat naso befasuk "nasi livne asher" vegomer (Bamidbar 7:72).

rashi: Mevorechet Adonai artzo. shello hayta venachalat hashshevatim eretz melea chol tuv keartzo shel yosef (80 sifre):
Mimmeged. leshon adanim umetek:
Umittehom. shehattehom ole umelachleach otah millematta; atta motze vechol hashshevatim birchato shel moshe meen birchato shel yaakov:
ohc: Mevorechet Adonai artzo. ulay lefi sheatidin lomar bene yosef lihoshua shetztzar lahem hammakom lihyotam am rav (Yehoshua 17:14), laze berach artzam lehitrachev. od lefi sheyyosef zan ufirnes kol yisrael, umatzinu sheheela Adonai alav bishvil ze keillu yeladam, dichtiv (tehillim 77:16) "bene yaakov veyosef sela", veamru zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 19:) lefi sheppirnesam nikreu al shemo, laze bercho berov tovat haaretz midda keneged midda.

rashi: Adonay. asher haya al yemincha bammilchama:

Machatz beyom appo melachim. et arbaa melachim hu yadin baggoyim male geviyyot, zo hi besorat berit ben habbetarim shenneemar lo al mitzrayim: "vegam et haggoy asher yaavodu dan anochi" (Bereshit 15:14):
targum: Shechinta dayya al yeminach mecha veyom rugezeh malchaya:

rashi: Vayhi. hakkabba:
Vishurun melech. tamid ol malchuto alehem:
Behitassef. bechol hitassef rashe cheshbon asifatam:

Rashe. kemo (Shemot 30) "ki tissa et rosh", reuyin ellu sheavarchem. davar acher — behitassef. behitassefam yachad baagudda achat veshalom benehem, hu malkam, velo kesheyyesh machaloket benehem (sifre):
ohc: Vayhi vishurun melech behitassef vegomer. perush, shehavayayt hammelech beyisrael tzarich shettihye behitassef rashe am yachad, keamram zichronam livracha (tosefta sanhedrin 83) en memannin melech ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad, vehu shennitkavven bemaamar "rashe am", uveamro "yachad shivte yisrael", shetztzarich sheyyihyu tzibbur merutztzim mimmennu.

Od yitbaer lefi sheamar besamuch ki hattora hi hammolechet alenu, keamro (Mishlei 8:6) "negidim adabber", laze gamar omer "vayhi vishurun melech", perush vahavayat melech beyisrael ze yihye im yitkabbetzu rashe am veyishalu melech, az hu sheyyihye melech, vehu amro "behitassef rashe am" vegomer, az hu sheyyihye melech bishurun millevad hattora. uchemo chen matzinu shehaya minnuy melech al yisrael beseder ze, dichtiv bishmuel (Shmuel 1 8:4) "vayyitkabbetzu chol zikne yisrael vayyavou el shemuel vegomer sima lanu melech leshaftenu", vehu atzmo maamar "behitassef" vegomer, aval zulat ze tihye zot hattora levad lemelech al yisrael, vehu maamar hannavi lahem (Shmuel 1 12:12) "vaAdonai elohechem malkechem", shehi hattora, shekkullah shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu.

Veulay ki laze ramaz betevat "vayhi" sheyyore al hatztzaar (Megila 10.), dichtiv sham (Shmuel 1 8,6) "vayyera haddavar beene shemuel kaasher amru tena lanu melech leshaftenu", uchetiv (sham sham 7) "vayyomer Adonai vegomer ki oti maasu mimmeloch alehem", veal ze nitnabbe moshe veamar "vayhi" vegomer.

Od ramaz, ki malchut yisrael tihye mitkayyemet kesheyyihyu yisrael mitassefim rashehem yachad, velo yihyu bad bevad, shebbaze yihye sibba sheyyityachadu yachad shivte yisrael. uchesheyyisrael begeder ze hinne hinnam berum geder hahatzlachot, umalchutam tihye bah havaya shel kiyyum, vetze ulemad ki miyyom shennechleku hallevavot venechleku hammalchuyyot ma alta beyadam, vezot sibbat egle yaravam vehabbaim acharav, ki rosh haavdan hu happerud, ucheli hammachzik habberacha hu hashshalom (Uktzin 3:12) veyichud hallevavot.

rashi: Talim leittot batztzara. talim enayim leittot hatztzara:
targum: Lama Adonai tekum berachik titamar bimdor kadishin leidane akta:

rashi: Mearvot moav el har nevo. kamma maalot hayu ufesaan moshe bifsia achat (sota 13):
Et kol haaretz. herahu et kol eretz yisrael beshalvatah, vehammetztzikin haatidim lihyot metzikin lah:
Ad dan. herahu vene dan ovdim avoda zara, shenneemar (Shoftim 18) "vayyakimu lahem bene dan et happesel", veherahu shimshon sheatid latzet mimmennu lemoshia:
ohc: Vayyarehu Adonai et kol vegomer. perush hifil Adonai bo reut, ma sheen gevul baayin lirot beechad mishshene derachim: o yair enav meor zarua latztzaddik shehu or sheshet yeme vereshit ganuz latztzaddikim, sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (chagiga 12.) shebbo yabbit haadam missof haolam; o hikriv haaretz lemul enav vehera otah lo lefanav:

targum: Leshabbacha al yedehon divne korach tushebachta:
Beyoma teminaa shalach yat ama uvarichu yat malka vaazal lekirvehon kad chadan veshappira libbehon al kol tavta daavad Adonai ledavid avdeh uleyisrael ameh:
Veitgele Adonai lishlomo tinyanut kema deitgele leh begivon:
Mimadbera ulevanona haden vead nahara rabba nahara difrat kol ara chittae vead yama rabba maalane shimsha yehe techumechon:
Hala fakedtach tekef velem la tidchal vela tittevar are besaadach memra dayya elahach bechol atar dithach:
Bedil deyedun kol amme ara are Adonai hu elohim let od:
Ivaru bego mashrita ufakidu yat ama lememar atkinu lechon zevadin are besof telata yomin attun avrin yat yardena haden lemeal lemerat yat ara dayya elahachon yahev lechon lemirtah:
Vihon pitgame ilen di veeti min kodam Adonai mitkabbelin kodam Adonai elahana yemam velele lemebad din avdeh veuleban ameh yisrael pitgam yom beyomeh:
Moshe avdi mit uchean kum ibbar yat yardena haden at vechol ama haden leara daana yehiv lehon livne yisrael:
Vahava kad shetze shelomo lemivne yat bet makdesha dayya veyat bet malka veyat kol reut shelomo deitree lemebad:
Tekef valam are at tachsen yat ama haden yat ara dekayemit laavahathon lemittan lehon:
La yitattad enash kodamach kol yome chayaych kema dahava memri besaadeh demoshe ken eheve imach la ashbekinach vela archekinach:
Vahava batar demit moshe avda dayya vaamar Adonai lihoshua bar nun meshamshuneh demoshe lememar:
La yade sifra deorayta haden mippumach utehe hage beh yemam velelya bedil detitar lemebad kechol dichtiv beh are bechen tatzlach yat darkach uvechen tachshat:
Lechod tekef velem lachada lemitar lemebad kechol orayta defakdach moshe avdi la tiste mineh leyamina velismala bedil detitzlach bechol atar dithach:
Berich Adonai di yehiv neyacha leameh yisrael kechol di malel la betil pitgama chad mikkol pitgamohi taknaya di malel bida demoshe avdeh:
Yehe memra dayya elahana besaadana kema dahava besaada daavahatana la yishbekinana vela yarchikinana:
Vahava chad shetze shelomo letzalaa kodam Adonai yat kol tzelota uvauta hada kam min kodam madbecha dayya midhava keria al birkohi vidohi perisan bitzlo letzet shemaya:
Umalka vechol yisrael imeh menachsin nichsat kudeshin kodam Adonai:
Unechas shelomo yat nichsat kudeshaya di nechis kodam Adonai tore tarten ribbo uteren alfin vaana tarta asre ribbo vachanichu yat bet makdesha dayya malka vechol bene yisrael:
Ufaked yehoshua yat sarche ama lememar:
Vihe libbechon shelim bidchalta dayya elahana limhach bikyamohi ulemitar pikudohi keyoma haden:
Vekam uverich yat kol kehala deyisrael kal rav lememar:
Perakta vigvurat edreach amach banaya deolid yaakov vezan yosef lealmin:
Vaavad shelomo beidana hahi yat chaga vechol yisrael imeh kehala rav mimaalana dachamat ad nachala demitzrayim kodam Adonai elahana shava yomin chanukkat beta veshava yomin chaga arbaat asar yomin:

Beyoma hahu kadish malka yat go darta di kodam bet makdesha dayya are avad taman yat alata veyat minchata veyat tarbe nichsat kudeshaya are madbecha dinchasha di kodam Adonai dachik milsovara yat alata veyat minchata veyat tarbe nichsat kudeshaya:
Kol atra detidrach parsat raglechon beh lechon yehavitah kema demalelit im moshe:
Leafnaa libbana lidchalteh limhach vechol orchan detaknan kadamohi ulemitar pikudohi ukeyamohi vedinohi defaked yat avahatana:

bart: Ketzad. lav appelugta kae ella milleta beanpe nafshah, veayyavam echad vivama achat kae. vehachi kaamar, ketzad din yavam echad vivama achat:
Tzericha hemennu chalitza. veim ratza lichnos lo yichnos, dechevan dehitchil begerushin kayma aleh belo yivne:
Tzericha hemennu get. dachalitza afkata lazzikka, veget bae leafkue kiddushin dileh, dachalitza lo mafkea kiddushin:
Chavitte chohen gadol lishatan vaarichatan bifnim. ledivre hakkol. sheoto chatzi issaron shecholek bo esrono shel kohen gadol nimshach venitkaddesh umekaddesh et hammincha:
Vedochot et hashshabbat. lefi shei efshar laasot lisha vaaricha vaafiyya meetmol, dechevan demikkaddesha bichli mippassela belina:
Toda ushelamim. toda o shelamim:
Yavi cheves. pachut shebbattoda ushelamim:
Yavi far ufara. detoda ushelamim ikka lesappoke bizcharim unekevot:
Verachel. nekeva bat shete shanim:
Gedi. ben shana min haizzim:
Sair. ez ben shete shanim:
Tale. keves ben shenato:
Yesh bahen maase cheli bifnim. bimlachtan shennaase bahen bifnim teunim keli. laafoke al gabbe tavla. uvimlachtan shennaaset bachutz, kegon lishato vaarichato shel lechem happanim, eno taun keli:
Vekarnotehen. shehu madbik batzek lechol dofen kemin karnayim, veorech hakkeren yotze arba etzbaot:

Rabbi yehuda omer shello tite. ben shete hallechem lelechem happanim ben beshiur orech verochav ben beshiur hakkeranot. bishte hallechem arko shiva verachbo arbaa vekarnotav arba etzbaot. vesimanach 15. velechem happanim arko asara verachbo chamishsha vekarnotav sheva etzbaot. vesimanach 22. vedarko shel rabbi yehuda latet simanim, kemo 114 374 13:
Sheyyehe lo fanim. defanot. [sheyyehe lo pinnim zaviyyot] vehen hen hakkarnayim:
Lo yissa et habbogeret. dichtiv (sham) vehu ishsha bivtuleha yikkach, perat levogeret shekkalu betuleha:
Rabbi elazar verabbi shimon machshirin. velet hilchata kevatayhu:

Shete hallechem. lechem happanim nillosh echad echad. dichtiv beh (Vayikra 24) shene esronim yihye hachalla haechat, melammed shennilloshot achat achat. uminnayin sheafiyyatan shetayim shetayim, talmud lomar (sham) vesamta otam, sima rishona sheatta ose mehem dehaynu battannur tehe bilshon otam, demashma shehaya noten shenayim bishne defusim yachad battannur. yachol af shete hallechem ken, talmud lomar vesamta otam, shehaya lo lomar vesamtam, ma talmud lomar vesamta otam, otam atta noten shenayim shenayim battannur vei atta noten shete hallechem shenayim shenayim ella echad echad:

Uvitfus. kemo defus, 327 belaaz. kemin teva shennittal kissuyah ushete dafnoteha zo keneged zo, kach hallechem hayu lo shete defanot veshulayim rechavim, umetakken habbatzek betoch haddefus sheyyehe asuy keen haddefus:
Ucheshehu. rode otan min hattannur:

Notnan baddefus kede shello yitkalkelu. veyishshavru. nimtza shelosha defusim hen, echad keshehi batzek, veechad haya lah battannur keshehi neefet, veechad keshehu rodah min hattannur notnah baddefus kede shello titkalkel:
Atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehanechil lechol tzaddik vetzaddik. samach maamar ze lechan, lehodia bachatimat hammishna mattan secharan shel tzaddikim, shellomdim umekayyemim kol ma shekkatuv bammishna:

Shelosh meot vaasara olamot shenneemar lehanechil ohavay yesh. yesh, begimatriyya hachi have, shelosh meot veeser. kelomar shehahanaa vekorat ruach sheyyesh lechol tzaddik vetzaddik baolam habba hu shelosh meot veeser peamim keneged kol haolam hazze, sheen haolam hazze chullo ella chelek mishshelosh meot veeser mimma sheyyesh lechol tzaddik vetzaddik nachala laolam habba:

Kohen hedyot lo yissa aylonit vechulei. vehu haddin leyisrael. velo nakat kohen ella mishshum pelugta derabbi yehuda deamar dechohen afillu yesh lo ishsha uvanim lo yissa aylonit, ma sheen ken beyisrael. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Veshennivala beilat zenut. kegon chayyave lavin o chayyave ase, vechol shekken chayyave keritut umitot bet din. aval habba al happenuya lo asaah zona:
Hakkosht. kach shemo velaaz uvaaravi. vehu nimne im sammene hakketoret:
Vehachemes. yesh sheppershu zangevil. veyesh sheppershu kinnamon:
Verashe vesamim. kegon egoz 222, venerd, vechayyotze vahem, shennotnim reach arev:
Hattia. min chiltit:
Vechiltit. kach shemah baaravi. veaf al pi sherechah ra, regilim litten mimmenna bimzonot:
Challot charia. karkom yaari. vekorin lo baaravi 386:

Af hen lo yillakchu vechesef maaser. derachamana amar (Devarim 14) venatatta hakkesef vegomer‏ veachalta sham, davar shehu neechol kemot shehu, atta kone bechesef maaser, sheeno neechol kemot shehu, en atta kone vechesef maaser. vechen halacha, deen metammein tumat ochalim veen nikkachim bechesef maaser:
Veim laddin. sheatta doresh kal vachomer meatzmecha:
Yesh teshuva. lehashiv, ma leammon umoav shekken nitparesh taaman, al devar asher lo kiddemu, vehaishsha en darkah lekaddem, tomar bemitzri vaadomi shello nitparesh taaman:
Lo chi. afillu im hayiti dan kal vachomer en lachem teshuva. umikkol makom halacha ani omer. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Netinim. givonim shennitgayyeru bime yehoshua unetunim lechotve etzim veshoave mayim:
Ellu lo mittammein. sheen chashuvin lo shomer velo yad:
Kolse hakkeruv. rambam peresh, rashe hakkeruv sheyyotzim mehem gidim shessovvim [mesubbachim tzarich lomar], vederech mochre hakkeruv shekkortim otan umashlichin otan:
Vechulfot teradim. sharshe hatteradim shemmashirim bakkarka keshechotchim hatteradim kede sheyyachalifu veyaalu acherim tachtam:
Et sheddarkan liggazez. haddevarim sheddarkam legazzan velo leakran im sharshehem, im akaran en hashsharashim metammein, lefi sheenan lo yad velo shomer:
Rabbi yose metamme vechullan. dechullam chashuvim yad laochel, chutz mikkolse cheruv vehallefet sheotan gidin hassovvim [mesubbachim] enan chashuvim lo yad velo shomer. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Betza megulgelet. tzeluya ketzat, ad shehi meorevet ureuya legamah:
Ad sheyyagos. hakkelippa chashiva shomer umitztarefet, ad sheyyachtoch mimmennu meat, veaz la chashiva yoter shomer, shehabbetza shotetet veyoredet derech oto shever vachatach:
Usheluka. aval im nishleka habbetza, shehi kasha veomedet betoch hakkelippa vaafillu shennishbera, leolam chashiva hakkelippa shomer, ad shettehe merutztzetzet:
Vechen etzem sheyyesh bo moach. chashiv haetzem shomer lammoach, veaf al pi shennishbar haetzem, ad sheyyihye merutztzatz:
Harimmon shepperado. shechatach harimmon lishnayim vaadayin haggargerim mechubbarin bakkelippa, haveya kelippa chibbur, ad sheyyakkish bekane veyitnaneu haggargerim shebbo:
Shelal hakkovsim. derech hakkovsim lishlol habbegadim hakkatan im haggadol kede shello yovad, vesofo lehaferidan:
Vehabbeged shehu tafur bechilayim. shete chatichot shel beged tzemer shettefaran bechutin shel pishtan, devadday sofo lehaferidan zo mizzo, mishshum issur kilayim:
Chibbur letuma. veim nitma haechad nitma chavero, ad sheyyatchil lehattir, veaf al pi shello gamar lehattir, demaase motzi mide maase:
Ma shehevi hevi. deamrinan lo leshem nidro heviah, ella nedava acheret hi zo:
Zo lehavi vemachavat. shehayta issaron solet munnachat lefanav, veamar, zo lehavi bammachavat vechulei:
Hare zo fesula. dikvaah lakkeli shehizkir bah veen yachol leshannotah lichli acher:
Ellu lehavi bichli echad. ellu shehayu munnachim lefanav:

Hare ellu fesulim. dehecha denadar bichli echad vehevi bishne kelim mafrish mimmenna shene komatzim, vehu lo nadar ella kometz echad. veod, shemmincha chasera hi bechol keli ucheli. vehecha denadar bishne kelim vehevi bichli echad haveya mincha yetera umiet bakkomatzin, shehu berer lah shene komatzin velo kamatz ella echad:

Amru lo bichli echad nadarta. velo chash ledivrehem vehikrivah bishne kelim, pesulim, veaf al gav delo amar ellu lehavi bichli echad. mishshum dehashta lekka lememar leshum nedava acheret ayte la, dechevan deamre leh bichli echad nadarta hava leh lememar lehu ana mishshum neder acharina maytina la:

Kishte menachot shennitaravu. deamrinan beferek hakkometz, im yachol likmotz mizzo bifne atzmah umizzo bifne atzmah kesherot, veim lav pesulot. veha dekatane leel ellu lehavi bishne kelim vehevi bichli echad pesulot, mayre kegon delo yachol likmotz mikkol achat bifne atzmah:
Lishatan vaarichatan bachutz vaafiyyatan bifnim. lo itberira taama deha milleta baggemara ammay lishatan vaarichatan bachutz vaafiyyatan bifnim:
Veenan dochot et hashshabbat. afiyyatan:
Uchesherot bevet pagi. rambam omer shehu makom samuch lehar habbayit michutz, sheshsham hayu ofim hammenachot. milleshon pat bag hammelech. veen halacha ella kedivre tanna kamma:
Happaggin. teenim shello nitbashshelu, kedichtiv [shir hashshirim 2] hatteena chanta faggeha. vechol shear perot nammi sheenan mevushshalim nikraim paggin:
Vehabboser. anavim shello nitbashshelu. umishshehiggiu lihyot kefol hallavan nikraim boser. ufaggin geruim mibboser:
Mishsheyyavou leonat hammaasrot. kol peri uferi kefi haet hakkatzuv lo lehitchayyev bemaaser, keditnan perek kamma demaasrot. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:

Peritze zetim vaanavim. shennitkashshu kodem bishshulan, veenan nifrachim bevet habbad. leshon uvene paritze ammecha (Daniel 11), bene adam kashim ureshaim. kach zetim vaanavim hallalu, kashin veenan nifrachin veenan nidrachin:
Bet shammay metammein. dachashive ochel:
Uvet hillel metaharin. dela chashive ochel:
Hakketzach. 100 belaaz. vezera shachor hu. uregilim latet oto belechem, lefi sheharagil bo eno va lide cheev lev:
Vechen lammaasrot. kemo shennechelku letuma, kach nechelku lemaasrot, dehamtammean tumat ochalim mechayyevo vemaasrot:
Lo yifchot mishshene gezirin. shete bekaiyyot gedolot. demiut etzim shenayim:

Vehammaale et hakkometz bachutz chayyav. karet, dehaalaa hi. uvehay kelala have nammi hammaale kometz bifnim dehaktara mealyeta hi, hilkach chashiv chamishsha komatzim vetu lo, velo chashiv lehay dehammaale kometz bifnim lekometz shishshi:
Ushene vezichim. shel lechem happanim:
Haubbar. hay ubbar, i bat kohen leyisrael hi, posel, dichtiv binureha, perat limubberet. i bat yisrael lechohen hi, lo maachil, desheeno yalud eno maachil:

Vehayyavam. i bat kohen leyisrael hi, posel lah, veshava el bet aviha ketiv (sham), perat leshomeret yavam sheenah yechola lashuv, shehi aguda bivamah. vei vat yisrael lechohen, lo maachil lah, kinyan kaspo amar rachamana vezo kinyan achiv hi:

Vehaerusin. i vat kohen leyisrael hi, pasil lah, dekane lah bahavaya, umishsheat havaya ifsila lah, kedichtiv (sham) uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar. i vat yisrael lechohen, lo maachil lah, gezera shemma yimzegu lah kos yayin shel teruma bevet aviha vetashke leacheha uleachyoteha:
Vehacheresh. i vat kohen leyisrael hi, pasal lah, deha kenaa betakkanta derabbanan. vei vat yisrael lechohen hi, lo maachil lah, dekinyan kaspo amar rachamana vecheresh middeorayta lo kani:

Uven tesha shanim veyom echad vechulei. echad min happesulim lakkehunna shehu ben tesha shanim veyom echad uva al hakkohenet o al haleviyya o al bat yisrael, pesalah milleechol batteruma, shebben tesha shanim veyom echad biato bia venitchallela bivilato. vei vat yisrael nisset lechohen ben tesha shanim veyom echad, eno maachilah batteruma, sheen kinyano kinyan gamur:
Vechen safek ben tesha shanim vechulei. dino keven tesha vadday ufosel:
Safek hevi shete searot safek lo hevi. katan shekkiddesh et haishsha, safek hevi shete searot safek lo hevi vekiddusheha kiddushe safek, ishto choletzet velo mityabbemet:

Nafal habbayit alav veal bat achiv. shehi ishto. safek hu met rishon venaflu shetehen leyibbum lifne achiv ufetura tzaratah mishshum tzarat habbat, safek hi meta rishona uvishat nefila leyibbum lo havay tzaratah tzarat erva keditnan vechullan im metu o meanu vechulei‏ tzarotehen muttarot. tzaratah choletzet velo mityabbemet. veayyede deayre bisfeke lechumra tane leha bahadayhu:
Muftzalin. latet rashe kanim beotan pitztzulim. ucheminyan hakkanim kach minyan happitztzulim:

Arbaa asar leseder ze. shesh challot shehayu beseder hammaarechet. learbaa mehen lechol achat shelosha kanim, hare shenem asar kanim, vehaelyona enah tzericha ella shenayim lefi sheen aleha masseoy, hare arbaa asar. hachalla hattachtona enah tzericha kol ikkar, lefi shemmunnachat al tohoro shel shulchan:
Lo siddur kanim. bammaaracha hachadasha:
Velo netilatan. meal hayeshana, doche shabbat:
Nichnas meerev shabbat veshomtan. mibben kol lechem velechem, umannicham learko shel shulchan, ulemachar mesadder hallechem, ulemotzae shabbat noten hakkanim ben kol lechem kemishpatan:

Arkan learko shel bayit. mimmizrach lemaarav hayu munnachin bearkan. chutz min haaron shearko lerachbo shel bayit, shehabbaddim shebbaaron hayu boltim vedochakin bapparochet vedomin kishne dadde ishsha, shenneemar (bammelachim 1 8) vayyaarichu habbaddim vayyerau, vehabbaddim lerachbo shel aron hayu munnachim, deillu learko shel aron hayu baddim lo haya ben bad levad ella shiur rochav haaron dehaynu ammeta ufalga, utere gavre hannosim bishne baddim et haaron shenayim mikkan ushenayim mikkan lo havu matze likkanes ben bad levad, ella vadday lerachbo netunim, vehem hayu mimmizrach lemaarav shehare hayu dochakim bapparochet, nimtza arko shel aron lerachbo shel bayit:
Kele gelalim. kelim haasuyin miggille habbakar:

Shehashsharashim yecholin latzet bahen. af al pi sheenan nekuvim, hashshoresh yotze meatzmo venokev et haggalal veet haadama shel oto cheli. ulehachi lo nakat kele avanim, lefi shekkashim hen veen hashshoresh nokev otan:

Atzitz nakuv eno machshir et hazzeraim. shebbetocho, delo mekabbele hechsher mishshum dachashive kimchubbar, veen hazzeraim nichsharim lekabbel tuma ella cheshebba alehen mayim leachar shennitleshu. vaafillu ferot telushim en nichsharim bammayim shebbetocho, lefi sheen hammayim machshirin keshehen bimchubbar, devainan sheyyehu hammayim telushin, vehane mayim demanneche veatzitz nakuv, kemanneche veara damu:
Vesheeno nakuv machshir et hazzeraim. deven mayim shebbetocho uven zeraim, tarvayhu chashive chitlushim:
Milahu. leatzitz sheeno nakuv:
Afar ad sefato. hoil veroe et haavir mearba ruchot, have cheatzitz nakuv, vachashive chimchubbar, ben hammayim, uven hazzeraim shebbo:
Ketavla sheen lah lizbez. sheen lah safa mikkan umikkan ella feshuta vachalaka, demayim shebbah enan machshirin et hazzeraim vachashive chimchubbar, hoil veroin et haavir mearba ruchot:
Natan get veasa vah maamar tzericha get vachalitza. deget dachi ketzat veshiyyer ketzat, umaamar kani sheyura deget, hilkach tzericha get lemaamaro vachalitza lezikkato:
Natan get uvaal. asur lekayyemah, shemmishshaa shennatan get kayma aleh belo yivne, utzericha get leviato vachalitza lezikkato:

En achar chalitza chelum. ha matnitin rabbi akiva hi deamar en kiddushin tofsin bechayyave lavin. veenah halacha, ella halacha kachachamim, sheomrim yesh achar chalitza chelum, veim kiddeshah achar chalitza tzericha hemennu get:
Achat yevama achat leyavam echad veachat shete yevamot leyavam echad. shavin hen sheyyesh achar get rishon o achar maamar rishon kelum veen achar bia shebbattechilla kelum veen achar chalitza chelum:

Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen. afillu avde melog yochlu, mishshum dahave kinyan kohen shekkana kinyan, kelomar haishsha shehi kinyano shel kohen kanta ellu haavadim, uchetiv (Vayikra 22) vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo, sheen talmud lomar kinyan kaspo, ella lemidrash hachi, vechohen ki yikne kinyan kaspo nefesh, sheavdo shel kohen kana nefesh, hu yochal bo:
Yerukkim mitztarfin. dachazu laachila:
Levanim en mitztarfin. detu lo chazu:
Uvachazarim. bachazeret, af al gav dilvanim lo chazu laachila, mikkol makom havu shomer. veen halacha kerabbi elazar bar tzadok:
Vechen habba al achat mikkol haarayot. beachat mikkol habbiot haellu:

O al happesulot kegon almana lechohen gadol vechulei. pesalah lichhunna mishshum zona. veaf al pi sheeshet yisrael shenneensa mutteret levaalah, pesula hi lichhunna. ugerusha nammi, i bat kohen hi mifsela behach bia mitteruma deve nashsha:
Mamzeret unetina leyisrael. lav appesula lichhunna kae, deha pesula vekayma, ella leinyan haaraa nakat leh, lemilke alah behaaraa kigmar bia:
Veet habbezichim leachar shabbat. vedinan haya lesadderan beshabbat bishat arichat hallechem:

Vehiktir et habbezichim beshabbat pesula. dimchussar zeman hu, shello haya al hashshulchan ella shishsha yamim. vehacha i efshar letakken velomar yannichennu ad shabbat habbaa, dechevan delechem nisdar kedino beshabbat, kiddesho shulchan veshuv eno yachol lishhoto ella ad shabbat rishona, demippesil belina:
Veen chayyavin alehem mishshum piggul. im hiktiran al menat leechol hallechem lemachar eno piggul, shello karav hammattir kemitzvato:
Velo mishshum notar. sheen notar chal al hallechem, shehare en rauy laachila:

Vetame. haochlo betumat hagguf eno becharet, kidamrinan behakkometz [daf ko] hannittar lattehorim chayyavim alav mishshum tuma, veze lo nittar lattehorim meolam, devzichim havu mattirim dideh velo karvu kehilchatan:
Yannichennu lashshabbat habbaa. veyaamod shevuayim al hashshulchan. dechevan delo nisdar beshabbat en shulchan mekaddesh ad shettaggia shabbat, umeoto shabbat yachol lehashehotan shivat yamim:
Sheafillu hi al hashshulchan yamim rabbim. kodem hashshabbat:
En bechach kelum. sheen hashshulchan mekaddesho ad hashshabbat, hilkach lo mifsal belina leachar hashshabbat:

Rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim kulei. disvira lehu anderoginos kezachar. vahadar beh rabbi yose veamar babberayta sheanderoginos beriyya bifne atzmo velo hichriu bo chachamim im zachar im nekeva, hilkach eno maachil batteruma:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. velet hilchata kevateh, deha kayma lan leel seris adam choletz vecholtzim leishto, vetumtum shennikra have kisris adam:
Anderoginos nose aval lo nissa. mippene shehu kezachar, vehashshochev immo have ba al hazzachur ben bezachrut shello ben benakvut shello:
Rabbi eliezer omer chayyavin alav sekila kezachar. davka bimkom zachrut shello velo benakvut shello. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:
Bene vetzalim. ammud haemtzai shehu chemo lev (yarok) umimmennu tzomchim habbetzalim, lehahu kare vene vetzalim:
Im yesh bahen rir. shehem meleim lecha veen bahen chalal:

Mishtaarin kemo shehen. keshebbaim leshaer im yesh bahen ochel kabbetza shiur tuma, meshaarin otan im harir veen [tzarich] lemaech et chalalan. veim yesh bahen chalal, memaech et chalalan veachar kach meshaer lechabbetza:
Sefoganit. asuya rakka kemin sefog. veenah derusa uveuta:
Mishtaeret kemo shehi. belo miuch:
Besar haegel shennitpach. derech besar haegel shehu nitpach umitrabbe keshehu mitbashshel, uvesar hashshor hazzaken mitmaet:

Bichmot shehen. im besar shor mevushshal hu shennitmaat veamad al pachot mikkabbetza, en omrim keshehaya chay haya vo kabbetza o yoter, vitamme af al pi sheachshav en bo kashshiur. vechen im haya vesar egel shennitpach venitrabba veyesh bo kede letamme, en omrim hoil ucheshehaya chay lo haya vo kede letamme, af achshav lo yetamme:

Chalatz vechalatz. muttar bikrovot sheniyya, sheen achar chalitza rishona shum zikkat yevamin, vachalitza batrayta lav kelum hi, vaafillu lichhunna enah pesula. vechen chalatz lezo umaamar lezo, vechen natan get lezo achar hachalitza shel zo, o im baal lezo achar hachalitza shel zo, en maase haacharon kelum. o im baal techilla vechazar uvaal lashsheniyya, o baal techilla veasa maamar bashsheniyya, o natan get lashsheniyya o chalatz lashsheniyya, en achar bia kelum, umaase acharon lo chashiv umuttar bikrovot hashsheniyya:
En achar chalitza chelum. aresha kae. veassefa tzarich lememar en achar bia kelum:

Rabban gamliel. en get achar get. shete yevamot leyavam echad meach echad, venatan get larishona vechazar venatan get lashsheniyya, lo neesru kerovot hashsheniyya alav lemehave kigrushato, dimchi yahev get larishona paka zikkat shetehen mealav, deget mahane bivama lemekam ale belo yivne, veshuv lo yeyabbem lo hu velo shear haachim lo layyevama shekkibbela hagget velo letzaratah, hilkach ki hadar veyahiv get sheni lashsheniyya en bemaasav kelum vahave kenoten get leishsha nachrit dealma. vechen shene yevamin livama achat venatan ze get veze get, haacharon eno kelum umuttar bikrovoteha:
Velo maamar achar maamar. ben shene yevamin livama achat ben beyavam echad ushete yevamot, haacharon eno kelum veenah tzericha mimmennu get umuttar bikrovoteha:
Yesh get achar get. dekamma lo dacha zikkatah legamre, deha baya chalitza, hilkach akkatti ikka palga zikka veahane get sheni lashsheniyya lemehave gerushato veasur bikrovoteha. vechen halacha:

Hachotech min haadam min habbehema min hachayya umin haofot. kullehu vechotech mechayyim ayre. veaf al pi sheppershu min hachay enan metammein, deen metamme ella evar min hachay velo vasar shepperash min hachay, hilkach tzerichin machashava sheyyachashov alehen laachila. veim lav, enan metammein:
Vehachelev bakkefarim. deanshe hakkefarim lo ochle chalavim, hilkach tzerichin machashava. aval bashshevakim deikka rov am habbaim lashshuk, ikka tuva deochle chalavim, veenam tzerichin machashava:
Ushear kol yarkot sade. sheenan nizraim bagginnot, enan meyuchadim lemaachal adam, utzerichin machashava:
Chutz mishshemarkaim. min batzal charif:
Ufitriyyot. min tzemach sheen lo shoresh. 149 velaaz:
Chutz mikkereshe sade. 592 belaaz, uvaaravi 627. sheellu af al pi sheen notim otan bagginnot, enan tzerichin machashava:
Vehargila. kach shemah baaravi, uvelaaz 521:
Netz hechalav. perachim levanim kechalav. veyesh omrim, esev keshechotchim oto yotze mimmennu chalav:
Akkaviyyot. esev male kotzim. vehu dardar bilshon mikra. uvelaaz 610:

Kelusin. harambam omer shekkorin lo vaaravi 122 47. vesavre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon verabbi yose sheellu enan tzerichin machashava, mippene shehen meyuchadin lemaachal adam. veen halacha keechad mehem, ella chullam tzerichin machashava, veim lav enan metammein:
Hare alay issaron. perashti. kamma esronim avi veeni yodea kamma amarti:

Yavi shishshim esronim. dei betzir mehachi nadar, lo ichpat leh, dematne veomer ma shepperashti yehe lenidri vehashshear yehe lindava. uvitfe mehachi lekka lesappoke, deen mincha achat yetera mishshishshim issaron:
Hare alay mincha. haomer hare alay mincha setam:
Yavi ezo sheyyirtze. mechamesh menachot:
Meyuchedet. shennikret mincha setam veen lah shem levavy. vechol shear menachot yesh lahem shem levavy, minchat machavat, minchat marcheshet, minchat maafe. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Mitnaddevim yayin. belo solet veshemen, umenassecho lashshitin bifne atzmo:
Veen mitnaddevim shemen. belo solet veyayin:
Mitnaddevin shamen. vekumtzo umaktir hakkometz veshirayim neechalim:
Shekken hu karev chovato vifne atzmo. im chovato hu karev bifne atzmo. af al pi shehu ba chova im hammincha, eno meakkev hammincha:
Tomar bashshemen kulei. dechevan delo ashkechan beh delete bichli bifne atzmo, hasheta nammi lo lete:
