Afillu ferida echat. tor echad, o ben yona echad, mitnaddevim ben shenayim. vahalacha shemmitnaddevim yayin veshemen bifne atzman. umitnaddevim minchat nesachim ben niske par ben niske ayil vecheves. vechol hakkarbanot baim bindava beshuttafut, chutz min hammincha, lefi shenneemar bah nefesh, dichtiv (Vayikra 2) venefesh ki takriv karban mincha:

Hammenachot vehannesachim. ad shello kadshu bakkeli. enan kedoshim kedushshat hagguf, ella kedushshat damim, shetztzarich lifdotan vehaddamim kedoshim. vedavka keshennitmeu yesh lahen pidyon im lo kadshu bakkeli, aval lo nitmeu, af al pi shello kadshu bakkeli en podim otan:

Haofot vehaetzim vehallevona uchele sharet. shennitmeu: en lahem pidyon. shello neemar pidyon bikdushshat hagguf ella bivhema baalat mum, dichtiv (Vayikra 27) veim kol behema temea, asher lo yakrivu mimmenna karban laAdonai, veheerich hakkohen otah vechulei. uvevaale mumim shennifdu hakkatuv medabber, dei bivhema temea mammash, keshehu omer (sham) veim babbehema hattemea ufada beerkecha, hare behema temea amura. veashmoinan bematnitin deaf al gav deashkechan bekadosh kedushshat hagguf venafal beh muma demifrik, haofot vehaetzim vehallevona uchele sharet dekaddeshe kedushshat hagguf venitmeu lo mifreke:
Kol sheer basar shehu velo yavo. kol kirva shehi belav, vaafillu en bah karet:
Kol chayyave karet. aval lo chayyave lavin. vechen halacha, shekkol sheissuro issur karet havvalad mamzer, chutz min hannidda. aval mechayyave lavin en havvalad mamzer:
Hearel. kohen arel shemmetu echav mechamat mila:
Eno ochel batteruma. deyalfinan mippesach dichtiv beh (Shemot 12) vechol arel lo yochal bo:
Neshehem veavdehem yochlu. deha mishshum arla vetuma lo nafke mikkelal kohanim, ella deinhu gufayhu mechussarim takkana:
Neshehem lo yochelu. deshavyah chalala beviato, denivala lappasul lah:
Veim lo yedaah. shehayta nesua lo kodem lachen velo ba aleha leachar shennaasa petzua dakka:
Haggalinim. kemo garinim:
Velo mitztarfot. im haochel lehashelimo lechabbetza, deyad chashiva velo shomer:
Galina shel rotev. garin shel temara lacha ureuya lamotz:
Af al pi yotza. kelomar af al pi sheyyotza min haochel, mitztarefet im haochel, lefi shehi neechelet, shemmotzetz otah mechamat retivut:

Lefichach chotam shel yevesha. gargir shel anavim utemarim yesh lahem chotam, shechotem nekev happeri, uverosh hachotam oketz, kach pershu rabbotay. vekashe leferusham, may lefichach. uvemishnayot davkaniyyot matzati, lefichach chotal shel yevesha, vechen gores rambam, umefaresh taama degarina shel rotev dehaynu shel temara lacha, mitztarefet, lefi shehi shomer lapperi, sheim lo haggarin haya happeri nifsad. veshel yevesha enah mitztarefet, deshuv en haggarin shomer lapperi, shekkevar kalta hallecha shebbattemara veen haggarin shomrah shello tippased. lefichach chotal shel yevesha vehu hakkerum hameluppaf vedavuk al haggarin shel temara, mitztaref im hattemara keshehi yevesha, mippene shehakkerum hu shomer, lo haggarin:

Veshel rotev. dehaynu temara lacha, en hakkerum mitztaref. shehaggarin hu shomer velo hakkerum. venikra oto hakkerum chotal, lefi shehu meluppaf vedavuk laggarin. leshon vehachtel lo chuttalt (Yechezkel 16):
Galina shemmiktzatah yotza. kegon garina shel temara lacha shenneechelet chetzyah vechetzyah nisheret im haggarin:
Ma shekkeneged haochel. chashuv shomer umitztaref, aval idach lo. vechen etzem sheyyesh alav kazzayit basar:

Haya alav. haya al haetzem basar betzad echad sheeno makkif et haetzem, amar rabbi shimon roin im yesh babbasar shiur sheyyuchal lehakkif mimmennu avyo kechut shel erev ketabbaat seviv haetzem, mitztaref. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Kegon hassia vehaezov vehakkoranit. sheggam ellu kach dinam, ma shekkeneged haochel mitztaref, uma sheeno cheneged haochel en mitztaref. vesia vekoranit min ezov hem. sia 457 belaaz, vekoranit 515 velaaz:

Venistaev. shennafal bo mum. devaal mum ikre tame kedichtiv (Vayikra 27) veim kol behema temea asher lo yakrivu mimmenna karban laAdonai, uvevaale mumin sheyyippadu hakkatuv medabber, kidfarshinan befirkin dilel:

Im ratza yavi vedamav shenayim. velo dami leresha deamrinan shor bemane vehevi shenayim bemane lo yatza, dehatam deamar hare alay shor bemane chayyav ad sheyyeviennu, aval hacha beshor ze venistaev shane, dechevan deamar shor ze akriv ola venistaev, azal leh nidreh, detu lo matze likyumeh:
Rabbi oser. lechattechilla. aval im hevi yatza. dechevan deamar ze, eno chayyav beacharayuto. veen halacha kerabbi:

Habbenoni shebbahen hekdesh. af habbenoni shebbahen hekdesh. dechi yesh lo shenayim, haggadol hekdesh, shehammakdish beayin yafa makdish, umissetama mutav shebbahen hikdish, dichtiv (Devarim 12) mivchar nidrechem. vechi yesh lo shelosha, choshshin af labbenoni, delo yadinan ahe minnayhu chal hahekdesh, i aggadol dahave ayin yafa, i abbenoni dahave ayin yafa legabbe katan, hilkach tarvayhu asire. mihu lo karev lammizbeach ella chad minnayhu. vehechi avid delishtere chad minnayhu, mamtin labbenoni ad sheyyumam, umechallel oto aggadol. demimma nafshach, i abbenoni chal velo aggadol, hare nafal bo mum vechillelo. vei aggadol chal meikkara, nimtza benoni chullin meikkara:
Perashti. eze mehen velo yadati eze hu:
O sheamar li abba. bishat mitato, echad mishshevaray hifrashti lehekdesh, veeni yodea al eze mehen amar li:
Haggadol shebbahen hekdesh. dehecha deamar perashti lekka sefeka, devadday haggadol peresh:
Yavi hu unesachav bemane. kach nitparesh dino battora shebbeal pe, sheyyehe erech hashshor im nesachav mane:
Egel yavi hu unesachav bechamesh. selaim:
Amar hare alay shor bemane. yeviennu bemane chutz minnesachav, shehare kach kevao:
Shor bemane vehevi shenayim bemane lo yatza. shehare kava shor bemane:
Katan vehevi gadol yatza, rabbi omer lo yatza. mishshum hachi tana pelugta derabbi verabbanan hacha besefa, lefaroshe deresha lav divre hakkol hi ella rabbi hi velo rabbanan. veen halacha kerabbi:
Zetim shekkevashan. beyayin o vechometz o vishar mashkin:
Betarfehen. im healim shellahem. ale zayit, metargeminan teraf zeta:
Tehorim. im naga sheretz bealin, tehorim hazzetim vehealim, dela chashive healim lo yad velo shomer:
Lefi shello chevashan. betarfehen:
Ella lemare. kede sheyyihyu nirim yafin yoter keshehealim immahen, denirim keillu mechadash nitleshu:
Keshut shel kishshut. keshehakkishshuim ketannim yesh lahen kemin sear katan, venikra keshut:
Vehannetz shellah. befi hakkishshuim yesh kemo netz aroch meat:
Tehorim. dela chashive lo yad velo shomer:

Lifne hattaggar temea. denicha leh lattaggar bassear uvannetz, shemmittoch kach nirim hakkishshuim yafim ucheillu mechadash nitleshu, vechevan sherotza bekiyyuman, chashive shomer lapperi. i nammi, lefi shehakkishshuim rakkim veyad hakkol memashmeshim bahen liknotan hen mitkalkelim im lo mippene sheoto sear shomran mikkol lichluch vetinnuf:

Hakkol shochatin. baggemara parech, hakkol shochatim lechattechilla ushechitatan keshera diavad. demeresha mashma dehay dimrabbinan mehakkol shochatin lechattechilla, uvesefa mashma dechi merabbinan mehakkol, diavad merabbinan leh, aval lechattechilla lo itrebe. veha lekka lememar kulla matnitin lechattechilla vachada katane, dechevan detana hakkol shochatin peshita dichshera. uvammaskana mefarsha matnitin baggemara hachi, hakkol shochatin, kol hammumchim hayyodim hilchot shechita shochatin, veaf al pi sheen muchzakin, shello shachatu lefanenu shelosha feamim lirot im yesh bahen koach shello yitallefu bashshechita veyavou lide shehiyya. bamme devarim amurim dachashive mumchim, bizman sheellu hammosrim lo lishchot yodim umakkirim bo sheyyodea hilchot shechita, aval im en yodim bo im yodea hilchot shechita, lo yishchot. veim shachat, bodkin oto, veim yodea hilchot shechita, shechitato cheshera:
Chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. daafillu diavad veyodim hilchot shechita asur leechol mishshechitatan. detamid hen muchzakin lekalkel, sheen bahen daat:

Vechullan sheshshachatu. middelo katane veim shachatu, ella vechullan sheshshachatu, mashma delav acheresh shote vekatan gereda kae ella af ashsheen yodim bo im yodea hilchot shechita deresha kae, devodkin oto. vei leteh kamman delivdekeh, veshachat vaacherim roin oto, shechitato cheshera. velet hilchata ki hay matnitin. ella af al gav deen acherim roin oto veleteh kamman delivdekeh, shechitato cheshera, derov metzuyin etzel shechita mumchim hen, veaf lechattechilla shochatin af al pi sheen acherim roin otan:

Shechitat nachri. afillu kehilchatah veyisrael omed al gabbav, nevela. aval enah asura vahanaa, dedavka shechitat min haaduk laavoda zara asura vahanaa, distam machashevet min laavoda zara, aval nachri haamur kan hu meotan shemmaase avotehen bidehen:

Umetammea vemassa. kedichtiv (Vayikra 11) vehannose et nivlatah vegomer, veaf al pi shello naga. velo haya tzarich lemitne, dechevan dinvela hi beyadua shennevela metammea vemassa, ella lomar lecha, zo metammea vemassa bilvad, veyesh lecha acheret shemmetammea afillu beohel, vee zo, zo tikrovet avoda zara:

Hashshochet ballayla vechen hassuma. tana shochet ballayla dumeya desuma, ma suma baafela af hashshochet ballayla baafela, uvehay hu detana hashshochet diavad in lechattechilla lo, aval kesheavuka kenegdo afillu lechattechilla shochatim ballayla:

Hashshochet beshabbat. af al pi sheim haya mezid haya mitchayyev benafsho, shechitato cheshera. umihu asura baachila leyomah, dilhachi tane beshabbat uveyom hakkippurim, leakkoshe shabbat leyom hakkippurim, ma yom hakkippurim asura vaachila kol oto hayyom mishshum innuy, af shabbat asura vaachila kol oto hayyom. ulemotzae shabbat mutteret ben lo ben laacherim. vehashshochet lechole beshabbat divhettera ka shachat, muttar levari leechol mimmennu beoto shabbat basar chay, aval lo mevushshal, shemma yarbe bishvilo:

Shekken tzibbur meviim vechulei. shelosha esronim lappar lishlosha asar parim hem tisha usheloshim esronim, veissaron lakkeves learbaa asar kevasim hem arbaa asar esronim, ushene esronim laayil lishne haelim hem arbaa esronim, hare chamishshim veshiva, velishne temidim shenayim, velishne chivse musaf shabbat shenayim, hare shishshim veechad. veamar lahem rabbi shimon, vechi kol otan shel oto yom bichli echad hayu, vahalo ellu lapparim veellu laelim velakkevasim, vei mearev lehu mippesil, shemminchat parim belilatan ava, shene luggim leissaron, chatzi hahin lishlosha esronim, uminchat kevasim belilatan rakka, reviit hahin leissaron dehaynu shelosha luggim, vehen bolot zo mizzo, venimtzet zo chasera vezo yetera. ella mippene ma en mevi yachid shishshim veechad esronim bichli echad, dead shishshim yachol lehibbalel belog echad. vehay tanna savar la kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov deamar beferek shete middot afillu mincha shel shishshim esronim en lah ella log. veaf al pi shello nivlela kullah, kevan sheruya lehibbalel en habbelila meakkevet, dehachi kayma lan dechol harauy levila en bila meakkevet bo, vechol sheeno rauy levila bila meakkevet bo:
Veshishshim veechad en nivlalim. bitmiyya:
Kurtov. reviit shel reviit hallog:
En mitnaddevim log. yayin lannesachim. shello matzinu minchat nesachim shel log echad velo shel shenayim velo shel chamishsha:

Aval mitnaddevim shelosha. luggim, dachazu lecheves: vearbaa. dachazu leayil: veshishsha. luggim, shehu chatzi hahin, dachazu lefar: umishshishsha ulemala. mitnaddevim, deshiva chazu shelosha minnayhu lecheves vearbaa leayil, ushemona chazu lishne elim, vetisha chazu lecheves ufar, asara chazu leayil ufar, achad asar chazu lishne elim ulecheves. vechen leolam:
Mincha min hammincha. haomer hare alay mincha, o min mincha:
Yavi echat. min hammenachot haamurot bapparasha:
Menachot. alay, o sheomer min menachot alay, yavi shete menachot mimmin echad:
Perashti. mine menachot sheavi, veeni yodea kamma minim hem shennadarti lehavi:
Mevi chamishtan. minchat solet, minchat marcheshet, minchat machavat, minchat maafe tannur, vehi baa shene minim, challot urekikin:
Perashti mincha shel esronim. bichli echad, veeni yodea kamma esronim kavati bah:
Yavi shishshim issaron. ditfe mehachi lekka lesappoke. vei batzir mehachi nadar lo ichpat lan, dematne veomer kamma shepperashti yehe lenidri vehashshear yehe lindava:

Rabbi omer. kevan deamar mincha demashma chada, alma bichli echad kevaah, veim yavi shishshim bichli echad, shemma betzir mehachi nadar vehave mincha yetera, deit leh lerabbi dikviuta demana milleta hi, hilkach yavi shishshim menachot meachat vead shishshim, chada shel issaron echad, vachada shel shenayim, vachada shel shelosha, vachada shel arbaa, ad shishshim. shennimtza mevi ben hakkol elef shemone meot usheloshim issaron, devadday chada minnayhu nadar. veinach nedava. veen halacha kerabbi:

Hare alay mincha min hasseorim yavi min hachittim. sheen minchat nedava baa ella min hachittim. uchegon sheamar illu hayiti yodea sheen meviim mincha min hasseorim lo hayiti noder ella min hachittim. aval im amar lo hayiti noder kelum, eno chayyav kelum:
Yavi solet. dichtiv (Vayikra 2) solet yihye karbano:
Rabbi shimon poter. rabbi shimon savar bigmar devarav adam nitpas, vehoil ugemar devarav shello kedin hammincha, eno chayyav kelum. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Saris. chamma, eno lo choletz velo meyabbem, velo choltzin umeyabbemin leishto:
Aylonit. simaneha perashnu beferek kamma:
Bealuha pesaluha. shehoil vehi petura min hayyibbum omedet alehem beissur eshet ach:
Vehashshote. afillu al yede chuppa vekiddushin lo posel velo maachil, sheen kinyano kinyan:
Nechtach haubbar shebbemeeha tochal. miyyad. vehu haddin im yeladattu vamet:
Ibbera lo tochal. shehaubbar eno maachil:
Gadol mishshel av. shehabboel eno maachil, lefi shello ba aleha leshem kiddushin velav kinyano hi, uveno maachil:
Haeved posel mishshum bia. im ba al hakkohenet pesalah milleechol batteruma:
Veeno fosel mishshum zara. im yesh lah zera levat kohen miyyisrael kasher:
Nichbash. nidchak uva aleha:
Hare ze eved. shevvelad shifcha kamoha:
Hayta em aviv bat kohen leyisrael tochal batteruma. im met aviv, af al gav dehavvalad kayyam uvealma valad posel, hay lo pasil, delav batar avu shadinan leh, delav zaro hu:
Hashshevet. min yarak hu, vechen shemo vaaravi. uvelaaz 76:
Mishshennatan tamo bakkedera. im haya shevet shel teruma, mishshennatan taam bakkedera vehotzio mimmenna, lo mitchayyev alav zar haochlo, deetz bealma hu:
Veeno mittamme tumat ochalim. dechevan shennitbashshel, kala chocho vetamo venishar keetz bealma, vetu lo chashuv ochel:
Luleve zeradim. anafim rakkim hayyotzim beet shemmelavlevim hailanot, vechovshim otan beyayin o vechometz o vemayim umelach, veochlim otan:
Vehaadal. min yarak dome litznon:
Vaale luf. mimmine habbetzalim. veyesh mimmennu min shekkorin lo luf shote:
Ad sheyyimtoku. dela chashive ochel ella leachar shekkovshim otan veyotze mehen merirutan:
Pakkuot. keen avatichim ketannim, vehen marim. verabbotay fershu, delaat midbarit. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Hare alay yayin. lannesachim:
Lo yifchot mishshelosha luggin. shehen pechutim shebbannesachim. reviit hahin lakkeves, telata luggin havu, shehin shenem asar luggin:
Shemen lo yifchot millog. shehappachut shebbammincha issaron solet, vehi teuna log shemen:
Rabbi omer shelosha luggin. kappachut shebbeminchat nesachim, issaron lakkeves balul birviit hahin shemen. veen halacha kerabbi:

Kayyom hammerubbe. keyom tov rishon shel chag hassukkot keshechal lihyot beshabbat. sheoto hayyom merubbe binsachim lakkarbanot shel chovat hayyom mikkol shear yemot hashshana. dahavu shelosha asar parim vearbaa asar kevasim vearbaa musafim, shene musaf deshabbat ushene musaf dechag, veelim shenayim vesair echad. vehannesachim hatztzerichim lechullam mea vearbaim log:
Yesh tzerichim hechsher. mayim. kedichtiv [vayyikra 11] vechi yuttan mayim al zera:
Veen tzerichin machashava. lechashshev alehen laachila. vechulla matnitin mefaresh lekamman:
Bet shammay omrim shene zecharim. deyalfinan mimmoshe shepperesh min haishsha leachar shennoldu lo shene zecharim:
Uvet hillel omrim zachar unekeva shenneemar zachar unekeva beraam. umimmoshe en reaya, sheal pi haddibbur asa:

Veshaha immah eser shanim vechulei. kidashkechan beavraham, leachar sheshshaha eser shanim im sara velo yalda nasa hagar. veyamim sheyyashav immah bechutza laaretz lo alu min hamminyan, dedilma yeshivat chutz laaretz garma. vechol hayyamim shehaish o haishsha cholim o chavushim bevet haasurim vechayyotze baze middevarim shemmonim hattashmish, en olin leminyan eser shanim:

Gershah mutteret linnase leacher. deshemma lav minnah have ella minneh. ucheshehu megarshah noten lah ketubbatah im toenet deminneh hu sheeno yore kechetz, umattilin cherem aleha im yodaat shehu yore kechetz vetoenet alav taanat sheker:

Haish metzuvve al periyya ureviyya velo haishsha. dichtiv (Bereshit 1) peru urevu vegomer‏ vechivshuha, vechivshah ketiv chaser vav, haish sheddarko lichbosh et haishsha hu metzuvve al periyya ureviyya:
Rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer vechulei. velet hilchata kevateh:

Veim nishtayyer mehaatara. shennechtach mehaatara veelach, kasher, sheen gid ella mehaatara ulemala letzad hagguf. atara hi shurat basar hammakkefet bimkom hammila. uven shenniftza haggid kemin makkat cherev vesakkin, ben shennitmaech vehuktan meelav, ben shennichrat, ben baggid ben babbetzim ben bechute habbetzim, kullam pesulim. vehane mile bide adam, aval mechamat choli hakkol kasher:

Bevet chonyo. bet hammikdash shebbana chonyo beno shel shimon hatztzaddik bealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim. shekkeshemmet shimon hatztzaddik amar lahem, chonyo beni yeshammesh tachtay, mippene shehaya baki veragil baavoda yoter mishshimi achiv. velo kibbel alav chonyo lihyot kohen gadol lefi shehaya shimi achiv gadol mimmennu shete shanim umechetza. venitmanna shimi kohen gadol tachat aviv. leyamim nitkanne chonyo beshimi achiv, amar lo bo vaalammedcha seder avoda. hilbisho ketonet bad dakka shellovshot hannashim al besaran vealeha ezor tzar katan veheemido etzel hammizbeach, yatza veamar leechav hakkohanim reu ma nadar ze vekiyyem laahuvato, oto hayyom sheetmanne lechohen gadol elbash ketonet shellechi veechgor beezor shellechi. bikkeshu echav hakkohanim lehargo, sach lahem kol hammeora, bikkeshu laharog et chonyo, ratz mippenehem levet hammelech. vaadayin kol haroe oto omer ze hu. halach lo lealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim shehayu bah revavot miyyisrael veasa sham mikdash uvana mizbeach veheela alav leshem Adonai. veal oto mizbeach nitnabbe yeshaya bayyom hahu yihye mizbeach laAdonai‏ betoch eretz mitzrayim. veamad habbayit hahu karov lematayim shana venikra bet chonyo al shemo. vehakkol modim shehakkarbanot shehayu kerevim sham enan karban. lefichach mi sheamar hare alay ola vehikrivah sham lo yatza yede nidro:

Sheakrivenna bevet chonyo. naase keomer hare alay ola al menat sheehergenna velo etchayyev beacharayutah, hilkach im hikrivah bevet chonyo yatza yede nidro, aval chayyav karet mishshum shochet bachutz, shehare kara aleha shem ola:
Rabbi shimon omer en zo ola. vahare hi chullin gemurim. sheen shem hekdesh chal aleha kelal kesheamar sheakrivenna bevet chonyo. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Veim gillach bevet chonyo lo yatza. ella yachazor vigallach bammikdash birushalayim, vesham yavi karbenotav:

Sheagallach bevet chonyo, im gillach bevet chonyo yatza. dehay gavra shennadar bannazir kede sheyyegallach bevet chonyo, letzaore nafsheh nitkavven, umippene shehaya karov levet chonyo verachok meeretz yisrael, amar i sagya bevet chonyo tarachna, tefe lo matzena leitztaore, velo chal shem nezirut alav, aval naase kemi shennishba shello lishtot yayin ad zeman peloni:
Rabbi shimon omer. eno nazir kelal umuttar lishtot yayin. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Veen tzarich lomar ledavar acher. im shimmeshu laavoda zara shello yeshammeshu od birushalayim:
Vahare hen kevaale mumin. shecholkim veochlim bakkadashim:
En pachot mishshenayim. mishshene yamim mishshenneefu:
Neechol lishlosha. sheafaum beerev shabbat. lefi sheen afiyyatan docha lo shabbat velo yom tov:
Letisha. beshabbat sheniyya, shehi teshii laafiyyato:
Laasara. shenneefu bachamishi beshabbat:

Shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana. kodem lashshabbat. neefa birvii veneechol beshabbat sheniyya, hare leachad asar. veim tomar, hare shenem asar ninhu, deha otah shabbat have yom hakkippurim veen hallechem neechol ad lemotzae shabbat. ha lo kashya, dilinyan achilat kadashim hallayla holech achar hayyom sheavar, hilkach mikre achad asar:
Veeno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov. lefi sheen ofim umevashshelim beyom tov ella ma sheochel beoto hayyom bilvad:
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer vechulei. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Tzerichot shene gittin. lishte yevamot. kerabbanan deyesh maamar achar maamar:
Vachalitza. leachat mehen, ufoteret tzaratah:
Maamar lazo veget lazo. pasal get shel acharona et harishona, dekam leh belo yivne, utzericha get lemaamaro vachalitza lezikkato:
Maamar lazo uvaal lazo tzerichot shene gittin. zo get lemaamaro vezo get leviato:
Vachalitza. leachat mehen ufoteret tzaratah:
Get lazo uvaal lazo tzericha get vachalitza. veasur lekayyemah, dekam aleh belo yivne mishshum get rishon, uveget lechuda lo nafka baalat bia, devia pesula hi:
En leachar chalitza kelum. vei hadar mekaddesh lah o letzaratah lo tafse vah kiddushin, kerabbi akiva deamar en kiddushin tofsin bechayyave lavin. veenah halacha:
Kishshut shennetaah beatzitz. sheeno nakuv, vehuchshera sham lekabbel tuma venitmet, dechitlusha damya:
Vehigdila veyatza chutz leatzitz. venechshevet kimchubbar, lefi sheyyoneket veshoevet min hakkarka shechutz leatzitz:
Tehora. shepparcha lah tuma mishsheyyatza chutz leatzitz:
Ma tivah littaher. dichshekkibbela tuma hayta chitlusha, hilkach ma shebbetoch heatzitz nishar betumato, uma shehosif achare chen veyatza chutz leatzitz, tahor. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Lo yifchot middinar zahav. vehu sheyyomar matbea shel zahav. dei lo, dilma niska dedahava kaamar, dehaynu chaticha shel zahav:
Nechoshet lo yifchot mimmaa chasef. sheyyavi nechoshet sheshshava maa kesef:
Perashti. kach vechach zahav:
Veeni yodea kamma perashti. yavi kol kach ad sheyyeda beatzmo shemmeolam lo nitkavven lechol kach:

Al petach habbayit. etzel petach hahechol bichnisato. velo hayu mannichim sham ella lehareot shemmaalin bakkodesh, deachshav mannichin al shel shayish umiyyad nosan lahechol umesadderan al shel zahav shel moshe:
Veal shel zahav bitziato. ad sheyyukteru bezichim, kidkatane lekamman bematnitin:
Hammachnisim omdim batztzafon. dehachi adif tefe deotan shemmesadderim haavoda yihyu batztzafon:
Ellu moshchin. vead shello yagbihu min hashshulchan ellu mannichin:
Afillu ellu notlin. veellu atzman mannichin achar shennatlu:
Af zo hayta tamid. desavar rabbi yose deen tamid ella shello yalin shulchan layla echad belo lechem:
Vehachallot mitchallekot lakkohanim. mishmar hayyotze cholek im mishmar hannichnas:
Chal yom hakkippurim lihyot beshabbat. sheddin lechem happanim leachlo beoto shabbat shennotlim oto meal hashshulchan, veachshav en yecholim leachlo mippene hattaanit:
Hachallot mitchallekot laarev. veen mamtinim lechalleko lemachar mippene shennifsal belina leachar zemanno shennistallek:
Hassair. shel musaf shehu chattat veneechol lakkohanim:
Neechol laarev. belele shabbat. shezzemanno leyom velayla ad chatzot. veaf al pi sheen yecholim levashshelo beshabbat velo beyom hakkippurim:

Habbavliyyim. kohanim shealu mibbavel. uvaggemara mefaresh delo bavliyyim hayu ella alekkesanderiyyim hayu. veal shem shessonim talmide chachamim shebbeeretz yisrael et habbavliyyim, karu laalekkesanderiyyim sheosim maase raavtanut bavliyyim:
Hayu ochlin oto chay. keshechal yom hakkippurim lihyot beerev shabbat:
Mippene sheddatan yafa. veenan katzim leechol habbasar keshehu chay:

Chalatz veasa maamar natan get uvaal. ayyavam echad vivama achat kae. veaf al gav detana leel, hadar tanya hacha mishshum sefa devae leifluge ben bia lachalitza, dachalitza ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof en achareha kelum, vehabbia davka bizman shehi battechilla. uleashmoinan nammi pelugta derabbi nechemya verabbanan:
Ben battechilla ben baemtza. kegon get lezo vechalatz lezo vechazar veasa bah maamar o bevaalat hagget, lo mahane hammaamar velo bainan get lemaamaro:
Bassof. achar maamar veget chalatz:
En achareha chelum. vachalitza gemura hi, vei hadar veaved maamar lo baya get, mishshum dachalitza gerushin gemurim ninhu, veaf al gav dehi chalitza pesula:
Habbia baemtza. kegon get lezo uvaal lezo vechazar veasa maamar bashshelishit, asur bikrovoteha:
Bassof. get lezo umaamar lezo vechazar uva (aleh) al [haachat], yesh achar bia zo zikkat yevamin, vechi mappik lah bae chalitza velo saggi lah beget:
En achareha chelum. venafka beget belo chalitza. vei hadar vekiddesh leidach achar bia en bemaasav kelum:
Hammachzir et gerushato. mishshennisset:
Vehannose et chalutzato. dekayma aleh belav delo yivne, kevan shello bana shuv lo yivne:

Vehannose kerovat chalutzato. dekasavar rabbi akiva dachalutzato keishto, shehakkatuv keraah beto, dichtiv (sham) bet chalutz hannaal. vekasavar nammi rabbi akiva yesh mamzer mechayyave lavin. veenah halacha:
Kerovat gerushato. digrushato keishto. veimmah vaachotah chayyave keritut ninhu:

Kavveret devorim vechulei. im hi mechubberet betit, hakkol modim shehi chekarka. veim hayta munnachat al gabbe yetedot, hakkol modim shehi kechelim. lo nechelku ella shemmunnachat al gabbe karka veenah mechubberet betit:
Rabbi eliezer omer hare hi chekarka. veniknet bechesef bishtar uvachazaka, kekarka:

Vechotvin aleha perozbol. shetar shekkotvim bet din lammalve shemmasar lahem kol chov sheyyesh lo, shello tehe sheviit meshammatto. veen kotvin perozbul ella al hakkarka, kelomar kesheyyesh lallove karka. veim yesh lo kavveret devorim, kemo sheyyesh lo karka dame, vechotvin aleha perozbul lammalve:
Veenah mekabbelet tuma vimkomah. dahave chimchubbar sheeno mekabbel tuma:

Veharode. mechallot devash shebbetochah beshabbat, chayyav chattat, ketolesh mimmekom chibbur. dichtiv (Shmuel 1 14) veyitbol otah beyaarat haddevash, vechi ma inyan yaar etzel devash, ella ma yaar hattolesh mimmennu veshabbat chayyav chattat, af devash harode mimmennu veshabbat chayyav chattat:

Almana lechohen gadol. avde melog. ma shehaishsha meshayyeret leatzmah veenah kotevet bichtubbatah, nikraim nichse melog, shehabbaal moleg otam nechasim kimligat hattarnegolim, mippene shehu ochel perot otan nechasim, veim pachatu pachatu lah veim hotiru hotiru lah. venichse tzon barzel hem hannechasim shehichnisa lo uma shehosif hu lah vechatvu bakketubba sach hakkol kibbel alav peloni kach vechach bichtubbatah. ulechach nikraim tzon barzel, shehakkeren kayyam kevarzel, sheim metu kullan, chayyav habbaal leshallem. ulefi shehayu regilim lashum hatztzon beshumat kach vechach, vehaya haroe chayyav beacharayutan kefi hashshuma afillu im metu kol hatztzon, lechach nikreu hannechasim shehabbaal mekabbel alav acharayutan nichse tzon barzel:
Avde melog lo yochlu. lefi shehen shellah vehi chalala:
Min haerusin lo yochlu vatteruma. mippene shennitkaddesha kiddushe avera nifsela mitteruma devet aviha im bat kohen hi:

Rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon machshirin. ad shettibbael vetease chalala, shenneemar (Vayikra 21) velo yechallel, shene chillulin, echad lah veechad lezarah. velet hilchata kevatayhu, ella af min haerusin lo yochlu vatteruma:
Nitarmelu o nitgarshu. min hakkohanim hallalu:
Min hannissuin pesulot. deshavveyuha chalala beviatan:
Min haerusin kesherot. daafillu tanna kamma lo pasal min haerusin ella bechayyehen, shehi mishtammeret levia pesula, aval metu lo:
Shennimmok miktzato en mitztaref. dema shennimmok eno chashuv ochel, kevan shennitmasmes veeno rauy laachila:

Happitma shel rimmon. kemin dad yotze verosh harimmon, vehu hannikra fitma. useviv happitma kemin perach yarok sheyyesh bo chutim dakkim, vehen keruyin netz. usevivot otan hachutim keen kos verosho asuy letalpiyyot, vehu karuy masrek, mippene sheyyesh lo shinnayim kemasrek:

Af hammasrek tahor. sheim yechatech min happeri, en mitgallim haggalinim bechach, hilkach lo have shomer. aval happitma, im yachtechuha ad sharshah, yitgallu haggarinim veyippased happeri. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Arko asara verachbo chamishsha. kedichtiv (Shemot 28) ammatayim arko veamma rachbo. rabbi yehuda letaameh deamar shel kelim bat chamishsha tefachim hi:
Noten arko. shel lechem happanim keneged rachbo shel shulchan:
Vechofel. hallechem, tefachayim umechetza lemala baggova mikkan umikkan. vehen hen hakkeranot. venimtzeu zekufot beshave lisfat hashshulchan:
Venimtza arko memalle rachbo shel shulchan. verachbo machazik chatzi orech shel shulchan, ucheshehaya mesadder acher etzlo nimtza shulchan kullo male:
Arko shenem asar. rabbi meir letaameh deamar kol amma bat shishsha tefachim, chutz mimmizbach hazzahav vekeren mizbeach hachitzon vehassovev vehayesod. vahalacha kerabbi meir:
Lechem happanim arko asara. beha mode rabbi meir:

Utefachayim revach baemtza. ben shene hassedarim. derochav hallechem lo have ella chamishsha, shene hassedarim machazikin asara bashshulchan learko, pashu lehu tefachayim revach ben seder leseder, shettehe ruach menashshevet bahem shello yitappeshu:
Abba shaul omer sham. beoto revach shebben seder leseder notnim habbezichim:
Vahalo chevar neemar venatatta al hammaarechet. veal, mammash mashma:
Vealav matte menashshe. vehayenu samuch, hacha nammi al samuch. vahalacha keabba shaul:
Nivlat behema temea bechol makom. ben bakkefarim ben bashshevakim:
Tzerichin machashava. distamayhu lav laachila:

Veenan tzerichin hechsher. lo hechsher mayim velo hechsher sheretz, sheen tzarich ligga bahen davar tame letammean, shessofan littame meatzman tuma chamura. veim tomar, bishlama nivlat of tahor deenah metammea ella bevet habbelia, nicha ditzricha machashava letamme tuma kalla. ella nivlat behema dimtammea vemagga uvemassa, machashava lamma li letuma kalla, hi gufa temea hi. ha milleta meshane vaggemara perek dam shechita, kegon deikka fachot mikkazzayit nevela, vetzerfah lefachot mikkabbetza ochalim, deven hay vehay have chabbetza, dilhachi tzarich machashava, umikkol makom chashiv sofo letamme tuma chamura veenah tzericha hechsher, hoil vehaya efshar letzarfah lechazzayit:
Bashshevakim. sheyyesh rov am habbaim lashshuk, ikka tuva deachle nivlat of tahor, veachle chalavim:
Enam tzerichin lo machashava. delaachila hen omdim:

Velo hechsher. denivlat of tahor sofah letamme tuma chamura, dimtamma vegadim bevet habbelia, vechelev mayre vechelev temea, dimtamme hachelev kabbasar, kedilkamman befirkin, hilkach enan tzerichin hechsher:

Rabbi shimon omer af haggamal vechulei. enan tzerichin machashava bashshevakim, deikka rov am veachle lehu. udelo chetanna kamma deamar nivlat behema temea bechol makom velo mappik lehane. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Kor. etz rach hannosaf berosho shel dekel, veochlin oto bene adam, uvimot haggeshamim hu mitkashshe:
Keetz lechol davar. veeno mittamme tumat ochalin:
Nilkach bechesef maaser. difri [mipperi] vegiddule karka hu:
Kafniyyot. temarim shello vashlu kol tzarkan:
Ochalin. umetammeim tumat ochalin:
Hamechattech levashshel. kegon mechattech deluim o vetzalim o vasar kede levashshel bakkedera:
Shello merak. shello gamar hachaticha. kemo umerak acher shechita al yado, bemassechet yoma [daf lo]:
Eno chibbur. af al pi sheadayin hachatichot meorot bemiktzat:
Lichbosh. shekkovshim beyayin uvechometz kede lehitkayyem:

Velishlok. shelika tefe mibbishshul, uvehay nicha leh bechibburan, hilkach kol zeman shello merak have chibbur. aval levashshel lo have chibbur, deyodea hu shehabbishshul yafridem vichallekem zo mizzo:

Hitchil lefarek. ulehafrid legamre echad mehen, lo amrinan kevan degalle dateh beechad sherotze lehaferidan, kullehu nammi cheillu mufradim zo mizzo velo have chibbur, ella ochel shepperek bilvad lo have chibbur, uma shello ferek, have chibbur:
Haegozim sheamanan. sheggiddelan vechibberan zo vazo. leshon vayhi omen et hadassa (Ester 2):

Shechamaran. leshon vayyitzberu otam chomarim chomarim (Shemot 8). midderech harotzim leetzor egozim o vetzalim, shechotchin otan vekoshrim otan bechevel o vimshicha umechabberin otan zo im zo vetolin otan kede sheyyitkayyemu:
Lefakkel. kemo lekallef. vedugmato shaninu perek 4‏ demaasrot mishna 6, habbetzalim mishsheyyefakkel:

Haegozim vehashshekedim. hasheta mayre vimfatztzea haegozim vehashshekedim. shehakkelippa shel egozim veshel shekedim chashiva shomer, veaf al pi sheppetzaan, kol zeman shehi mechubberet baochel chashiva shomer:
Ad sheyyerasses. leshon vehikka et habbayit haggadol resisim (Amos 6). kelomar ad shettihye hakkelippa retzutza ufetuta lachalakim dakkim:

Kol hakkelippin. kegon kelippe egozim ushekedim verimmonim ukelippe vetzim, chashive shomer laochel, umitztarfin im haochel lehashelimo lechashshiur lekabbel tuma. umihu kelippa lacha haelyona sheal haegozim bishat lekitatan, enah mitztarefet, dela chashiva shomer, sheen shomer al gabbe shomer:
Kedura. nekuva. leshon mekadderim beharim keditnan beeruvin. ukedura enah mitztarefet, lefi sheenah shomeret keshehi nekuva vachatucha:
Vehachitzona. hi hakkelippa haddakka hannofelet meeleha keshemmemashmeshin babbatzal. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Shebbesasan. sheddash otan beragle habbehema o vemaklot im hattevua. uvesasan, leshon bossu mikdashecha (yeshaya 63):
Verabbi yose metamme. hoil ureuyim lehafchan beeter im hattevua. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Pesiga shel eshkol. derech haeshkol latzet min hashshidra shellah kamma eshkolot ketannim, veotan eshkolot nikraim pesige anavim:
Sherikkenah. shennitrokna min happesigim shebbah, kelomar shehesiru mimmenna happesigim hakketannim venishara rekanit:
Shiyyer bah gargir echad temea. shennaaset kullah yad leoto gargir:
Sharvit shel temara sherikkeno. shehesir hattemarim venishar hashsharvit rekan:
Verabbi elazar ben azarya metaher beshel pol. mippene shehappolin gassim hen veen tzerichin lesharvit, sheafillu mitarvim bappesolet noach lenakkeran:

Umetamme beshel kitniyyot. deshomer hu, mippene shehen dakkin veen yachol lenakkeran keshemmitarvim bappesolet, venicha leh sheyyehu veotan sharvitin kede sheyyuchal lemashmeshan uletaltelan beoto sharvit. veen halacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya:
Dagim meematay mekabbelim tuma. dechol zeman shehen chayyim enan mekabbelim tuma:
Mishsheyyitztzodu. chashuvim kemetim:
Im yecholim lichyot. sheim yachazirum lammayim yichyu, enan mittammein. aval im en yecholim lichyot keshemmachaziran lammayim, af al pi sheadayin lo metu, mekabbelim tuma. vahalacha kevet hillel:
Yichur shel teena shennifshach. anaf shel ilan teena uvo teenim, shennitlash venifrad mimmekom chibburo, ella shennishar meore umedubbak biklippat hailan bilvad:
Rabbi yehuda metaher. otam teenim shebbeanaf, im naga vahem tuma. dachashiv lehu kimchubbar, hoil veheanaf meore ketzat, veaf al pi sheeno meore ella vakkelippa:

Vachachamim omrim im yachol lichyot. im yiksheru vichabberu heanaf im hailan yichye heanaf veyotzi ferot, chashuv kimchubbar utehorim. veim lo yichye kesheyyiksheruhu im hailan, hare teenim shebbeanaf kitlushim hen chashuvim umekabbelim tuma. vahalacha kachachamim:
Habba al yevimto. shogeg. kesavur ishsha acheret hi:
Mezid. leshem zenut velo lemitzvat yibbum:

Afillu hu shogeg vehi mezida. lo mibbaya hecha dehi mikkavvena lemitzva, ella afillu hecha detarvayhu lo mechavvene lemitzva, kegon shehu mechavven leishsha acheret vehi nitkavvena leshem zenut, kana, deamar kera (Devarim 25) yevamah yavo aleha, mikkol makom:
Hammeare. shello gamar biato ella hichnis atara bilvad. ufegiat atara belo hachenasa keruya neshika:
Kana. vezacha bannachala, veyotzet beget im ba lehotziah:
Lo chalak ben bia levia. ben bia kedarkah levia shello kedarkah, dichtiv (Vayikra 20) mishkeve ishsha, maggid hakkatuv sheshshete mishkavot yesh beishsha:

Ufosel et em immo. dei lav hu, hayta em immo chozeret litruma devet aviha leachar mitat bittah. vechol zeman shezze kayyam enah chozeret litruma dichtiv (Vayikra 22) vezera en lah, ayyen aleha, o bat bat habbat, o ben ben habben, o bat bat habben ad sof kol haddorot:
Lo chivni kohen gadol. kelomar lo yirbu kemoto beyisrael, shehu posleni min hatteruma:
Shehassaris. yesh saris shecholetz vecholtzin leishto:
Vehassaris lo choletz vechulei. dichtiv (Devarim 25) velo yimmache shemo, perat laze sheshshemo machuy:
En li lefaresh. eni yodea lefaresh eze saris ben chalitza veeze patur:
Seris adam. shennistares leachar shennolad:

Seris chamma. mimmee immo shello raa chamma ella keshehu saris. vesimanav meforashin, kol sheen lo zakan, usearo lakuy, uvesaro machlik, veen meme raglav maalin reticha, ucheshemmetil mayim eno ose kippa sheen killuach hashsheten holech lemerachok ad sheyyaase iggul kemin kippa, veshichvat zaro deha, veen meme raglav machmitzin, verochetz bimot haggeshamim veen besaro maale hevel, vekolo lakuy veeno nikkar ben ish leishsha. vahalacha kerabbi akiva sheomer seris adam choletz vecholtzin leishto umeyabbemin leishto. aval hu eno meyabbem, shehare pasul lavo bakkahal:
Vehakkelusim. min kitniyyot:
Umitztarfim. difamim shehen neechalin im happeri:
Rabbi yose omer af oketz haddelaat. mippene shehu nishlak immah. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Aggasim. baaravi 64, uvelaaz 591:
Kerustemelin. tappuchim ketannim sheddomim laafatzim. hakkeruyim 130:
Perishin. baaravi 373, uvelaaz 486:
Uzradin. baaravi 287. uvelaaz 569:
Tefach. aoketz delaat yevanit davka kae, velo aacharine hashshenuyim bammishna, deokatzehen ketannim:
Kuneras. yerakot marim, umemattekin otan al yede haur berotchim. veen halacha kerabbi elazar berabbi tzadok:
Lo mittammein velo metammein. veen tzarich lomar sheen mitztarfin:
Chelev behema tehora. shennitnabbela:
Tahor mittumat nevela. dichtiv [vayyikra 7] vechelev nevela vegomer‏ yease lechol melacha, vaafillu melechet hakkodesh bemashma:

Lefichach hu tzarich hechsher. dechevan sheen sofo letamme tuma chamura, dehachi kayma lan perek kamma detohorot, dechol sheen sofo letamme tuma chamura hayenu letamme adam vechelim, tzarich hechsher:

Chelev behema temea metamme tumat nevelot. delo tihara tora ella chelev shel behema tehora shennitnabbela, dichtiv [sham] chelev nevela vechelev terefa, yatzat chelev behema temea sheen lah terefa, lefi shetterefatah ushechitatah shava:

Veeno tzarich hechsher. letumat ochalim im tzeref pachot mikkazzayit lefachot mikkabbetza kidfarishna leel. aval machashava vadday vae, midi dahave abbisra devaya machashava vechol makom keditnan leel:
Tzarich machashava bakkefarim. velo vashshevakim. aval hechsher tzerichin bechol makom:
Meematay mittammeot mishshum mashke. distamayhu laachila kayme. umeematay mittammein tumat mashkin lihyot techilla:

Mishsheyyecharcher. mishsheyyavi ashan viashshen lehaveriach haddevorim. leshon lecharcher riv. shennire cheillu rotze lecharcher riv im haddevorim. perush acher, mishsheyyecharcher, sheyyechammem otam lehotzi divsham, af al pi sheadayin lo yatza haddevash. leshon nachar mappuach (yirmeya 10). veit degarse mishsheyyeharher, kelomar mishsheyyeharher machashava velibbo lirdot haddevash:
Mishsheyyerassek. kesherotzim lirdot devash min hakkavveret, chotchim besakkin umotziin challot challot, vezehu rissukan:

Vehinnichah meubberet. af al pi sheyyesh lah banim mimmennu vehi ochelet batteruma, lo yochlu avde tzon barzel batteruma, lefi shehen shel yorshin veyesh laubbar chelek bahen, veen laubbar koach lehaachilam batteruma, i mishshum dekasavar ubbar bime zara zar hu, i mishshum dekasavar yalud maachil, sheeno yalud eno maachil, dichtiv (Vayikra 22) vilid beto hem yochlu, vekare beh hem yaachilu:
Shehaubbar posel. im bat kohen leyisrael hi vehinnichah meubberet veen lah ben acher, poslah millashuv levet aviha:
Veeno maachil. sheim hayta bat yisrael lechohen vehinnichah meubberet en baubbar koach lehaachilah, vehu haddin laavadav:

Af bat kohen lechohen kulei. kevan deamart sheeno yalud eno maachil, af bat kohen lechohen en haavadim ochlim batteruma mippene chelko shel ubbar, shehare avadav hen veenan ochlin ella bishvilo, vehu en bo koach lehaachil. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Mittammeim umetammeim velo mitztarfim. lefi shehen yadot bilvad, veenan meshammerin et haochel:
Veyad happarkil. keshehaanavim kerutim im hazzemora, nikraim parkil. leshon parkile anavim:
Tefach mikkan vetefach mikkan. hazzemora shenniktzetza vehaeshkolot teluyin bah, tefach min hazzemora miyyamin laeshkol vetefach missemol, chashuv yad, tefe lo:
Yad haeshkol. oketz haeshkol shettaluy bazzemora, hu yad haeshkol:
Kol shehu. afillu aroch harebe:
Zenav haeshkol. sofo shel eshkol:
Sherikkeno. shehushsheru mimmennu garine haanavim, af hu yad laanavim shebberosho, sheochazim oto biznavo. veaf hu shiuro vechol shehu, vaafillu aroch harebe:
Vehammachbed shel temara. machbedot shel temarim, uvahen temarim, shiur orech hayyad shellahen lehavi et hattuma, arbaa tefachim, aval tefe lo:
Umalin shel shibbolin. zakan haelyon shel shibbolet sheyyatza verosho kemin sear shel zakan:

Hare alay ola yavi cheves. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer o tor o ben yona. beatreh detanna kamma lo hayu korim ola setam ella leolat behema, ufechuta shebbeolat behema hu keves, hilkach yavi keves. uveatreh derabbi elazar ben azarya hayu korim ola setam gam leolat haof, hilkach yavi tor o ben yona. umar ki atreh umar ki atreh:

Yavi far vaegel. zecharim velo nekevot. deola lekka lesappoke ella bizcharim. umatnitin rabbi hi deamar lekamman hammitnaddev katan vehevi gadol lo yatza. aval rabbanan pelige aleh veamre hammitnaddev katan vehevi gadol yatza, deyesh bichlal merubbe muat. vahalacha kachachamim:
Perashti. echad mikkarbenot habbehema veeni yodea meeze mehen perashti. yavi mikkol mine behema hazzecharim gedolim uketannim, dehaynu par vaegel ayil vesair ugedi vetale:
Perashti. et hammin:
Veeni yodea ma perashti. im min behema o min of:
